social.properties|m.earned_crowns: become the new Crown King, having earned {0} crowns in the past 7 days\!
item.properties|f.static_diskgun: A shockingly powerful handgun that creates a storm of electrified disks. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_2: We're attempting to find a means to activate the Core through the power of the minerals found within the Clockworks.  Those minerals are capable of transforming the Clockworks- we have seen this in the Haven Arcade.  It is our belief that we can use that power to activate the Core and... open it somehow.
auction.properties|m.featured: Featured auctions are held by the Haven Treasury. \n\nThey often contain rare, unique or limited time items.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_2: Mount Krampus is the home of the Grinchlin faction and their allies. They are a very stingy lot and won't drop any loot themselves. All their treasures are stored in the shelters you'll find up the mountain.
helptips.properties|m.tut_dash: Evade damage from monster attacks by pressing [[DODGE]].
helptips.properties|m.tg2_crystal: Crystal blocks are like breakable blocks except that if destroyed, they also destroy the crystal blocks of the same color connected to them.
item.properties|f.wolver_cap: A lively hat made from significantly less lively Wolver hide.
logon.properties|m.trying_next_port: Failed to connect to the server. Trying an alternative port. Please wait...
item.properties|f.spiraltail_mask: A simple simian mask made to celebrate the new year. Your sly shenanigans are sure to become a spectacle.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_spec: Hi there {0}, I'm Zebulon, a knight who utilizes specialty gear that is suited for specific scenarios.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons that target specific monster families and gear that has mixed defense types. \n\nSometimes what you really need is a sword that smites the undead or armor that raises your slime smashing proficiency.  The gear I specialize in is often built for a specific task, but is also great to mix and match with other sets.  Experiment\!
conversation.properties|m.core_guard_1: You should go speak with Vaelyn.
guild.properties|log.energy_added: Deposited {0} energy to the energy well (new total\: {1}).
item.properties|f.barrier_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The elemental offense of a tortodrone on the Long Migration should aid you on your own expeditions.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: Thanks for your help collecting spikes\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.firefighter_helmet: Normally worn by firefighters, this helmet doesn't offer much defense but grants the wearer high fire resistance.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_shield: A reliable shield that'll keep you from getting too fired up in battle.
item.properties|f.super_stun_gun: An upgraded Stun Gun whose powerful blast will discourage even the most disconcerting of Clockworks monsters.
item.properties|f.vile_seal: A small scrap of ancient parchment imbued with dark magicks. It is believed that they grant power to those with evil souls.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_3a: Very well, then let's begin.  Shadow damage is generally caused by concentrations of negative energy.  Attacks that inflict shadow damage include anything from the psychic manipulation of the aforementioned negative energy to physical attacks using weapons forged from dark matter.
mission.properties|o.ancient_generator: Explore the Ancient Generator and restore power to the Rescue Camp before night falls\!
item.properties|f.guild_members_300: Allows your guild to recruit up to 300 members\!
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_2: During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
guild.properties|i.buy_environments: Change the environment for the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.circuit_breaker_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against shock, at the expense of fire and freeze resistance.
item.properties|f.mighty_defender: An advanced Spiral Knight shield, reinforced for battle and beautifully embossed for the stories afterward.
item.properties|f.mercurial_helm: A sublime silver helmet that'll let you move as swiftly as water, though perhaps not quite so swiftly *through* it.
item.properties|f.azure_guardian_helm: A noble helmet reserved for the most senior members of the Spiral Order. The technique which weaves dragon scale seamlessly into the metal is a closely guarded secret.
mission.properties|o.aggressive_assembly: Rescue the lost squad and decommission the factory foreman
pvp.properties|m.love_upload: Select the level type you'd like to upload.\nNote\: the file selection dialog will not be visible if you are playing full-screen.
mission.properties|m.ancient_generator_2: You nasty, little things\! Don't you dare touch the artifact\! \n\nArgh\! I'll be back for you\!
item.properties|f.fire_barrier: Surrounds you with fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
item.properties|f.valkyrie_helm: A priceless helmet whose name denizens of the Underworld dare not mention.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_weap_4: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Be careful confronting the Warmaster\!
mission.properties|o.explosive_plot: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_9a: Hi {0}\!  Look at you, wow\!  Hey, Vanguard or not you know where to go if you want to really stand out right?
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
item.properties|f.critter_carapace: A chitinous chunk carefully shucked from a Clockworks creature. It's in surprisingly good shape.
social.properties|m.invite_persona: Select the player you wish to invite\:
chat.properties|m.away_set: Auto-response message set. Use /back to turn it off.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r6: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_3c: Remember, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
mission.properties|o.shocking_sentient_s: Battle your way to the secret weapons facility
item.properties|f.rename_guild: Allows you to choose a new name for your guild. This item can only be used by a Guildmaster and is destroyed once used.
item.properties|f.firebreak_armor: Upgraded Emberbreak armor further hacked to resist fire.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_7a: {0}, I thought you would be taller.
item.properties|f.static_edge: A modified Proto Sword capable of generating a low-intensity electrical charge.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_torin: A fading inscription reads\: Here lies Torin, knight of Almire.
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_helm: An illuminated helm strengthened against soporific smogs. It's surprisingly soft inside.
item.properties|f.bushy_tail: A peculiarly intact specimen of a Clockworks beast's tail.
conversation.properties|r.fc_bridge_2: I'm not here to make trouble with Vanaduke.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_armor: A variegated veiling ward worn by vehemently venerated victors.
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_4a: There's one last thing- it seems you won't be the first knight to have entered the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.  We've detected another Alpha Squad recon module somewhere within the factory.  Please attempt to recover it.  I hope that analysis proves that Euclid's squad made it out of there alive...
item.properties|f.schemer_scrap: A fragment of a blueprint used by gremlin schemers to construct their mechanical monstrosities. With enough of them and a little tape, you could construct a metal death machine yourself\!
mission.properties|o.p_r9_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_3a: Over here we have a collection of valuable items and objects you will likely find in the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.divine_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Oh {0}, it's horrible, just horrible\! \n\nA terrifying swarm of black kats came out of some dark portal deep within the Clockworks and have raided the Moorcroft Archives\!
mission.properties|o.go_shopping: Visit the Haven Bazaar and discover what it has to offer
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We saw the explosions all the way from camp\! That was amazing\!
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_3a: We thought things were getting pretty predictable, even at the depths you've been exploring.  The Core was in sight.  But now some kind of massive negative energy anomaly has surfaced above the Core, blocking access to it.  Recon Knights have said that all they see near it is fire, endless fire. \n\nWe don't know what it is just yet, but squads near that depth have already gone missing.  This is bad news.
item.properties|f.volcanic_demo_helm: A cutting-edge helm reinforced with volcanic iron and designed for use with high-temperature explosives.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_4a: If what Parma said is true then we're the last line of defense against The Swarm. {0}, I won't lie but this might change everything. We'll need to pass this on to Spiral HQ immediately. I'll round everyone up and send you a mission to accept when you're ready.
item.properties|f.reaper_rib: A bone stained black by the wickedness of its former possessor.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Biotech Hahn for research.
item.properties|f.fireburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of fire.
item.properties|f.freezing_vaporizer: An alchemical bomb that produces a cloud of ultra-low temperature mist.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Two cannons have stopped firing\!  Report at once, you mongrels\!
item.properties|f.magmatic_fanatic_mail: A plated mail said to have been worn by fanatics that worshiped a magma god. Its fires will protect those that are worthy.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_1a: Hello {0}, I'm happy to report that my equipment is back up and running\! Now I have some good news and bad news for you.  The good news is\: I've been able to track down the source of that energy signature. Here is the bad news\: the energy source has been pinpointed to a highly dangerous area of the Clockworks that Recon Knights have dubbed the 'Royal Jelly Palace.'
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3a: Gremlins are a race of creatures who are incredibly adept at creating and dismantling all manners of machinery. They are at once a legion of brilliant artificers and a force of powerful destruction.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_1:
Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\! Merry Winterfest\!

That special time of year is finally here, when a delicate blanket of wondrous white snow covers Haven and every Stranger, every snipe and every Knight fills their hearts with holiday cheer.

But to you I must tell, all is sadly not well. Lacking motive or reason, a group of shriveled-heart grinchlins have threatened this Winterfest season\!
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research: By now you have likely collected a few material samples from your early expeditions into the Clockworks.  Spiral HQ is requesting some of those materials for their ongoing research of the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.glowing_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns bright enough to light a darkened room.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_wasd_move_: Keyboard used for movement, advanced commands, quickslots and chat
mission.properties|o.vicious_viscous: Prove your valor against a legion of powerful piercing monsters
item.properties|f.celestial_orbitgun: This planetoid projecting pistol conjures images of the birth of stellar systems. Opponents caught within its blazing maelstrom are sure to see the light.
uplink.properties|m.unclaimed: Accept to claim these items on this knight. Be aware that you will not be able to Steam Trade these items in the future, once claimed.
item.properties|f.tundrus: A modified magnus that ensures that if somehow your target survived the first shot, they will still be frozen in their tracks. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
item.properties|f.exp_west_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
item.properties|f.toy_box: Contains one unique toyland costume or accessory. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_shield: A large, bony bulwark bathed in blackish brume. It occasionally issues a quiet, forlorn whisper, usually about remembering to block.
item.properties|f.flawed_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. Though flawed, this orb is still useful in crafting low-powered items.
sprites.properties|d.iron_harness_eli: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal normal damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 10% \nCan be used by\: All battle sprites
chat.properties|m.usage_sound: Usage\: /{0}\nToggle all sounds between full and silent.
helptips.properties|m.unlock_gold: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use the Gold Key.
chat.properties|m.usage_smile: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nSmile at your fellow players.
item.properties|f.seraphic_helm: A beautiful mail coif that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_helm: A superior plate helmet imbued with the elemental essence of flame. It's difficult to breathe in, but it can resist high temperatures and any number of savage attacks.
item.properties|f.pathfinder_helm: A helm handy for blazing trails and protecting against the bites of hungry monsters in the wild.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
uplink.properties|e.unvalidated: Your email address has not been validated. An email has been sent. Please follow the link in the email and once validated, return here and try again.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_8: This gremlin comes from the colony of Emberlight, deep within the Clockworks. They're a group of outcasts that have defied King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. We're hoping we can make a treaty with them that will allow us to use their colony as a base of operations for our missions deeper underground.
item.properties|f.drake_scale_helm: A helmet crafted from the scales of beasts thought to be the descendants of dragons.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: Drones can also deal status damage.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_helm: A hardy helm handcrafted by Gremlin smiths to protect a Mecha Knight's control unit. With the control unit removed it fits a knight remarkably well.
item.properties|f.obsidian_crusher: A peculiar bomb made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. Despite it being a bomb, some are drawn to holding it and 'solving' it as if it were some kind of puzzle.
projectx.properties|i.style_kit: Use cosmetic items to permanently add them.
item.properties|f.exp_west_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the western side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.soul_dust: The dust of the departed. Whether it still retains any shred of a soul remains to be seen.
helptips.properties|m.lock_striker: Out-run anyone with the Striker Dash, hit'em hard and then leave them in the dust\! \n\nBe the ultimate damage-dealer with an increased overall attack damage and the fastest sword\!
conversation.properties|m.ritual_2b: Where did you find that?\! Hand it over\! I can finally complete my work\! But just a friendly warning\: I have no idea what might happen. It could be very bad. You probably want to be prepared in case things go... awry.
mission.properties|o.creators_and_create: Learn about the most powerful construct and gremlin monsters
mission.properties|r.pioneers_8a: Tell me about Squad Technician Rulen.
item.properties|f.nether_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when this shield smashes through your foes.
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: Some of your {0} friends already have a full friend list\:\n{1}\n{2}
dungeon.properties|m.scarlet_fortress_de: Named for its vibrant tapestries, the Scarlet Fortress is a deconstructed mass of a forgotten castle, drifting endlessly in the void of the Clockworks. Strange bestial ghosts haunt its long corridors, tirelessly pursuing those that enter their domain.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3a: It is hard to know exactly as so much of what is within seems to hold their origin from different worlds. Some appear to be from realms of great antiquity, no doubt once home to innumerable old gods and creatures.\n\nThis world is an unnatural one. What you see within it was never meant to be here. The great histories of so many worlds endlessly churning through the cogs of this great machine... I find it quite sad.
conversation.properties|r.core_tech_1: I'd like to know how I can help.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r4: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
mission.properties|o.eye_of_needle: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_dash: Sorry, there must be two letters surrounding any dash, and two dashes maximum.
item.properties|f.battle_chef_coat: A coat worn by the knights who work in the Skylark's galley. Not to be trifled with, these chefs are blade masters on and off the battlefield.
item.properties|f.frenzy_avenger_helm: A helm worn by heavenly guardians who watch over a kingdom hidden atop a wind-swept mountain.
item.properties|f.gh_env_default: The default environment that really captures the stale air of the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_2: Again, this is really weird Biscotti, but I'll do my best.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r3: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
item.properties|f.spiral_culet: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_a86a6d: Defeat the fabled Snarbolax that lives deep within the Gloaming Wildwoods.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_4a: The Apocrea bend reality, twisting the environment they invade into a trap. In these traps they stalk any life, harvesting their souls for some unimaginable purpose.
sprites.properties|d.magnify: Increases the reach and power of the ray of light.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_1: I'll leave the next few areas to you. They are pretty overgrown, so keep your eyes peeled for monsters in the tall grass. Some of them are pretty adept at hiding in the shadows. Gives me the creeps just thinking about it really.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_b_2a: Sure, let's head to the bazaar.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_1a: Hello there, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you will be needing a quick lesson in the species of monsters within the Clockworks that inflict piercing damage, yes?
help.properties|m.controls_chat: Press [[CHAT_START]] to enter chat or commands. Type /help into your chat window for a list of commands.
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc1: You may only rename your knight every 30 days.
guildhelp.properties|l.record_console: The Guild Record can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|f.heavy_shard_bomb: A solid chunk of depleted Crimsonite with an explosive surprise inside. Everybody loves surprises\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_techknight: Good data is like a good pudding, you can never have too much of it.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_1a: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. I have been assigned by Captain Ozlo to oversee our Clockworks mining operation. \n\nBefore you lies "the Arcade," a fascinating complex that serves as our link into the heart of the Clockworks. Since you're new here, I'll give you a quick run-down of what Spiral HQ has us doing here.
shop.properties|m.cart_recipe_learned: You have already learned this recipe\!
helptips.properties|m.loading2: Armor and helms not only offer physical defense, but can also protect you from status conditions. The right combination will greatly increase your chance of survival.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_3a: Exactly\!  So what the heck is it doing in the Clockworks now?  It just doesn't make any sense. \n\nSo, if we are to believe that indeed a lost kingdom from the past has somehow wound up in a massive, mechanical world in present day, the question remains, why?
item.properties|f.divine_avenger: An upgraded Avenger forged from the purest sun steel. There are few foes remaining in this world that are worthy enough to be defeated by such a fine blade, and there are still fewer heroes worthy of wielding it.
mission.properties|b.becoming_champion: Having heard of your many accomplishments and successful missions completed for Spiral HQ, Lieutenant Feron would like to speak with you.
item.properties|f.tri_guard_helm: A special helmet designed specifically for knights on first recon of alien planets. This rugged helmet protects against a variety of harsh elements.
item.properties|e.not_use_snow_bucket: Can't use this item now. It can only be used in town or in a guild hall. There can only be 10 in use at once.
exchange.properties|m.steam_overlay_disa: The Steam overlay must be enabled in order to purchase energy.  Please ensure that "Enable Steam Community In-Game" is checked in the Steam "In-Game" settings, then restart the game.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_5a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!
mission.properties|o.p_r3_mat_01: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok: You are eligible for this mission.
conversation.properties|m.gh_bechamel_2: Please examine the statue previews carefully\!  I sometimes have trouble fashioning some accessories, like auras and special items, into statue form.  There are no refunds, so be sure you like what you see before purchasing\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_warning_1a: Up these stairs lies the gate to Haven. Be sure to talk to Virgil before you enter so you know what to expect.
item.properties|f.twisted_spine_cone: An enhanced Spine Cone that will thrash opponents with thorns and bury them in brambles.
item.properties|f.heavy_deconstructor: An upgraded Deconstructor that will wreck robots and crush constructs in a wider area.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_zip: Please check that the ZIP or postal code is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4b: Skill points are gained regularly as a sprite levels up. They can be applied to skills within the battle sprite interface. \n\nWhen applying a skill point, you must choose an augment to increase, such as the cooldown rate or overall damage.
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_helm: A helm for those who want to bring down some beasts.
guildhelp.properties|m.design_info: Design Mode allows a guild member of sufficient rank to rearrange the furniture and other infrastructure within a Guild Hall. Once in Design Mode, furniture items can be picked up and put back down again much like a Gold Key or Heavy Statue, and by default they can be rotated while held by using the Mouse Wheel. When you are happy with your rearranging, you can Publish your changes from the Command Console and make them visible to the rest of your guild.
helptips.properties|m.atg_healthcap: Use HEALTH CAPSULES from your quickslot bar to heal.
mission.properties|m.intro_expansion: Expansion Missions are special missions that must be unlocked in order to access. Completing Expansion Missions earns you exclusive rewards\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_2a:
Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

You are receiving this mail as a result of an incorrect/cryptic entry in your recent resource allocation request.  Please provide a detailed summary of your projected use of the following requested resources\: 
- 999 'Open minded' devilites 
- 50 barrels of 'whatever frostifurs eat' 
- A 'towering pillar' of everfrost and 'all the frozen souls it brings forth'
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: Spiral HQ wants us to haul these minerals back up to Haven.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Euclid volunteered to help The Sleeper. I'm sure he's in here somewhere battling The Swarm even as we speak. As for Rulen...Vaelyn I'm sorry. He disappeared shortly after Euclid made his decision. I haven't been able to find him ever since.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
projectx.properties|m.please_relaunch: Please quit and re-run the game to check your new options.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Scraith, first to scale the walls of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks.
mission.properties|r.search_continues_1a: Thank you, Lieutenant. Any more information with regard to the Alpha Squad?
arena.properties|m.revive_desc: Use a Spark of Life to revive early and gain an edge in battle.
helptips.properties|m.atg_ublocks: Some blocks cannot be destroyed by normal attacks.
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_subject: Krogmo Coins earned in The Coliseum\!
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_2:
It was those blasted cloaking fiends\! They came from the shadows and staged an ambush.   When I get my hands on Seerus I'll... Argh\! 

(Feron slumps to one side, clearly more injured than he initially appeared) 

Blast, I'm having trouble gripping my sword...
item.properties|f.armor_back: An accessory that can be attached to the back of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
auction.properties|m.start_recipe: Select a learned recipe to search for the ingredients.
mission.properties|m.elemental_my_dear_2: Excellent, then we're 'off to the races' as they say.  Elemental damage is generally caused by energy based attacks that are comprised of anything from photon-based laser fire to arcane energy manipulation.
social.properties|m.earned_prestige: become the Most Prestigious, having earned {0} prestige in the past 7 days\!
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r6: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: The rest of us thought we weren't going to make it. But then...then the light surrounded us and we were safe. We've taken to calling it The Sleeper. We aren't sure what it is exactly, but it needs our help. This world was created to protect it but somehow The Swarm breached the Core and has been feeding on the energy and growing like a leech ever since.
exchange.properties|m.fee: For every trade, the energy seller pays the {0}% trading fee from the crowns.
item.properties|f.rocket_sprocket: A sturdy sprocket used by machines that fire projectiles.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_blu: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits a blue glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.gram: An extraordinarily heavy sword whose weight will slow down even the swiftest of knights. That said, just imagine what it'll do to anything you hit with it...
item.properties|f.ice_queen_crown: A regal crown resembling that of the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1b: What services can I find here? (Follow Tylen)

mission.properties|b.oilers_in_boilers:
A boiler room beneath Moorcroft Manor has been overrun by a legion of oily slimes known as 'oilers' that seem to enjoy fiery conditions.  This could prove disastrous for any levels in close proximity should the slimes enter the boilers and cause an explosion. 

Moorcroft Manor serves as an invaluable connection point into Tier 2 and its departed residents have been the most gracious of hosts.  It is in Spiral HQ's best interest to send a squad in to deal with the smoldering slimes before they create a firestorm that seals off our access to Tier 2. 

It is up to you to locate the oilers and remove them from the boilers\!

support.properties|m.subheader_step209:
Sometimes we make a mistake when trading with players. This happens to all of us.

But Game Masters can't know what the agreement with the trade was. One player could claim this wasn't what was agreed on, while the other could claim it was. And we can't just blindly pick a side. So we have to rely on players double checking what they're trading before they click to confirm.

So if you just made a trade you didn't really mean to, then I'm afraid Game Masters won't be able to assist you. Instead you'll want to talk to the other player and see if the player is nice enough to reverse the trade.

Also remember never to trade anything away "as a loan" unless you are OK with this player not returning the item. Game Masters won't be able to recover it for you.

mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
item.properties|f.woven_sentinel_helm: A helm imbued with interwoven wolver hair to protect against even the harshest elements.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro4_1a: I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp to the north. \n\nAnd should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_plate_shield: A superior shield imbued with the elemental essence of flame. It is so resistant to high temperatures that it's a mystery how exactly it was forged in the first place.
item.properties|f.iron_dragon_helm: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Iron Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_a: Last night terrible monsters attacked us in the darkness.  It was utter chaos. With no power for the turrets we couldn't defend ourselves. \n\nSo many brave Knights lost...
item.properties|f.chaos_cloak: A forbidden mantle said to grant the wearer protection within the nameless realm where all elements are said to converge into one and divide into all.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok_replay: You are eligible to replay this mission.
item.properties|f.gh_env_embers: An environment that fills your Guild Hall with falling ash and soot as if Vog himself had passed through.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_4a: I'd like to help however I can.  Where is Spiral HQ now located?
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Get inside, use the elevator...blow up whatever is controlling those cannons\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_treasure: Treasure blocks are always a lucky find\! They contain coins and useful items.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_d: I have to keep these new recruits out of trouble.
conversation.properties|r.emberlight_vis: Why is King Tinkinzar trying to destroy Haven?
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_1a: {0}\! Am I glad to see you\!  This place is so alien, I'm happy to see a familiar face and not another hostile.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_3a: When our technicians finally got the Skylark's communications systems online, we could not establish a link with the Alpha Squad and they have never been heard from since. Their channel is completely dead. \n\nTheir dead line is what has us all scratching our heads.  Our comlinks are built to withstand all manners of extreme conditions, even explosions.  Heck, they survived the Skylark going down after all.  There's nothing I can think of that could kill the link completely.
item.properties|f.dangerous_draped_armor: Loose-fitting armor worn by more experienced Recon Rangers. It's rumored that gear like this is crafted from the remains of armor from Rangers who fell in combat, acting as a reminder to the wearer that they are always within Death's embrace.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_pur: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits a purple glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.jelly_helm: Gelatinous headgear made from gooey guardians.
guild.properties|m.too_many_members: Your guild cannot have more than {0} members. \nUpgrades to your member limit may be purchased in the shop in your guild hall.
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_compl: This will greatly aid me, thank you.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Amazing...I never thought I'd see another one of us ever again\! I'm glad to see you made it here safely.
item.properties|f.iron_gear: A metal gear that was once a component of a complicated contraption.
projectx.properties|e.no_node_found: Could not enter instance. Please try again later.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_1a: How do sprites level up and evolve?
mission.properties|m.tortodrone_1a:
[All] Important Employee Reminder\: 

An ID Card is required to access the staging area. Properly presenting the ID Card will consume it to power the Grim Gate. Remember\: "When you Use it, you Lose it." 

ID Cards not used in this manner ("lost, broken, or misplaced") will need to be reissued by HR. The cost for a card replacement will be deducted from your next paycheck and a black mark will be added to your employee file. Don't let this happen to you. Don't lose your ID Card. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp
conversation.properties|m.tier_1_require: Well met, {0}.  In order to proceed and explore deeper depths of the Clockworks you must first achieve Rank 4-2. \n\nReturn here once you have completed the requisite Rank Missions.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_1a: Congratulations {0}\!  Knight Elite huh?  Wow, you must be proud\!
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
mission.properties|m.anniversary_end_1:
{0}\! You did it\!  I've got my kitchen back\! 

Remember, you can exchange the Cake Slices you receive for awesome cake helms from Maskwell in the Haven Town Square. It's just like that old baker's saying, 'Wear the hide of your fallen foes to prove your might as a warrior\!' 

Ok, maybe I just say that.
item.properties|f.trinket_slot_upgrade: Once used, this upgrade opens a trinket slot for {0} days.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
mission.properties|b.elemental_my_dear: Biotech Hahn has agreed to inform you about the monsters in the Clockworks that inflict elemental damage.  Contact him via comlink and hear what he has to say.
chat.properties|m.usage_move: Usage\: /{0} x y\nMove to the (x, y) coordinates.
item.properties|f.deadly_shard_bomb: A large chunk of Crimsonite primed with a potent explosive. No more depleted Crimsonite here\: this bomb's made with the good stuff\! Or the bad stuff, if you happen to be the target.
item.properties|f.token_primal: A small wisp of the essential spirit of nature. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
item.properties|f.swimsuit_trunks: A pair of spiral issue trunks intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_1: This all sounds really strange, but I'm happy to help if I can.
conversation.properties|r.mon_pocket_2: Thanks Nonna, but maybe next time.
chat.properties|m.unknown_item: Unknown equipment {0}. Use /help level to list equipment.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_1: Hello. I'm Wegner, Chief Geo Knight of the Skylark and head of geological studies within the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.confetti_dark_harvest_: Celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival by launching a sizeable gourd into the air. What comes next is up to the Punkin King...
mission.properties|b.crimson_chaos: Spiral HQ has been monitoring several known Crimson Order bases in hopes of intercepting one of their elusive high-ranking members. Recon knights assigned to watch one of those bases report that it has suddenly gone silent and have requested backup before investigating it further. Head down to their location and investigate the base for any signs of what has happened.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: Don't mind Hubert, he's been de-spiked.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_1a: Thanks for your help earlier. Stay safe\!
pvp.properties|m.playagain_team.1: 1 guildmate is needed for a {1} team.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Hey\!  I hear you're the one bringin' in all these spikes?
item.properties|f.meteor_mote: A small piece of a rare material that is said to have fallen from the sky. Gremlins typically use it in the construction of power sources.
item.properties|f.padded_cap: A one size fits all light helm that is typically worn by gunslingers.
mission.properties|o.the_collector: Save the sprites and the researchers from the Collector
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_3: Truly you are among the greatest of all warriors who have ever lived\! The bounties of the Arena King are yours for the taking\!
item.properties|f.nog_blaster: One highly volatile chamber full of creamy, high-cholesterol cheer that when fired really packs a punch.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.mighty_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you can feel the berserk energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_5a: We discovered a town known as 'Haven' and have set up a base of operations there. The locals have provided us with food, shelter and power.  It's not Isora, but it's home for now. \n\nI've pinpointed your location.  Unfortunately you'll need to cross a massive chasm in order to reach Haven.  Perhaps now that your camp has power there is an elevator somewhere leading into the Clockworks.  You may just be able to reach us that way.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_2a: But that tome suggested Almire was destroyed over a thousand years ago...
dungeon.properties|m.tutorial_b: The Crash Site|Waking in a New World
item.properties|f.honor_shield_1: A ceremonial shield issued to Spiral Knight recruits. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.fowl_cowl: A beaked mask shrouded in a simple hood. Take on the guise of your feathered friends and celebrate the new year.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_4a: Accept my mission and let's get to work blowing some stuff up\!
item.properties|f.mighty_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you can feel the unstable energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_1a:
(You see the lost soul of Almire standing before you.  In his face you see a profound sadness.  Staring beyond you he begins to speak without introduction.) 

Lord Vanaduke brought the fire from the mountains to our kingdom.  Everything burned.  His enemies.  Even his family. 

My family was lost too.  I fled the battle as soon as I saw the wave of flames in the distance.  I was able to reach my home just in time to see it burn.  I don't even remember how it ended.  I have no memory of my passing.
item.properties|f.reset_star: A special sprite food that resets applied skill points and reverts any ultimate skill selection.
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_blade: A mythical blade that lashes out with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. Those who wield it claim to feel the fiery stare of the beast upon them whenever they close their eyes.
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_1a: We meet again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has asked me to introduce you to some advanced alchemy.  Don't worry, this won't take long.  I've got an old mecha knight to work on anyway.
item.properties|f.plated_sentinel_helm: A helm reinforced with gremlin plating to defend against a range of dangerous elements.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: That's fine, just talk to me again when you are ready to choose.
monster.properties|m.promotion_3: I admire your ability to promote synergy.
item.properties|f.supply_pack_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This compact pack has enough supplies to last a single Knight one week.

item.properties|f.silvermail: Strong, yet light armor for knights who've sworn an oath to hunt down and destroy the undead, wherever it may lurk.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_5a: In the mean time we'll run an analysis on that strange device you found in the Royal Jelly Palace. If it is related to the Artifact, we'll find out soon enough\! \n\nGood luck, {0}.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_2: During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of fiend and undead family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'best free lecture yet' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
guild.properties|log.env_changed: Changed the environment to {0} for {1} crowns, replacing {2}.
helptips.properties|m.loading4: Rare monsters offering unique items roam the Clockworks. Have you discovered any yet?
item.properties|f.irontech_bomb: A heavy bomb wrapped in thick iron plates. Though it is slower than most bombs, it packs a powerful punch.
dungeon.properties|m.cogmaster_castle_de: Calling all knights\!  Spiral HQ has launched a full-scale assault on the heavily fortified castle of Warmaster Seerus, a devious gremlin of the Crimson Order. All attacks against the sturdy walls and destructive artillery have failed - Spiral HQ needs YOU to turn the tide of the battle and take the fight to the Warmaster himself\!
mission.properties|b.shopping_again_b: Now it's time to learn about some of the more advanced services the Bazaar offers.  Follow knight Bechamel and pay a visit to Punch and Vise, Brinks and even visit Bechamel's own shop\!
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_5a: Thank you Kora, I'll try to find a way across the chasm to Haven.
item.properties|f.prize_box_gremlin: Contains various unique costumes and items crafted by Gremlins. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Spikes go in. Flying razor disks of barely-understood primordial energy come hurtling out\!
mission.properties|r.alchemy_beginners_9: I think I've got it, thanks\!
item.properties|f.fiery_diskgun: A handgun powered by an infernal engine that launches molten disks in rapid succession. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_helm: A finely-made helmet for the more discerning explosives expert. It won't tell you what kind of wine goes best with Nitronome, but it'll certainly keep your head looking good. And in one piece.
mission.properties|m.intro_expansion_loc: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Expansion Missions\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: Sprites have a set appetite that limits the amount of materials they can eat at any one given time. When you feed a material to your sprite, its appetite will deplete. Once fully depleted, you will be unable to feed it.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_8a: Perhaps gremlins are trying to steal our technology?
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Very good, {0}. You will find a new set of missions for you under Operations. These new missions will be grouped according to their overall objective and can be tackled in parallel to each other. This should allow you maximum flexibility in order to respond to each new threat as they come up. Farewell, {0}, 'Guardian of Cradle'.
item.properties|f.shockburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of lightning.
guildhelp.properties|l.design_console: Design Mode can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|d.furni_lay: USE\: Have a quick lie down.
item.properties|f.warm_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns strong enough that it feels warm to the touch.
item.properties|f.jaws_megalodon: A fearsome helm made to resemble a deep sea monster.
item.properties|f.graviton_charge: A small explosive charge with mysterious origins. It is capable of generating a vortex of crushing gravity.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_snipe: A quietly resting snipe that will stay where it's placed.
mission.properties|m.ancient_generator_1: What do we have here, more little creatures that came from the sky?  Here to take my power and disturb my research? \n\nNo one disrupts the work of the great Schemer Razwog\!  I'll see to it you never leave this room alive\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_4a: Uh, I think these sprites are studying these old books. I didn't even know they could read\! \n\nAnyway, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. I see more empty transport crates; not good. You go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_b_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm Bechamel, and I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
item.properties|f.sweet_dreams: Don't be fooled by this weapon's fluffy exterior. It hits much harder than it looks. The perfect weapon for fighting things that go bump in the night.
helptips.properties|m.tut_goldkey: Pick up and use on Gold Doors\!
item.properties|f.royal_core: A sweet-smelling lump of ooze collected from a particularly noble specimen of slime.
logon.properties|m.steam_invalid_ticket: Invalid Steam UserID Ticket. Try logging out, quitting Steam completely and trying again.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_coba: Well met, {0}.  I'm Jorin, a knight who has mastered the standard issue Spiral Knight gear.  The recipes I have for you produce very reliable weapons and gear. \n\nJust because your weapons don't output fancy special damage types or your armor defends from status conditions doesn't mean you can't shake it in the Clockworks.  The gear I specialize in is good for just about any situation.  It will keep you alive and packs a punch on almost any monster that comes your way.
item.properties|f.box_elite_trinket: Contains various elite, five-star trinkets and a Trinket Slot Upgrade. Items are randomly chosen. No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_5: Each item will require a specific type of Fire Crystal.  Fire Crystals can be obtained from the Supply Depot, earned by completing certain missions, and found in treasure blocks in the Clockworks\!
helptips.properties|m.loading0: The basic play controls can be viewed at any time by pressing [[TOGGLE_HELP]].
projectx.properties|m.cross_the_chasm: Cross the chasm to reach Haven.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_sword: This calloused carving crusher cascades fury upon fatigued foes.
pvp.properties|m.start_delayed: Your {0} game has been delayed. Waiting for more players...
item.properties|f.fusion_blaster: An enhanced elemental blaster designed to banish creatures that lurk in the shadows.
mission.properties|b.go_shopping: The Haven Bazaar is a place where all manners of item-related goods and services can be found.  Whether you're in the market for a more powerful sword or just want to make your armor stand out in a crowd, it's got what you need\!
sprites.properties|d.caustic_quills: Fires a series of quills that stick to targets and inflict poison. For each hit a quilled target receives, they lose one quill and take additional damage.
item.properties|f.indestructible_giftwra: Presents wrapped with this Grinchlin gag can never be opened again. Leave it to Grinchlins to ruin complimentary gift wrapping services for everyone.
town.properties|m.haven_desc: A peaceful town that is home to the Strangers. These salvagers offer the Spiral Knights sanctuary in return for the treasures that they acquire while investigating the Clockworks. Haven is also heavily populated with snipes, bulbous little birds with a curious means of locomotion.
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_2a:
An excerpt from the accounts of Lord Brandell, High Chancellor of Almire\: 

Like so many of its people, Law and Order have fled Almire.  Only Justice remains, but she too has been twisted by the cursed flames that ravage our kingdom.  Justice is now the burning scepter of our once great Lord Vanaduke.  Justice is swift, unflinching, merciless. 

My position has afforded me much in my life.  I used to love the view that my tower offers. From these lofty heights I thought of myself as the first one to greet the spring season, the first to smell the life in the air as the flowers bloomed.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_7a: (You sense great pride coming from the fallen knight, but he says no more and stares off into the distance towards a lifetime that only he sees.)
item.properties|f.gm_helmet: An impressive indigo helmet that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
social.properties|m.befriend_message: Enter an optional message to include with your friend request\:
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium perfect for pondering over many a quaint and curious volume of forgotten lore.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_3a: Great, thanks for being a good ambassador\! \n\nLastly I need to get you up to speed on something called 'energy.'  It's very important to your mission here on Cradle.
mission.properties|b.skies_under_cradle: The Clockworks are a fascinating underground complex that houses entire worlds within its colossal, iron geo-globes.  One of them that recon knights have discovered is known as the 'Aurora Isles,' a series of mysterious floating islands under a false sky. \n\nAs a newly ranked Apprentice, you now have clearance to explore the ruins within these islands and collect any useful materials you may discover.
item.properties|f.black_kat_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a shadowy sapper of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
guild.properties|i.console_publish: Publish design changes to the Guild Hall.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_15: I'd like to see the shops. (Follow Tylen)
item.properties|f.blaster: A versatile handgun issued to Spiral Knights who have proven themselves in the field.
sprites.properties|d.explosive_firestorm: Creates a series of explosions when unleashing the firestorm.
pvp.properties|m.coins_earned.n: You have earned {0} Krogmo Coins playing {1}\!
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the fiery drakon, battle sprite of those who prefer frontline, destructive combat? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
mission.properties|b.king_of_ashes:
Within the ever-burning depths of the Firestorm Citadel, Lord Vanaduke lies in wait for any living being to pass into his accursed kingdom.  Any squad that has ever attempted to infiltrate the citadel has perished or was simply lost, like the countless lost souls bound to this terrible realm. 

Lord Vanaduke is ready for war, believing in his twisted mind that any who dare enter the citadel to be an invading force bent on overtaking his kingdom.  He stands as the last obstacle before gaining access to the Core and the Spiral Knights having any chance of restoring the Skylark and returning home. 

As a Champion of the Spiral Knights, you alone have what it takes to lead a team into the very heart of this inferno and face the titanic might of Lord Vanaduke.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_1a: {0}, I cannot thank you enough.  We've already established our research base and are collecting a tremendous amount of data that we would have never had without your efforts.
item.properties|f.ultra_poison_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_1: SITUATION RESOLVED. PLEASE EXIT THE FACILITY.
item.properties|f.grave_soil: Dreadful dirt dredged from a creepy crypt. It is always a little cold to the touch.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The maskeraith sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: What are you doing\!? My cakes\! My pretty cakes\! Unacceptable\!
item.properties|f.storm_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe created the world in its passing\: its fire the sun, its bones the mountains.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.umbral_blaster: An enhanced shadow blaster designed to neutralize alien bioforms.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_5a: It would seem so.  And this place, it just radiates evil, it's almost indescribable.  It's even starting to affect the levels surrounding it- fires are breaking out everywhere. \n\nYou're one of the best we've got, {0} and if there's anyone that could lead a squad through the citadel it's you.  But even reaching it won't be easy.  We're going to need to take care of a few fires and gather a bit more intel before storming the gates.
item.properties|f.grim_repeater: Used only by the most elite of the Spiral Knight rangers, this devilish machine gun earned its name from the incredible speed in which it hands out shadowy tickets to the afterlife.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I'm either here celebrating or downing my sorrows.
arena.properties|m.chat_all: Spectators may now chat with players.
conversation.properties|m.gh_bechamel_1: Greetings {0}, what can I help you with?
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Hello {0}, I'm Remi, a knight who specializes in bombs and explosives.  The recipes I have for you are pretty straightforward- producing weapons and gear that focus on blowing up your enemies to smithereens\! \n\nUsing bombs isn't a fire and forget kind of affair though.  Bombs require an understanding of timing, both before and after you drop one, in order to get the most bang for your buck.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad sends in to take down many enemies at once.  Bombs are great for clearing out a mob of beasties in one swift KA-BOOM\!
exchange.properties|m.billing_error: Your payment could not be processed due to a stray snipe in the gears. Fear not\! Your card has not been charged, and maintenance gremlins have been dispatched to repair the problem. Please try again later.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_1: Head into the room ahead with the party pad. You're almost done.
guildhelp.properties|m.guild_hall_info:
The Guild Hall is the nerve center for any Spiral Knights guild. Here, guild members can relax, plan future missions, and take advantage of the various Guild Hall amenities at their disposal. The Guild Hall is extremely customizable, and can be expanded to fit guilds of all sizes. It can also contain a wide variety of unique furniture and room types, so coordinate with your friends to make your Guild Hall a true reflection of your guild\!
 When a Guild Hall is first opened, it consists of two rooms\: a lobby, and the Command Console room. Guilds wishing for more space to customize can purchase expansions to increase the base size of their guild hall. These are available from the Command Console while in Design Mode.
 Guilds that have expanded the usable space in their Hall can fill that space with a variety of different rooms, available for purchase from the Birdsong Emporium. These rooms can be as simple as an empty room for placing furniture, or they can contain one of a number of different guild amenities, such as alchemy terminals, shops and more\!
 Guild Halls require a large amount of resources to maintain, which is represented by a weekly upkeep cost in Crowns. As a Guild Hall gains more expansions, this cost increases, so make sure there's enough Crowns in your Guild Treasury to pay for everything\!
item.properties|f.gh_theme_fire: A fiery theme that's sure to keep your Guild Hall warm and toasty... or sweaty.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_mastery_1a: I could always use a good sword.
uplink.properties|m.ironclaw_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we have intercepted gremlin transmissions from this facility that indicate they are building some kind of weapon to destroy Haven\!  It is your mission to infiltrate the facility, destroy this weapon and save Haven from destruction\! 

Known only as 'Project Roarmulus,' it is said to be impenetrable from standard attacks.  You will have to find a way to break whatever armor it is using.  Intel suggests this weapon is located deep within the facility. 

But getting to it won't be easy.  You will find that gremlins have little care for a safe work environment as live rockets seem to be fired every which way at all times.  However you should be able to utilize the 'polarity walls' you will find in testing environments to block the oncoming rockets.  Look for a purple and gold switch to toggle them. 

We've also detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad somewhere in this factory.  Retrieve it if you can\! 

Good luck\!
projectx.properties|e.name_vulgar: Sorry, that name contains an inappropriate word. Please try another.
helptips.properties|m.atg_togswitch: Switches can open AND close doors.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_welcome: Welcome back to the Training Grounds. This last level will teach you the last few important things you will need to know as an explorer of the Clockworks. Head up the ramp and let's begin\!
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
item.properties|f.sacred_sentinel_helm: A radiant defending doubleweave for insulating against erratic elements.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_3: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap.\n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_a: We may not have power, but the least I can do is get a fire going to provide a little light tonight.
item.properties|f.plasma_cell: A high-tech plasma source that could positively blind someone with science.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_danger: The Grinchlins have sabotaged Winterfest for the last time. Take the fight to them\!
helptips.properties|m.terminal_1: Welcome traveler, this is a Clockwork Terminal. Take a moment to rest and change your gear. \n\nUse the elevator either to return to Haven or delve into a more dangerous stratum of the Clockworks.

- Every Gremlin must remain LOYAL to King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. The Iron Law must be obeyed\!

helptips.properties|t.tg1_overgrown_1: See you on the other side

social.properties|m.autofriend_single: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! You have automatically been made friends.
item.properties|f.coliseum_room: A lively room featuring a Coliseum ticket booth, a Coliseum Rewards Supervisor, and a Krogmo Alchemy Machine.
item.properties|f.super_slime_slasher: A shovel with a wicked edge that's especially well-suited to fighting slimes in the trenches.

item.properties|f.power_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_6a: I'd like you to give me the tour once more.

mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We don't know for sure but it has to be related to the Artifact. The energy signatures are identical. If the Artifact is involved that means...
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: Tell me about the other battle sprites.
pvp.properties|m.no_reward: You have dishonored my great Coliseum with your lack of fighting spirit\!  You shall receive no Krogmo Coins and no rank points\!
item.properties|f.spiral_crescent_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.owlite_wand: They say the wand chooses the wizard, so don't let this one see your cute friend.
mission.properties|r.another_trace_3a: You can count on me, Kora.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.

item.properties|f.firecracker: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of fire upon detonation.

mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_6a: Once again these sprites seem to have adapted their form to suit their surrounding environment.
item.properties|f.vial_fire: A glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
item.properties|f.sacred_hex_armor: A phantasmal suit of armor for those who are aiming for the infernal.
item.properties|f.blizzbreaker_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at shrugging off the coldest of shoulders. It's not bad at resisting freeze attacks, either.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_311da7: Hit the Whammie playing the Golden Prize Wheel.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_3: These shelters will offer you two choices\: exit the mountain and claim some Grinchlin treasure, or press on further up the mountain. \n\nShould you press on, you pass on the loot in that shelter, but will find even more treasures at the next shelter.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_b_: I'll be sure to say hello when I see a Stranger.
global.properties|m.disconnected: You have been disconnected from the server.
item.properties|f.angelic_helmet: A beautiful costume designed exclusively for great heads.
helptips.properties|m.danger_module: Warning\! The path beyond this point is far more dangerous than what you would expect on this level. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!
support.properties|m.subheader_step206:
Revealing personal information is not acceptable, whether it is their own or another player's. Asking for personal information is not acceptable either.

Asking people how old they are or what grade they're in or what sorts of sports they do etc. is not considered personal.

But things like phone numbers or address or real name are personal information and should never be revealed.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_2: Such bravery, such pluck\! Yes, perhaps with some luck you stand a chance against the terrible fiends that mean to destroy Winterfest dreams. \n\nSo note the addition of a Winterfest mission, take up your sword and I will grant you rewards\!
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_return_des: A level where travelers can safely return to the town above.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_4a: Vatel here will sell you a selection of recipes as well as personal color changers and other items.
helptips.properties|m.tut_explosive: Explosive blocks will harm anything around them when they are set off. This includes you\! Take them out from a safe distance with your handgun.
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_2a: (Tell Kora about the Ancient Generator, Razwog and the mysterious Artifact.)
conversation.properties|m.hunter_1a:
Hello there my good Knight, I am Armero, great hunter of the wilds and curator of this prestigious lodge you see before you. 

On the walls are some of the many trophies claimed from many courageous expeditions, where life and limb were put on the line in order to experience the pure, untamed thrill of the hunt. 

Now I say, do you have the same spark within you? The same taste for the open air, for danger?
item.properties|f.phantamos: A powerful handgun brimming with dark energy. The Phantamos represents one of the most recent additions to the Spiral Knight's arsenal, as containing shadow energy of this degree took a great deal of research.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5a: I'd like to go over your energy tutorial one more time.

conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_f: Where is the safety on this thing?
item.properties|f.everfrost: A small patch of ice crystals that never seem to melt, even when exposed to direct heat.
item.properties|f.deadly_charcoaler: This gallant grill is guaranteed to char your competition.
mission.properties|b.work_idle_hands:
Devilites are a type of fiend that seem to have a very rigid corporate structure that governs their every action.  Recon Knights have discovered a series of devilite 'offices' throughout the Clockworks, typically found in the remains of an alien city. 

Analysis of the data collected from these offices indicates that devilite corporations are outsourced by gremlins in order to design and manage various projects that include weapons specifically engineered to target Spiral Knight squads. 

It's time these devilites were issued pink slips and their fiendish projects cancelled.
conversation.properties|m.npc_rummagekni: I know it was here somewhere...
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_1: Rhendon is waiting for you in an area of the Clockworks known as the Sunset Steppes where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites.  Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles.  You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_heav: Hello {0}, I'm Izola, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad guardian.  The recipes I have for you produce highly defensive armor and hard-hitting weapons. \n\nHeavy weapons require precise timing to use effectively and the gear tends to slow you down some.  But what you sacrifice in usability is returned in sheer power.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad can depend upon to stay alive and face even the fiercest of monsters.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: I can already feel the frost fading.
item.properties|f.hazardous_draped_armor: Loose-fitting armor worn by more experienced Scarlet Scouts. It's rumored that gear like this is crafted from the remains of armor from Scouts who fell in combat, acting as a reminder that unless necessary Scouts never leave a man behind.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikedata_: What might the gremlins be doing with all of these spikes?
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_1a: Listen up, Rangers\!  Grab your scarves and sharpened swords because where we're going isn't going to include a warm welcome\!  Our scouts report that Amu-Sol is a frozen wasteland filled with fiends and hungry beasts.  This fiendish city seems to be spreading its icy chill throughout the Clockworks and if we don't get in there and figure out why, it's going to be a long winter here on Cradle. \n\nLet's ride, Rangers\!
item.properties|f.heavy_gear: A weighted gear that previously assisted in the operation of an enormous machine.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
item.properties|f.harlequin_suit: A costume for those who juggle, tumble, or have the gift of mischief.
item.properties|f.authentic_mask: A high quality {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's very well made and lasts forever\!
item.properties|f.grey_owlite_shield: A resplendent replica of the shield thought to have been issued to the most eminent of Owlite wizards. Wielding it fills you with righteous vengeance.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: Click here to accept the listed trade, and buy crowns with energy.
chat.properties|m.ident_set: Your forum identity has been set to this knight.
