item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: A liberated set of schematics showing off the complete spec and scale of Project Roarmulus.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_a4e946: Pay a visit to Moorcraft Manor.
item.properties|f.light_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
chat.properties|m.usage_spawn: Usage\: /{0} name attr value attr value...\nSpawns an actor in the scene.
item.properties|f.snarbolax_coat: A shadowy suit made from the hide of a sinister Snarbolax.  Even looking at it too closely is dangerous.
item.properties|f.confetti_summer: When thrown, this summer confetti makes you feel all warm inside.
item.properties|f.toxic_needle: An Autogun modified to fire piercing bolts dosed with a wicked poison.
item.properties|f.forbidden_fruit: A sinful snack favored by famished fiends.
mission.properties|b.first_contact: You have escaped your crash pod and reached a Rescue Camp just as the sun set across the alien landscape.  Using your comlink, it is now time to establish contact with Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.replica_mask: A plastic {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's not well made and eventually falls apart.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_3a: I sometimes find dark matter mineral deposits in the Clockworks, perhaps-
item.properties|f.ultra_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
projectx.properties|m.mission_fc: Recover the recon module in the Firestorm Citadel.
conversation.properties|m.fc_greeter_1: Heed my warning traveler; this is a dangerous and terrible realm. You stand before the gates of the Firestorm Citadel, the former heart of the great kingdom of Almire, now a dominion twisted by fire and malice.\n\nLeave this place if you want to live.
item.properties|f.irontech_destroyer: The big brother of the Irontech Bomb, the Destroyer unleashes the full potential of irontech power.
item.properties|f.iron_wolf_coat: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rose_regalia: Contains various unique Rose Regalia costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
helptips.properties|m.tut_buttons: Not all buttons are in plain sight. Have a look around\! They are sometimes hidden under blocks.
support.properties|m.option_201_1: If you're convinced this qualified as spamming then click OK to file the complaint.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_2: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a more stable version that blew up gremlin test subjects far fewer times than the prototype.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_8a: Pah\!  I am no mere gremlin.  I am the thousand eyes that watch you in the darkness.  I am the hissing blade that whispers your doom.  Tear down every wall and cog in this accursed place and you will find only shadows. \n\nI cannot be stopped by the likes of you\!  Hsst\!
guild.properties|l.gl_save_progress: Saving guild log to the desktop...
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_4a: We need you to explore the surrounding levels and collect any intel you can.  You can start with an Owlite castle of some sort that recently surfaced near this anomaly.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_2a:
In short, this camp has no power and the sun is setting soon. Last night all manners of horrible monsters came after us in the dark.  We couldn't see and had no power for our defensive turrets. 

...we lost a lot of recruits. 

We need to channel power to the Rescue Camp so that we can set up a defensive perimeter before night falls\!
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_9a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_pplate: Pick up and place a STATUE on a PRESSURE PLATE to keep doors open.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_bc04ed: Earn clearance to explore Tier 2 of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.volatile_catalyzer: Removing the safety overrides from a piece of Gremlin technology is a good way to lose a limb. In this case, it probably won't be one of yours. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of luminite.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_6a: On the east side we have a couple of combat practice rooms. These Training Cubes are mostly harmless and are perfect for experimenting with your weapons and shield techniques\!
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_4a: Thanks, {0}.  I thought we were done for back there. \n\nLet's get the artifact back to Spiral HQ before someone else tries to nab it.
mission.properties|b.sovereign_slime:
The source of the strange energy signature is believed to be located somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace, the home to one of the members of the slime aristocracy, the Royal Jelly. 

The might of these sovereign slimes is not to be underestimated.  Should you find yourself facing this hot-tempered highborn, you would be wise to be equipped with the appropriate gear and backed by a full squad of experienced knights. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with pierce resistant gear and shadow damage weapons before deploying for the Royal Jelly Palace\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_shield_1: Let's get one essential survival tool out of the way right now- your shield. Hold [[DEFEND]] to defend with your shield. While defending you will completely withstand most damage from all sides. The gun puppies in the next hallway shouldn't be a problem to get past so long as you defend as you run through.
sprites.properties|d.iron_heart_attack: Targets destroyed while enchanted may also drop defense orbs.
item.properties|f.obsidian_edge: A sinister sword made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. Simply holding it makes you somehow feel guilty of an unknown crime.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight7_1a: Initial readings are off the charts, {0}\!  We've never encountered anything like this before.  It will take some time to fully understand what this object is used for.
helptips.properties|m.tut_weapons: You can cycle between equipped weapons with [[NEXT_WEAPON]]. Try equipping your handgun.
item.properties|f.prize_box_frenzy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_3: In order to venture even deeper within the Clockworks you must visit the Hall of Heroes and speak to Lieutenant Barrus to receive your 4 Star Certification.
conversation.properties|r.arc_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
mission.properties|r.pioneers_11a: I'll do my best to recover the recon module and destroy the Snarbolax\!
support.properties|m.request_updated_mai: Your support request regarding {0} has been updated.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: An elegant display commemorating a knight's promotion to the rank of Champion.
item.properties|f.shadowsun_slicker: An evil duster that is said to harbor a great power that feeds off of the unforgiven sins of its owners.
item.properties|f.venom_veiler: The ultimate in toxic dispersal devices, the Venom Veiler can be used to destroy pests on crops. Failing that, it can also be used to destroy crops.
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_chara: Sorry, that name contains an invalid character.
item.properties|f.cyclops_cap: A strange helm with a single, focused eye favored by junior gunners.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: Emberlight founded by gremlin outcasts from Great Colony. Gremlins of Emberlight not obey the Iron Law, so flee or die. We start over with Emberlight. New colony home to few of us\: most ex-schemers, some merchants, some fighters, all traitors in eyes of Great Colony gremlins.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r7: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.shadow_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire shadow rounds.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r3: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise: Contains a randomly chosen Prize Box in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against freeze, at the expense of fire and shock resistance.
item.properties|f.warp_dust: A light dust left behind when a creature travels at unbelievable speed. It tastes great in dip.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at deflecting the most fiery of rhetoric. It's not bad at resisting flame attacks, either.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_2: With the Biotechs' help, I should be on the mend and fit for duty again in no time.  {0}, I can't stress enough how important this victory is for all Spiral Knights.  You've helped us deal a mighty blow to the Crimson Order by destroying their Grand Arsenal. \n\nThanks to you, gremlin forces will not have any more of these massive war machines for some time. And with our Technicians studying what is available in Seerus's personal quarters we may end up gaining valuable insights into gremlin technology or even the location of the rest of the Crimson Order\!
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro_1a: Welcome to Cradle, recruit\! Always happy to see a knight survive a drop in one piece. We have a Rescue Camp not far from your position.  I'll guide you there- but ready your sword, there are hostiles on the road ahead\!\n
helptips.properties|m.loading14: Do not share your account information. Game Masters will never ask you for your password.
helptips.properties|m.atg_retraps: Some switches can reverse the direction of a trap wave. Now you can cross traps in both directions\!
item.properties|f.medieval_war_helm: A heaume sturdily built to last for a hundred years of war.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_1a: {0}\! Oh, {0} you made it\! Haha\! \n\nI am so happy you came out of there alive\!  I was worried sick about you\!
item.properties|f.black_kat_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Nappers, the undercover sleeper cell of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_4: In order to venture deep enough to reach the Core you must visit the Hall of Heroes and speak to Lieutenant Barrus to receive your 5 Star Certification.
mission.properties|o.shopping_again: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
item.properties|f.helm_front: An accessory that can be attached to the front of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.furni_block_ice: A block made of densely packed snow. It's perfect for assembling elaborate snow forts\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_3: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: I think so... we'll try and slip out when we can.\n\nOh, but be careful\! Whatever caught us is still here, guarding a large cache of our captured battle sprites. If you plan on fighting it, beware its deadly charge. Good hunting\!
item.properties|f.slime_slasher: A sturdy shovel modified to dole out a little extra damage to slime family monsters.
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_2a: Go. I will allow you to have one last moment before I destroy your meddling kind. However, should you choose to turn down my generous offer then you are welcome to come and face me in the Core where I will hasten your demise.
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: They say these minerals power every gate in the Arcade.
item.properties|f.hazardous_oni_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a fiend who lives in the mountains of a distant land. Said to guard the gate to heaven itself, it only allows those who are worthy to pass.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A jolly green plant inside a cheerful pot.
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit, another quill is fired from the target to the next available target.
uplink.properties|i.crowns: The number of crowns to attach.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: Hmm, certain combinations seem to attract different kinds of monsters.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_123: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
exchange.properties|m.paypal_tooltip: Checkout with PayPal in your browser.
guildhelp.properties|u.design_wiki: A full list of available furniture can be found on our official wiki. | URL | http\://wiki.spiralknights.com/Furniture
item.properties|f.kat_eye_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Preowa, whose artillery silenced the Grey Feather Tower Sages.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: Greetings, {0}\! Now that I've had sufficient time to research the battle sprites you rescued I can give you a proper evaluation of each. \n\nDespite their well, strange appearance, we have concluded that these 'new' battle sprites are not only suitable for combat but may have even further enhanced capabilities as a result of their transformation.
item.properties|f.spine_cone: A ferocious device that is positively bursting with briars.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.grand_flourish: A fanciful blade for those who prefer to solve their problems with a hop, a skip and a stab.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_2c: What lies at the core of the Clockworks?
pvp.properties|m.upload_wait_fs: {0}\n\n You may need to switch out of fullscreen to find it\!
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r9: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
guild.properties|e.already_withdrew: You have already withdrawn from an energy well today and must wait 24 hours.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_5a: It seemed like the world itself tried to trap you back there, what a close call\! \n\nKeep your wits about you when you go off exploring the Ancient Generator below.  If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters and rigged with traps, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
mission.properties|b.sewer_stash: It seems that the Ironclaw Munitions Factory is not the only place gremlins are storing high-powered weaponry.  Intel suggests that once manufactured, weapons are moved out of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory and stored in secret weapon caches throughout the Clockworks. \n\nOne of these caches has been uncovered in one of the Clockwork's wasteworks systems.  It's likely not going to be pretty reaching it, but eliminating the weapons stored in these wasteworks could result in far fewer casualties in the future.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_7a: Grantz was the real veteran of the bunch.  A seasoned Guardian, Grantz specialized in keeping his squad safe, namely by crushing anything that would mean to do them harm. \n\nGrantz took his Guardian's Oath very seriously, often putting himself directly in harm's way in order to protect another.  The guy was selfless.  I imagine that if disaster truly befell the Alpha Squad, Grantz didn't let it end without one hell of a fight.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r3: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_1a: Greetings, recruit.  Always good to see another knight make it to the Rescue Camp.  I imagine you're looking to prepare for your journey to Haven.  A good place to start is the gate here into the Clockworks.  Simply approach the control panel at the north end of the lift and press the action button ([[?ACTION]]).\n\nAny questions?
item.properties|f.supernova: The destruction left in the wake of this peerless pistol is anything but nebulous. Supernova shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_1a: What is this place and what are you talking about?
item.properties|f.empty_room_catwalk: An empty Guild Hall room with industrial flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
item.properties|f.boater: A stylish skimmer to sport at summer soirees.
chat.properties|m.usage_loadout: Usage\: /{0} [loadout]\nList loadouts, or equip a named loadout.
item.properties|f.advanced_cautery_sword: A Cautery Sword with an additional saw function adapted to cutting through the bony spines of larger Lichen Colonies.
item.properties|f.deadshot_mantle: A poncho for a pale rider with sights set on taking down the bad, ugly, undead denizens of the dark.
mission.properties|r.anniversary_gremlin: Biscotti asked me to come check on you.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_easy: Normal difficulty features challenges suitable for any player.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_1: Vials are one type of pickup. When thrown they release the alchemical agents within creating an elemental explosion. You can give them a try in the next room.
conversation.properties|m.atg_guard: Greetings\!  Beyond this door you will find the advanced training hall. As a Spiral Knight, you are free to use it to practice your skills and learn more about the Clockworks.
helptips.properties|m.tut_lever: Doors can often be opened by finding the right switch. Try hitting this switch with your handgun\!
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_shield: A mythical shield crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_4a: Good luck, {0}.  Be sure to thoroughly prepare before attempting this mission.
projectx.properties|e.name_too_consec: Sorry, names cannot contain the same letter in a row more than twice.
item.properties|f.prismatech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of photon-charged liquid that split on impact.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Without you?  No, I'm here to bring you back.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_experimen: Certain types of monsters seem to be attracted to different combinations of minerals found down here in the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.furni_chest_spiralfoot: A sealed locker filled with important Spiral Order equipment, like socks.
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_1a: {0}\! I hear they've selected you to save the day, eh?  Well, before you get all 'hero' on me and go marching off into the darkness below why don't you and I go head on over to the other side of the camp and teach a few of the monsters that tore up this camp last night a lesson?
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_9b: Thanks\! I'm off to train. [Complete mission]
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_expira: Please check that the expiration date is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_standar: This is a regularly scheduled maintenance reboot. It will be available as soon as possible.
item.properties|f.rocky_core: A delicious gummy treat with an impenetrable rocky shell. More than a few teeth have been lost by knights attempting to get at the gooey interior.
projectx.properties|m.head_north_arcade: Head North to the Arcade and report to Feron.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_3a: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap. \n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_2a: I've read your report of the Core, it's fascinating.  What an impossible structure and to think that the Alpha Squad might actually still be alive but... inside that thing is just incredible. \n\nI understand that Lieutenant Vaelyn has already led a team to the Core terminal and is establishing a base of operations for research.  This is of great value to all Spiral Knights and we have you to thank\!
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_2: Ok, here is the gist of it all- collect materials and recipes and turn them into weapons and gear.  Easy right?
dungeon.properties|m.graveyard_desc: A graveyard is a terrible place that simultaneously exists in the world of the living and the dead. Though they contain secret treasures in their dark corners, they are home to ancient horrors that wish to consume all who enter. Once inside, finding an exit as fast as possible is advised.
helptips.properties|m.atg_torto: Tortodrones can be found patrolling the Clockworks.  They will not attack unless attacked first - but be warned, once they are enraged, they are fearsome and deadly opponents.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_3a: A battle sprite is an AI-driven construct capable of reconnaissance and light combat support.  Battle sprites are highly adaptable.  Their AI allows them to acutely observe their surroundings and aid their knight in the most optimal way.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_3a: Well, keep your wits about you. If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
conversation.properties|r.arc_leader_1: Sure sounds important, tell me how it all works.
item.properties|f.bristling_buckler: A small shield spiked to supplement your sword in a skirmish.
item.properties|f.prize_box_autumn: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in an Autumn style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.crimson_chaos: Investigate a Crimson Order base that has suddenly gone silent
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_15: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_3: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
item.properties|f.prize_box_aerodynamic: Contains unique aerodynamic costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.gh_env_rain_shower: The perfect environment for Guild Halls without fire insurance or whose members are simply too lazy to ever water their plants.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2c: Are there any friendly gremlins within the Clockworks?
item.properties|f.sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with the power to repel the various afflictions that knights might encounter in the line of duty.
projectx.properties|i.full_inspect: Allow other knights to inspect all your equipped items.
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: This is no longer routine training\! Get those Recruits to the elevator. We're extracting them back to Haven. You on the other hand need to head down and see who's at the bottom of this.
item.properties|f.polaris: It's said that the explosions caused by this stellar sidearm are so bright that you'll always be able to find your way in the darkness. Polaris shots become more powerful the further they travel.
chat.properties|m.usage_alchemy: Go to the alchemy machine in the Bazaar.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
item.properties|f.royal_skewer: A jagged, razor-sharp barb from one of the most powerful slimes on Cradle. Once removed from the slime it grows brittle and eventually turns to dust.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campknight: Come get warm by the fire.
redeem.properties|e.already_redeemed: The code you entered has already been redeemed. Doh\!
projectx.properties|m.achievement_obsole: Legacy\: Can no longer be achieved.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_1: Well met, knight.  Before you lies elevators leading to what Spiral HQ are calling 'Shadow Lairs.'  Shadow Lairs contain some of the most powerful monsters in the Clockworks, so be sure that you are fully Tier 3 equipped before going any further.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_elem: Greetings {0}, I'm Archilus, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high elemental damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the elemental attacks of constructs and gremlins. \n\nElemental resistant armor and shields are adapted from Owlite technology.  Though the Owlites themselves no longer exist, their amazing elemental mastery lives on in this gear.
item.properties|f.buckled_coat: A verdant coat fastened with shiny golden buckles.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_2a: You have a strange definition of recreation if that's the case.  Tier 3 fiends and undead are nothing to sneeze at, in fact they're among the worst creatures you'll find so close to the Core. \n\nDevilite management seems to be the worst at these depths and that results in some very violent devilites.
uplink.properties|m.confirm_att_account: This is an account-wide mail, you can read it with any of your knights but the attachment can only be accepted once.\n\nAccept the attachment now?
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: The watcher of the Wildwoods...the horrible Snarbolax\!
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_1a: Whew, I'm glad you came along when you did. Those pesky gremlins were going to wreck everything\! The bazaar would have been ruined\!\n\nOh right, where are my manners? My name is Tylen, it's a pleasure to meet you, {0}.
item.properties|f.vial_shock_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
monster.properties|m.overtime_2: I'm not saying to work this weekend, but everyone else is, so...
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: C.U.B.E. Club Members may spin up to 50 times at once.\nRequires Golden Slime Coins.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
chat.properties|m.complain_self: You can't file a complaint about yourself.
mission.properties|o.first_contact: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink
guild.properties|i.charter: View important information about this guild.
item.properties|f.frenzy_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe shaped the world in its passing\: its frenzy started the mighty winds, its scales became the shadows.
exchange.properties|e.already_tx: Please wait, a request is still being processed...
item.properties|f.blackhawk: A shadow-aligned handgun of incredible power, it's said to contain the soul of a knight who was only two days from retirement.
mission.properties|b.reporting_duty: Lieutenant Feron is responsible for overseeing the Clockworks mining operation in the Haven Arcade.  Report to him and learn about the situation in Haven and Spiral HQ's mission to reach the Core of Cradle.
helptips.properties|m.unlock: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Silver Key.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_gre: A tall torch filled with ghastly green fire.
projectx.properties|m.mission_rjp: Recover the recon module in the Royal Jelly Palace.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a cut-throat warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.luck_potion: A syrupy secretion said by some to strengthen serendipity. (Spiral HQ is unable to determine any actual effect.)
conversation.properties|m.mission_surviv: It hunted us down...got the rest of my team...
mission.properties|m.pioneers_4a: We need you to discover what happened to them.  You'll start by seeking out known locations of their recon modules and collecting them for analysis.  I will be in charge of locating their general whereabouts and directing you toward them.  It's your job to go into the wild to retrieve them. \n\nAdditionally, I'll provide you with a quick background of each of the four members of the Alpha Squad\: Squad Leader Euclid, Squad Guardian Grantz, Squad Recon Parma, and Squad Technician Rulen.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r4: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
social.properties|m.party_invite: {0} has invited you to join their party.
item.properties|f.misplaced_promissory_n: An old document promising to pay a sum at a date long gone. Grants Normal Defense and increased Defense with decreased health.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_3a: At 4 and 5 star level, gear offers the best protection you can find and weapons pack the biggest punch.  If you want to stay alive where you're heading, you need to start building an arsenal of 4 and 5 star gear. \n\nAnd remember- as items reach 5 star they typically can branch even more than before.  Your combat options are about to really open up.  Plan your arsenal with care.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_helm: A hardened helm made to protect intrepid explorers while they explore the unknown.
mission.properties|b.chilled_to_bone:
By now you have no doubt run into strange, undead monsters known as 'spookats.'  Recon Knights have finally discovered what seems to be the source of these ghostly cat-like creatures. 

Large concentrations of spookats have been sighted in what is believed to be the darkened remains of an owlite castle.  Dubbed the 'Candlestick Keep' this shadowy realm is only illuminated by a series of owlite candles.    

Proceed with caution while exploring outside the light of the candles.  Lurking in the dark are enormous spookats known as 'grimalkins.'  Grimalkins seem to withstand all weaponry and are to be avoided.  Your only defense is to stay in the light\! 

Spiral HQ has issued you this mission in order to collect more data on the origins of the spookats and the mystery behind the fall of the owlites.  Investigate the Candlestick Keep and report your findings\!
item.properties|f.hex_visor: It's said a fly could dodge anything with eyes like these. Too bad you're not a fly.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_1: Hi there\! I'm Biscotti, Head Chef of the Skylark\! I'm still calibrating the battle sprite food alchemizer, so check back with me later.
chat.properties|m.usage_item_pack: Usage\: /{0} pack [player name]\nGives an item pack to the player
dungeon.properties|m.no_revive: Your revive effort is no longer necessary.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_1a: Thought you could just walk away with the artifact did you?  Hand it over now or I'll light this fuse and turn you into a million, tiny, smoldering bits\!
conversation.properties|r.sl_guard_3: I'll get a Shadow Key and start investigating\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_welcome: We have picked up your distress signal, recruit. Your first objective is to reach Haven, where we have created an outpost. You're likely a little woozy from the crash, so I'll guide you through the basics. The road may be dangerous, so ready your sword and keep your wits about you. Good luck\!
helptips.properties|m.lock_howto:
* There are multiple Control Points scattered around the map 
* Capturing and holding a Control Point increases your team's score over time 
* To capture a Control Point, stand on it until it changes to your team's color 
* The team with the highest score at the end of the match WINS\!
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_1a: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven.  To start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
dungeon.properties|m.leaveparty_return: Leave the party and return to {0}.
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_3a: And how does my sprite evolve?
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r4: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_super: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
dungeon.properties|m.dark_city_desc: This once bustling city from an advanced world is now home to innumerable fiends from the Underworld. Under the light of the moon they burn their dark sigils into the ground, summoning more of their cohorts for reasons yet unknown.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_sentin: A helm reinforced with volcanic plating to defend against a range of elements.
guild.properties|x.rename_desc1: Your guild may only be renamed every 30 days.
guildhelp.properties|m.storage_info: The Guild Storage acts like a community item bank. Guild members of the appropriate rank can add or remove equipment or items to the Storage as they see fit. It's a great way to share resources between guildmates, or to help out newer members\!\n WARNING\: Items placed in Guild Storage can be removed and claimed by any guild member with access to Guild Storage. Do not put items into Guild Storage that you want to keep for yourself\!
guild.properties|m.hall_now_closed: {0}'s Guild Hall is no longer open to the public.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_stri: Greetings {0}, I'm Echo, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad striker.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on rapid, close-quarters combat. \n\nThe arsenal of a striker focuses on speed.  You want to get in close with your enemy, hit them hard and get out.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that leaps into battle ahead of your squad, striking first before they can even fire off a shot.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_b: Don't forget your shield, it will save your life\!
item.properties|f.fire_raider_tunic: Treasure is at your fingertips and ash in your wake with this soot laden coat.
projectx.properties|m.save_offer: In order to save the knight that you have created, you must create an account to use when logging into the game.
monster.properties|m.punkin_intro_2: What does the Punkin King have for thee...?
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h:
The Clockworks have been so consistent for so long\! Just ticking along like, well... you know. But now *something is happening* and I don't know what it is\!\! 

I'm so excited\! 

Bring us samples of these Mysterious Spikes and we'll make good trades for them\!
mission.properties|o.advanced_alchemy: Visit Bosco and discover the potential of advanced alchemy
mission.properties|m.new_threat_9a: You cannot stop what you cannot see.
item.properties|f.frayed_fabric: The worn remains of a Clockworks denizen's duds. It could probably be recycled.
pvp.properties|m.coins_earned.1: You have earned {0} Krogmo Coin playing {1}\!
uplink.properties|d.starter_pack: A Starter Pack is everything a Knight needs to begin their adventure on the strange, new world of Cradle. Gift it to a friend that you know will have your back\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Raise your shield to block attacks\!
conversation.properties|r.core_lead_4: But I thought there was no way inside it?
item.properties|f.feral_cannon: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the penetrating energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
mission.properties|b.alien_ooze: One of our field research teams is under siege from a large colony of lichens. Lichens are an alien species of the slime family thought to have come to the Clockworks via a meteor that crashed on to the surface of Cradle.  This particular species of slime is formed from innumerable smaller slimes that form mobile, sentient 'colonies.' \n\nLichen colonies can further combine to form larger and larger versions of themselves, rapidly evolving a range of deadly claws and barbs.  Prevent them from combining at all costs and save the research team\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Undercorp employees get a free mug with every visit.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
helptips.properties|t.parma_recon_2: Recon Module\: Entrance to the Core
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_3a: Once again the sprites have changed and this time they're really creeping me out\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
item.properties|f.skelly_mask: A spooky mask good for both scaring children and protecting from shadow attacks.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r4: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_3: Thanks {0}, I appreciate it.  And do me a favour, please don't mention this little 'incident' to Spiral HQ...
item.properties|f.leviathan_blade: A rare treasure of the Spiral Order, the blows from this mythical sword are said to rain down upon its victims like the water from a tidal wave.

mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
mission.properties|b.weight_of_darkness:
It is speculated that all fiends within the Clockworks crossed over from a dimension known as the Underworld.  While how they crossed over and what their motives are on Cradle is unclear, data collected from fiendish cities seems to indicate that they are now stranded on Cradle, much like us. 

The undead on the other hand remain a mystery.  Why spirits return to the material realm is unknown, though it is clear that many of the spirits within the Clockworks have come from other worlds.  Given how hostile these creatures can be, the only way to obtain useful data is through direct interactions, like combat. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you collect combat data for the powerful fiend and undead monsters in Tier 3 of the Clockworks in order to better understand the nature of these creatures. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with shadow resistant gear with elemental and piercing damage weapons\!
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Lord Vanaduke \nLittle is known about the eternal Duke of the Almirian Empire. Our sensors show the mask is a source of power as well as a potential weakness.

mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!

mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_1a:
Alright Rangers, listen up - we've got orders to infiltrate a gremlin bioweapons facility lead by a member of their 'Crimson Order,' known as 'Herex.'  This is just a fancy way of saying that one of the craziest of the crazy gremlins likes to load his gun with unconventional bullets. 

We don't know what he has cooking down there so arm yourself and don't forget to wear a mask. If Herex is anything like Seerus you're liable to catch more than a cold down there. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!

mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_1a:
Nothing like a death-defying romp through a haunted necropolis to really get the blood pumping, eh Rangers? 

The necropolis originates from Almire, fallen kingdom of some crazy lord something-something, population\: innumerable legions of Undead.  Apparently these less-than-living residents are guarding something that Spiral HQ would like to acquire. 

Our job is to recover a special book, a piece of a much larger collection of works that may give us more insight into the nature of this cursed kingdom.  So grab your helmets, and your best zombie-basher- I'm not expecting a warm reception. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!

mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_2a: As you know I am attempting to assemble a research team to work on-site in the Core terminal.  In order to successfully utilize it to restore the Skylark, it is imperative that we reach it and set up this research station. \n\nAll evidence seems to point towards you having the potential to finally reach the Core.  By breaking through the Firestorm Citadel and establishing a link to the Core, my team could set up the necessary supply lines and get to work immediately.  But we can't do that while that infernal citadel and its horrible ruler stand in our way.

mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm_b: Having restored power to the Rescue Camp and established contact with Spiral HQ, it's time you attempted to cross the chasm north of the Rescue Camp and reach Haven where the rest of the Spiral Knights have taken refuge. \n\nIn order to cross the chasm you will need to take an elevator down into the Clockworks and find another to bring you up on the other side.  There's no telling what dangers lurk in the dark depths below so Rhendon will be accompanying you on your journey.
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: My rescue team was ambushed by some giant mechanical horror. We didn't stand a chance. I'm glad you got here when you did, otherwise I don't know if we would have made it.

Armed with your new sprite, your mission is to find this 'Collector' and rescue the knights and sprites it has taken captive.
conversation.properties|m.dark_harvest_e:
Welcome to the Dark Harvest Festival\!  This annual celebration honors the undead with festive masks, delicious treats and dangerous tricks\!

To participate, explore the Clockworks and try to find the legendary 'Punkin King.'  This ghoulish gourd gives out candy to visitors.  You can exchange the candy to the traders here in the Haven Town Square for monster masks\!

Should you prefer the direct approach, or just need a few more, our vendor will sell you candy as well.

mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!

Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.

mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_4a: I'll make it.  Just you wait.
