item.properties|f.quicksilver_helm: A fine helmet made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
item.properties|m.in_style_kit: (This modifier is also present in your style kit.)
mission.properties|b.toy_soldiers: Recon Knights are reporting much greater numbers of mecha knights in the first stratum of the Clockworks and have discovered a mecha knight production facility close to Haven. \n\nMecha knights are believed to be gremlin-engineered sentries of the construct family that share many of the capabilities of a Spiral Knight.  Proceed with caution when seeking out the production center and then shut it down for good\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: Careful in there.  Looks like they had a big one with them...
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_cardho: Please enter your entire name as it appears on your credit card.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Continue to fight the good fight, {0}. Remember what you've learned. Farewell\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_teblocks: TIMED EXPLOSIVE BLOCKS will count down to 0 before exploding and causing damage.
chat.properties|m.usage_revoke_gift: Usage\: /{0} <account name> name attr value attr value...\nRevokes a gift from the identified account.
pvp.properties|m.love_unapprove_confirm: Are you sure? You will be able to make changes again, but the approval process will be started over.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6a: I'd like to see the shops again. (Follow Tylen)
chat.properties|m.usage_help: Available commands\: {0}\nEnter\: "/{1} <command>" to learn more about each command.
conversation.properties|m.final_test_kni: I see.  This will be very interesting information for Spiral HQ.  Our base camp in Haven is just up ahead.  Head on up the elevator and meet the other Knights who survived the crash like yourself. The techs in the Lab will be eager to study that artifact.  They'll see to it once you get to Haven. \n\nDon't worry about the others in the Rescue Camp.  Thanks to you, we have a functioning elevator system to reach them.  You've saved them all\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: This place gives me the chills.
pvp.properties|m.bribe_reward_subject: King Krogmo reward earned in the Coliseum.
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
item.properties|f.polar_night_warden_coa: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of nighttime watch duty.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r9: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
item.properties|f.capsule_health_ultra: A capsule that restores an extreme amount of health. Never leave home without one\!
mission.properties|b.return_of_ur: A Recon squad has reported that deep within a fiendish city, devilites are attempting to summon a legion of powerful trojan warriors.  Based on intel from a devilite internal memo, the trojans are known as the 'Legion of Ur,' and are said to have once numbered in the thousands.  Strangely, the memo indicated that the Legion of Ur was sealed away in the Underworld and that an alternative approach would be required for bringing them back. \n\nWhatever means the devilites intend to use to bring a few thousand trojans into the Clockworks, they must be stopped.  Infiltrate their city and stop the fiendish army before they become unstoppable\!
projectx.properties|m.bug_message: Please enter a brief description of the bug.  \nPlease note that bug reports are not answered by GMs.  \nIf you also need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: The best current market price. A response of ??? indicates that there is no current market offer for the amount you've entered.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_3b: There are different theories. Some say the gremlins that you see working on it now are responsible. But that seems too great even for their seemingly infinite work force. Even with the means to do so, how did they "start?" Where did they find the power?
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_shield: A mythical shield imbued with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. It's said that the beast can use the glowing orbs on the shield's face to see and stalk weak-hearted wielders.
item.properties|f.gunpuppy_helm: A helm handcrafted from salvaged Gun Puppy parts.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Grantz he...he fell while protecting us from The Swarm. He stood his ground even when the rest of us were forced to flee. I'll never forget how brave he was.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_1: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_spiralhorn: Contains various unique accessories and items to celebrate the Year of the Ram\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.pepperbox: An Autogun modified to fire high-temperature bullets capable of engulfing foes.
item.properties|f.owlite_feather: A small feather plucked from an Owlite, said to be a mythical race of great magician birds.
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_shield: A reliable shield that'll help keep you grounded in battle.
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_3: I think I've got it thanks for-
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r9: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of slime and beast family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
item.properties|f.serene_helm: An ancient, resilient helmet covered in a soft layer of moss.  Within the cool, stony interior of this helmet you can hear a faint and soothing song formed by the rustle of winds traveling from distant lands.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of construct and gremlin family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'other very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge for the second time' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
mission.properties|b.guardians_of_cradle: You have been invited to attend a meeting with several members of Spiral HQ to discuss what to do next about the Core and the threat of the Swarm. Join them in the Hall of Heroes to learn about Operations Missions.
guild.properties|m.confirm_promote: Are you sure you want to promote {0} to {1}?
item.properties|f.firo_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful firo bullets that split multiple times on impact.
pvp.properties|e.late_playagain: You are too late to play again.
social.properties|m.trader_busy: Oops\! That player is otherwise occupied.
chat.properties|m.usage_come: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades to come to you.
mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_3a: Thanks Bosco\!  I'll gather some recipes and get crafting\!
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: We've recovered what little remains from Owlite Keep concerning the Kingdom of Almire. Combined with the snippets we've gotten from the nature sprites within Firestorm Citadel itself, we are starting to get a clearer picture of Almire's history.
item.properties|f.prize_box_colossal: Contains various unique costumes and accessories to celebrate the Year of the Horse\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.prize_box_cozy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Cozy style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_hood: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
dungeon.properties|m.gloaming_wildwoods_: Spiral Knight recruits are advised to avoid this dark and misty forest until they are experienced with the dangers of the Clockworks. The Gloaming Wildwoods is home to packs of vicious beasts, the worst of all being the mythical Snarbolax. Said to be 'a living shadow,' the Snarbolax prefers the taste of prey that had been a state of terror before death and will often mercilessly harass its victims before delivering the final blow.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_8a: I assume you've named them as well?
item.properties|f.iron_slug: Only the most frightening of foes can withstand the crippling paralysis caused by the magnum force of the Iron Slug's sudden impact. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_suited: Contains a suite of suitable eye shapes for your style kit\: Club, Diamond, Heart, and Spade.
item.properties|f.enamorock: A strange stone that makes you have warm and fuzzy feelings inside just by holding it.
item.properties|f.ult_evo_catalyst: A contained charge of highly unstable energy that can be synthesized by battle sprites. In doing so, sprites can evolve into their ultimate forms and harness the power of their ultimate skills.
item.properties|f.black_kat_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Nappers, the undercover sleeper cell of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder: Schemer Razwog\: Work away from the others. The Order must never know we have the artifact. Find a way to power it. Bring it to me. Do not betray me.  I will know. \n\n-H
item.properties|f.kat_suit: A clawed costume made by Moorcroft tailors. It's perfect for curious knights who are prone to pause for naps after a long night of adventuring.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_5: It is time you entered the Hall of Heroes once more.  Having been fully Star Certified and successfully completed so many missions that have ensured the survival of the Spiral Knights on Cradle, Spiral HQ is preparing you for the high rank of Vanguard.
item.properties|f.waste_module: A small receptacle that once collected refuse from a device built to wreak havoc. Now, it just plain reeks.
item.properties|f.hive_box: Contains one unique hive-themed item. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.valiance: This high-performance handgun is a symbol of the Spiral Order, and is proudly worn by veteran members. As it is often said, a knight need not have courage\: just Valiance.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_1a: Tell me what you know about the Clockworks.
sprites.properties|d.disintegration_ray: The ray of light also reduces the defense of its targets.
item.properties|f.almire_table: A table transplanted from the hallowed halls of Almire to adorn your abode.
item.properties|f.wildfire: An elite handgun that can offer a tremendous surprise for the enemy on the battlefield as its small charges of energy transform into raging wildfires. Wildfire shots become more powerful the further they travel.
projectx.properties|e.password_mismatch: The passwords you entered do not match.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_giantswor: Etched within the side of the blade appears to be some kind of map of the stars.
mission.properties|b.time_enough_at_last: A knight named Edger has gone missing while exploring the Scarlet Fortress.  Given that this crumbling castle is swarming with spookats and jelly cubes, his squadmates fear for his safety and have asked a more experienced knight like yourself to investigate. \n\nLocate Edger within the fortress and bring him back to Haven\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_shield_2: As your shield absorbs damage it will turn from green to red and eventually break. Once it's broken you cannot defend until it regenerates, so be careful\!
item.properties|f.sacred_shade_armor: A shadowy suit of armor built to outlast whatever might slink from the shadows.
item.properties|f.final_flourish: The premier armament of the serious fencer, it can riposte just as easily as it can rip up foes.
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: Three lichens slide into a room...
item.properties|f.hazardous_grim_mask: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of Death itself. Those that wear it have a saying, 'Death is at your heels, so keep facing forward.'
projectx.properties|d.achievement_87eae7: Revive a downed party member, giving them only half a pip of health.
conversation.properties|r.hunter_1a: I've seen my share of danger, and I like it.
item.properties|f.spiral_tailed_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.primal_ore: An extraordinary metal imbued with the savage spirit of the wild.
mission.properties|b.vile_engine:
Somewhere below a level that lichens have taken to inhabiting lies a strange facility of unknown origin that seems to be used for the production of toxic slime monsters. The 'slime generators' are capable of rapidly producing slime monsters that then quickly populate nearby levels. 

Squads in neighboring levels have already reported overwhelming numbers of toxic slimes, making it impossible to lead expeditions beyond depth 23.  It is time a knight of your caliber form a squad to infiltrate this strange facility and shut down production of these vile creatures. 

Any data that you could collect as to their origin would be highly valuable to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r9: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.big_beast_basher: It was suggested that this brutally sharp mining pick could probably be used to hunt both beasts AND minerals. The Clockworks were never the same.
item.properties|d.recover_accessory: Recovers an accessory from an item, returning the accessory to your arsenal.
social.properties|m.party_full: Oops\! That party is no longer accepting new members.
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: Luck changes, sometimes from bad to worse...
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_crown: Ruggedly royal regalia recently reproduced from regally resinous remains.
item.properties|f.red_saber: A saber the color of the burning sun that is given to knights who have shown exemplary bravery in past actions.
item.properties|f.gun_puppy_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gun puppy.  It's so convincing, your friends just might give you the run around\!
item.properties|f.bottomless_stocking: An interdimensional tear in this fuzzy fabric sock swallows any item placed within it.  It even swallowed the stitches.
mission.properties|o.beyond_axes_of_evil: Crush the new gremlin logging operation in the Jigsaw Valley
helptips.properties|m.rescue_door_sk: I've almost got this door open. While I'm working at it, rescue the captive knights in the area\!
uplink.properties|m.love_rejected: Sorry, your Crucible level was rejected\: {0}
conversation.properties|m.imposto_50: Glorp\! If I had bones, they'd be broken\!
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_barrier: If you start feeling overwhelmed, use the force barriers like the one to your right to take a breather. Monsters and projectiles cannot pass through them.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_mail: Superior plate mail forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It's restrictive, but incredibly strong.
item.properties|f.eternal_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. This orb is prized by the most powerful knights and is used to craft items of extraordinary power.
item.properties|f.confetti_leaf: A fantastic party favor used in forest festivities.
item.properties|f.thricer_slicer: At some point the eggheads will figure out what these mysterious energy spikes are. But in the meantime, now we can slice and sling them at double the rate, with extra mysterious orbital spins\!
item.properties|f.woven_shade_armor: A loose fitting suit of armor that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_coat: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
item.properties|f.prize_box_raiders: Contains one of various unique items and accessories for raiders. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|m.expires_remaining: Expires in {0} day(s), {1} hour(s), and {2} minute(s).
mission.properties|b.p_r3_mat_1: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
admin.properties|d.load_tester: Spawns PseudoPlayer clients to test the server. Not recommended for use on production deployments\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_vile: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Vile style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: Hello there, {0}\!  My name is Bosco and I'm here to give you a rundown on the basics of alchemy. \n\nIt's pretty simple stuff really, thanks to these Alchemy Stations.  They do all the heavy lifting for ya\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_4: Welcome back to the Hall of Heroes, {0}.  Please speak to the heroic knights you see before you to gain access to their weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale: An armored scale from what was thought to be an extinct creature. It reflects light with an otherworldly sheen.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_divine: A bright, heavenly theme that will make it really hard to lose your keys.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: They can be killed but often you can just avoid them.
helptips.properties|m.tut_victory: You've made it\! Walk on ahead to enter the Rescue Camp.
item.properties|f.shadowsun_stetson: A dashing hat for duelists who prefer to get their work done at midnight, rather than high noon.
item.properties|f.miracle_hood: A miraculous mask said to grant a single miracle to the wearer when they need it most.  In practice, it'll likely save your skin more often than that.
item.properties|f.volt_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful volt bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.crescent_helm: A sturdy helm that resembles a crescent moon when the visor is lifted.
social.properties|m.friend_request_pendi: You have already sent a friend request to {0}.
item.properties|f.personal_color: Once used, this item will permanently change your Knight's personal color to the specified color.
social.properties|m.friend_party_progres: You must wait for {0}'s party to reach depth {1}.
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_1b: No thanks, I'll explore the place myself.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_2a: And speaking of gremlins, we're starting to get an alarming number of reports of gremlins mobilizing in the Clockworks below Haven.  We don't have too many details yet, but given the relations we've had with them so far, our guess is they're preparing for an attack.
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise_2: Contains two randomly chosen Prize Boxes in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_1a: Tell me what you know about the gremlins.
projectx.properties|m.region_mismatched: Note\: this place is hosted in "{1}", there was a temporary problem finding a place in "{0}".
chat.properties|m.usage_grant: Usage\: /{0} number\nGives you a number of crowns.
item.properties|f.fiery_pepperbox: When you've been attacked by a swarm of Ice Cubes, all Knights agree\: happiness is a Fiery Pepperbox.
mission.properties|m.elemental_my_dear_1: Hello again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict elemental damage correct?
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_2c: How do I obtain more energy?
conversation.properties|r.atg_guard: Thanks\! I'll go see what's inside.
item.properties|f.deadshot_chapeau: A mythical hat for those that never miss their mark. It's rumored to have been made from cloth that was previously interred.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_3a: Spiral HQ believes you are our best choice to help track down the energy signature, since you were the one to bring us the Artifact in the first place.  Rhendon will be dispatched to get on the trail of the gremlins below.
item.properties|f.furni_statue: A commemorative statue that may be placed in a Guild Hall. Up to {0} statues may be placed per hall.
helptips.properties|m.sl_elevator_active: Shadow Key required to open.\nShadow Keys can be acquired randomly in lockboxes or purchased from the Supply Depot.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_99c5a1: Travel the entire Clockworks from depth 0 to depth 29 in a single expedition without having to revive.
item.properties|f.shock_barrier: Surrounds you with orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
item.properties|f.fire_raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings and a thick coat of ash.
guild.properties|m.published: The Guild Hall has been updated\!
item.properties|f.radiant_silvermail: An upgraded set of Silvermail that is said to shine brightly even in the darkest of hours.
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_1a: Welcome to our advanced training hall. Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like some directions?
item.properties|f.haze_bomb_mkii: A Haze Bomb modified to disperse noxious chemicals over a wider range.
uplink.properties|m.newsletter: Subscribe now and get a free Proto Crest accessory\!
item.properties|f.heavy_demo_helm: A reinforced helmet that might be handy if you, the master of exploding, take it with you.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_4a: Even though you have defeated Vanaduke, it appears as though the curse he brought down upon this kingdom still lingers. It requires all of our power to keep these raging shadow fires in check.
social.properties|m.empty_feed: No recent event activity. Check back later.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_6a: Hold fast, traveler. You stand in the court of the Kingdom of Almire. Do you not hear the trumpets sound the return of our mighty legions? Are you not in awe of the prestigious heraldry of our great houses and statesmen?
item.properties|f.gorgomega: A terrifying shield that combines the dual-crushing power of a gorgo and the mythical tortomega. Crushing enemies has never been more fiendishly fun.
item.properties|f.gunslinger_hat: A mighty fine piece of headgear worn by pistol-packing warriors from a forgotten time. It's perfect for dueling, searching or drifting across high plains.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_4a: I'm going to need you to go over that-
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_1: Spiral Knights are capable of unleashing the hidden powers locked from within the weapons they use called "charge attacks." Charge attacks are more powerful than a standard attack and can often produce special effects.
item.properties|f.decon_rig: An exosuit of structural iron and comfortable conduit crafted from the very bones of Cradle.
item.properties|f.ranger_signal_flare: A flare that signals a nearby Recon Ranger to provide support fire
conversation.properties|m.hunter_3a: Indeed\! Monster trophies will require a great deal of materials, so it is only reasonable that a group effort is required. \n\nLastly, some of the materials you will need can only be acquired by spending boss tokens with Brinks in the Haven Bazaar. They act as proof of your valor in defeating such fearsome creatures\!
item.properties|f.chroma_tear: A crystallized Chromalisk tear suitable as a lens for focusing weaponry, or for correcting myopia.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
item.properties|f.neutralizer: You'd be surprised at the number of practical applications to be had from two substances that, when combined, leave quite literally nothing in their wake. Neutralizer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
guild.properties|i.buy_expansions: Purchase more space for the Guild Hall. Increases upkeep.
helptips.properties|m.tg_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those retrodes weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_2: Victory is yours\! But will these warriors leave this hallowed hall of glorious combat and be forgotten, or continue on against even more terrifying foes in hopes of reaping the rewards of the Arena King?
helptips.properties|m.atg_statustraps: Beware\!  Some traps can cause damage AND inflict harmful status effects.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: A magnificently preserved royal seal of the lost kingdom of Almire. It probably belongs in a museum.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_11: Brinks is the Token Trader, issuing certain items to Knights in exchange for tokens that can be collected within the Clockworks.  Tokens can be found in treasure blocks, issued as mission rewards or found when defeating special boss monsters.
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll find those black kats and recover the Ancient Pages\!
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r9: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
projectx.properties|i.render_effects: Enables more detailed graphical effects, but\nmay reduce graphics performance with less powerful systems.
item.properties|f.infernal_guardian_armo: Charred, stygian armor worn by those who defend the infernal depths.
projectx.properties|m.cs_instructions: Please select the control layout you would like to use.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_1: Cradle is a dangerous world and it's important to make sure you have powerful gear in your arsenal in order to survive.  To do that, you will need to use the Forge.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_1a: Welcome to the Haven Bazaar\!  It's a pleasure to meet you {0}, my name is Bechamel. Since I work here in the Bazaar, Spiral HQ has asked me to show new arrivals around this fabulous epicenter of commerce and let them know everything it has to offer. \n\nSo let's go on a quick tour shall we?  Try and keep up, I walk fast.
helptips.properties|m.atg_traps: Watch your step\!  Wait until TRAPS are down before walking over them.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 4 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
conversation.properties|m.casino_imposto: Waiter? Oh sorry about that good sir.
guild.properties|i.member_storage: Community item storage for members and above.
item.properties|f.mega_magnus: An upgraded Magnus powerful enough to take a monster's head clean off. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
item.properties|f.avenger: A holy sword created in another time to arm knights who fought against the legions of the Underworld.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r7: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
chat.properties|m.usage_cry: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCause your knight to cry.
item.properties|f.black_chaingun: A highly advanced machine gun designed to output hundreds of rounds of shadow bolts in a very short time. Controlling one of these requires skilled hands.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4c: Harness upgrades are definitely worth the crowns. Superior versions of each harness reduce combat skill cooldowns\!
support.properties|m.option_210_1: If you're sure the other options didn't cover your complaint, and you're sure the player broke our Terms of Service, then please enter a short explanation here for what your complaint is.
conversation.properties|m.core_lead_4: I'm saying that we know this entire world isn't natural, and I for one don't believe that those hordes of miserable gremlins, no matter how industrious, could have built an entire world.  They had to have been aided by something far beyond their measure and perhaps whatever that is lies within the Core. \n\nThe same goes for the Alpha Squad.  They wouldn't just disappear, even within the furthest depths of the Clockworks.  They were our very best.  It was this Core that swallowed them.
item.properties|f.storm_caller: A party favor of the gods, used to summon a bolt of lightning from the heavens.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_helm: A reliable helmet that'll come in handy when the heat is on.
conversation.properties|r.tier_accept: Roger that, I'm on my way.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.aegis: A sublime shield entrusted to only the most worthy members of the Spiral Order. Whether its crest is a relic from the Order of old or a creation from the Knights' time on Cradle is not immediately clear.
steam.properties|e.too_many_knights: There are too many knights to perform the conversion.  This account \nhas {0}, your Steam account has {1}, and you can only have {2} total.
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_2: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: Did you come from the chasm?  How?
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_downtim: The game will be unavailable for a short time during scheduled maintenance.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft2_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
sprites.properties|d.extra_hearty: Increases the chance of hearts dropping and duration of the enchantment.
item.properties|f.honor_shield_3: A ceremonial shield issued to Champions of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.exp_center_4f: An expansion that adds a small central room to the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|b.p_fast_advancement: Use this Test Server exclusive mission to quickly power up your weapons and gear.  Each level of this mission is exactly the same, allowing you to change your equipped weapons and gear at each depth. \n\nOnly a few heat embers are needed to max out any item\! 'Return to Haven' before you reach the end so you can come back to this mission.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: From the tomes we have recovered, we've learned that Firestorm Citadel was once part of a much larger kingdom known as Almire thousands of years ago. Although it was bordered by other aggressive nations, Almire was renowned for the martial prowess of its many legions. These legions kept the kingdom safe for many years. Alas, they weren't enough.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_helm: A loose fitting helm that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_3_3: Aye, it appears I'm no longer fit for this fight.  It's up to you now, {0}. You alone possess the strength to face Seerus and bring him to justice.  Many knights have lost their lives here today.  Honor their spirits by finishing the job\!
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_4a: Energy is essential in order to acquire powerful gear and items from the Supply Depot. \n\nYou will find all sorts of uses for it in your travels, just look for the energy symbol\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We're in\!  This is it\!
help.properties|m.controls_attack: [[ACTION]]. Hold to do a charge attack. [[ACTION]] also lifts large items, speaks to NPCs, and activates stations.
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_2a: Basically it comes down to 'branching.'  You see, most of the alchemy you have likely seen up to this point follows a linear evolution path.  It simply improves over time and each upgrade is better than the last. \n\nBut not all items are like that.  Many of them can become multiple, completely different types of items than their original\!
item.properties|f.helm_side: An accessory that can be attached to the side of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.iron_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Iron Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_8a: Yes.  It would seem as though we have much to learn of this place. \n\nRhendon's report noted that many of the sprites were missing from the site. He suggested foul play.
item.properties|f.pollinator: A rare, advanced handgun produced by biotechs with captured Gremlin technology. It fires pollen particles that cling to the enemy, causing explosive damage and also the sniffles.
mission.properties|m.status_lobby: Mission Lobby\nKnights joining in the Mission Lobby can receive completion credit for the mission.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2d: Battle sprites gain perks at certain levels that you can equip within the battle sprite interface. Perks provide bonuses to your stats.
craft.properties|m.moved_treasury: Item moved to your Guild Treasury
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: Account does not exist or is temporarily unavailable.
helptips.properties|m.atg_switch: Switch out of reach?  Throw a pot or shoot it with a gun\!
item.properties|f.deadly_crystal_bomb: A large chunk of Moonstone and Valestone alloy primed with a potent explosive. Studies have shown that this bomb can be used to reduce a zombie's craving for brains by up to 100% by blowing them to pieces.
item.properties|f.blazebrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a concentrated high-temperature explosion that is harmless to knights.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_9a: Yes I know. Anyway I also understand that some of the sprite transport crates were empty again. Something is not right... \n\nNow then, secure that last cache of sprites before whatever is stealing sprites finds it\!
helptips.properties|m.loading13: If you are the party leader, you can remove any player from your party. Click the status icon of the player you wish to remove and select "Remove from Party."
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We're cut off\!  Please help us defeat those lichens\!
social.properties|m.party_progress: {0} cannot join until the party reaches depth {1}.
item.properties|f.radiant_sun_shards: A solid chunk of solar-charged Luminite with an explosive surprise inside. Devilites hate surprises.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
helptips.properties|m.tut_shrubs: Try clearing out these shrubs. Plants and other destructible objects often hide treasures.
item.properties|f.volt_oil: A slippery substance that always holds a slight electrical charge.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Welcome to the Moorcroft Archives, traveler. Here you will find an illustrious collection of ancient grimoires from many forgotten worlds. It's quite the sight, I know\! \n\nYou're free to look around but please don't touch- some of these books are filled with incredible mystic power. You could hurt yourself\!
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
helptips.properties|m.dead: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to cycle to Spectator View.
chat.properties|m.usage_respond: Usage\: /{0} message\nResponds to the player who sent the last /tell.
helptips.properties|m.test_lobby: Welcome testers\! Before you head off into the Clockworks, feel free to help yourself to some wonderful stuff from the merchant to the left. \nThe embers to the far right will level up weapons once your collect enough of them and proceed to the next floor. \nGood luck, brave knights\!
item.properties|f.wild_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.celestial_nav_suit: A special suit built to commemorate Isoran starfarers of old.  With this equipped, you feel like you would never get lost in space... if only the Skylark could fly.
logon.properties|m.newer_version: The game is in the process of being updated. Please try again in a few minutes.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_1: Hail\! You must be the brave knight Spiral HQ has sent to deal with these Grinchlins. Mount Krampus is not like other levels so allow me to explain to you how it works.
conversation.properties|m.npc_supply_tea: Sorry I don't have much time to talk. I have to get all these supplies down to our forward outposts. People tend to forget that without knights like us running supplies down into the Clockworks, our ability to scout out areas further afield would be severely limited.  What a thankless job, huh?
conversation.properties|m.rc_nervous_1a: I want to buy something with the crowns I've earned in the training grounds, but that merchant is totally giving me the creeps. What do you think it's hiding under those robes?\!
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_helm: Made from the scales of rare Clockworks beasts, this sturdy helmet is resistant to even the highest of temperatures.
item.properties|f.super_brawl_crown: Awarded to the champion of Super Brawl\!
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A long, razor-sharp tooth, proof that you encountered the fabled Snarbolax and survived to galumph back.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_2a: Ah, that's right, you're a new recruit.  Most knights encounter their first sprite on the battlefield.  Chances are you've not had the opportunity to see one yet. \n\nAllow me to explain...
item.properties|f.quicksilver_mail: A fine set of mail made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
conversation.properties|m.npc_lostknight: It's good to know Spiral HQ hasn't forgotten about me.
item.properties|f.heavy_pulsar: A Pulsar upgraded with Spiral technology to pack a greater punch. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: At any given time a sprite has a 'favored item', a special material that it enjoys eating the most. Feeding one of these to your sprite is a great treat and grants the sprite a lot of heat.
item.properties|f.plague_essence: A powerful essence left behind when a creature perishes from a particularly putrid disease.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_7a: Hsst\! So, you're the ones who defeated Razwog and took what was mine.  You are not worthy of possessing this powerful Artifact and so I am here to relieve you of it.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_4: A ceremonial sword issued to Vanguards of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.almire_chair: A chiseled chair as ancient as Almire's ailing aristocrats.
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: I'm a field researcher working under Chief Geo Knight Wegner.
mission.properties|b.welcome_to_haven: Having survived the journey to Haven you must contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink and give her your report.  She has information as to what to do next as well as special instructions on the use of energy.
global.properties|m.peer_shutting_down: The requested peer is shutting down.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_ora: A tall torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I worked my employees hard to get where I am today.
projectx.properties|m.remove_loadout_pro: Are you sure you want to remove {0}?
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_5a: Once freed you will collect an Apocrean Sigil as proof of your deed. Bring these to me and my friend here will reward you with special treasures I have collected during my time in this world. You can use these items to craft rare and powerful items using that obelisk of creation over there.
item.properties|f.token_snarbolax: A long, razor-sharp tooth plucked from the mouth of a Snarbolax; a memento representing a Knight's triumph over the monstrous stalker of the Gloaming Wildwoods.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_mail: A suit of artifact armor that is said to have been worn by titans. Though it offers amazing protection, its incredible weight makes it cumbersome to wear.
item.properties|f.valestone: A fabled mineral of a vibrant, green color said to contain the essence of all natural life.
item.properties|f.heavy_dark_matter_bomb: A solid chunk of Dark Matter with an explosive surprise inside. Gremlins hate surprises.
sprites.properties|d.hexing_haze: Creates a miasma around you that hexes any target within. Each hex has a timer that deals damage to its target upon termination. For every target acquired by hexing haze, the duration of the miasma increases.
item.properties|f.brimstone: A smelly, stygian, sulfuric shard commonly found in the Underworld.
mission.properties|m.steam_overlay_disab: The Steam overlay must be enabled in order to purchase expansions. Please ensure that "Enable Steam Community In-Game" is checked in the Steam "In-Game" settings, then restart the game.
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: That and a solid arsenal, yeah.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_4a: Lost souls trapped by the Apocrea are bound to the realities they have created. Find the lost souls and free them from the bonds of the Apocrea.
conversation.properties|m.imposto_death: Abort Mission\! I'm retreating back to Haven\! Glorp\!
guild.properties|i.buy_themes: Change the theme for the Guild Hall.
monster.properties|m.vanaduke_1: What's this? More wolves hungry for the blood of Almire? Our great kingdom shall never fall to the likes of beasts\!
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_3a: Our recent intel from Recon Knights suggest that gremlins are planning something big.  We believe they are developing some kind of weapon they're calling 'Project R' that will be targeting Haven itself.  Spiral HQ and the Strangers themselves are requesting that you investigate the matter given your performance in the Royal Jelly Palace.
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of extremely low temperature material at an increased rate.
item.properties|f.energy_well: After energy is added to the energy well, guild members may withdraw 100 units of energy daily.
item.properties|f.elite_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. Orbs like these are used by elite knights to craft items of exceptional quality and power.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_8a: Yes, quite. These sprites have adapted the power to cloak, to use the very shadows around them for subterfuge. Between that and their newfound skills in toxins and debilitations, I'd say they could be quite handy on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.prize_box_frosty: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Frosty style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_2: Indeed\! A battle sprite can synthesize matter into useable energy. This machine can take certain materials and alchemize them into extra special sprite food... that is, when it's finally calibrated.
item.properties|f.ice_axe: A technical climbing tool that can pick apart monsters with precision.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_b: Not much equipment has been salvaged from the crash pods.  There's not even enough here for each able-bodied Knight.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_c: I think I need to craft a better shield when I get back to Haven.
sprites.properties|d.flame_barrier: Surround yourself with a barrier of flames that enhances your defenses while burning nearby targets.
uplink.properties|m.metal_sonic: Thank you for purchasing Sonic CD on Steam\!  Attached is your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.  These items are costumes that can be equipped over any armor allowing you to look like Metal Sonic whenever you like\! \n\nPlease note, gear can only be equipped in towns or at an Arsenal Station.  If you are a new recruit and have just emerged from your crash pod, make your way to the Rescue Camp.  Once you reach the Rescue Camp you can equip your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.
mission.properties|o.darkest_forces: Learn about the most powerful fiend and undead monsters
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_pu: A short torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
guild.properties|i.guild_log: Examine recorded events within the guild.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2b: Do the gremlins have a leader?
item.properties|f.nodeslime_helm: A menacing mask of malice made from obliterated ominous ooze.
item.properties|f.supply_deluxe_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This deluxe pack has enough supplies to last an entire squad of Knights one week.
item.properties|f.pvp_bomb: Creates a cross-shaped blast that increases in size with power ups.  Does not require charging to use.
item.properties|f.grand_tortoise: A shield empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. The very plates of this colossal carapace shake as the unstable energy within waits to be unleashed.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_final: Just one more room lies between you and the elevator out of here. Remember what you have learned so far and you'll do just fine... at least that's the theory. Try not to die, ok?
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_234: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_shad: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
helptips.properties|m.confirm_energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to confirm spending energy.
mission.properties|o.pioneers: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1c: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
conversation.properties|m.npc_campguard_: We're resting here for a while before we journey deeper into the Clockworks.
mission.properties|o.p_fast_advancement: Quickly power up your Knight's gear\!
chat.properties|m.unknown_command: Unknown command {0}. Use /help to list commands.
item.properties|f.blackened_crest: A shield once carried by a knight of Almire, now a cursed relic that has been nearly burned beyond recognition within the Firestorm Citadel. Very powerful alchemy would be required to restore it to its former glory.
item.properties|f.lite_shield: A lightweight knight light that offers holistic protection.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
helptips.properties|m.graveyard: Graveyards are an unnatural place, a world between worlds where dark spirits gather, hungry for the life of any live soul that must pass through.  You must hurry and find the exit as fast as possible before these phantoms awaken and stalk you\!
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_shield: A spiny buckler forged from beast chitin, providing ample resistance to both heat and venom.
item.properties|f.driftwood: A peculiar piece of wood that just won't stay put.
help.properties|m.monster_slime: Deal PIERCING - Weak to SHADOW - Strong against PIERCING
item.properties|f.firebreak_helm: An Emberbreak Helm modified to provide further protection against fire.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_2a: What happened here? These remains look to be hundreds of years old...
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_5b: And don't worry about applying skill points the 'wrong way,' since you will eventually gain enough skill points to max out all your skills\!
item.properties|f.armor_rear: An accessory that can be attached to the rear of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|o.alien_ooze: Rescue the field research team from a lichen colony
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_mask: An upgraded Skelly Mask infused with the elemental essence of fear. Wearing it makes the hair on the back of your neck stand up.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_10a: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_3de017: Pay a visit to Emberlight, the town of gremlin outcasts.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: Well met\! When I heard they were sending you {0}, I didn't believe it. THE Vanquisher of Vanaduke\! It's an honor to be reporting to you.
item.properties|f.heater_shield: A shield with a built-in furnace that keeps its user toasty warm, protecting them from most freeze attacks. Many knights also use it as a makeshift stove top when out in the field.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_5a: You don't understand, do you? You simply don't have a choice.
chat.properties|m.inv_cannotinvite: You may not invite others (the party is locked or full).
projectx.properties|m.confirm_mode_chang: Mode changed. Click to accept within {0} or the\nmode will automatically revert to the previous setting.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_2a: Nice to meet you, {0}.  What's your situation?
guild.properties|m.theme_change_warning: You are paying to install this theme. If for any reason it is removed you will have to pay to install it again.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_ro: A festive new years snipe that will explore its surroundings.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_1: Well met, {0}\! Glad to see Spiral HQ sent us some reinforcements, and not a moment too soon\! Our backs are against the wall and we need your help\!
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: (For the first time since you've known him, Hahn is silent. He seems to be contemplating your findings very carefully.)
item.properties|f.angelic_raiment: A beautiful suit of armor that constantly shines as if illuminated by the sun.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.wicked_whisker: A whisker won from the great Kat Tribe hero, Margrel. They were traditionally worn as a ward against Owlite magics but now represent the triumph of goodly magical arts over evil.
conversation.properties|m.mission_lab_by: Our guards were overwhelmed.  We never stood a chance.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
sprites.properties|d.scorching_barrier: Increases the number of orbiting fireballs and their size.
projectx.properties|p.use_style_kit: Spend 1,000 crowns to modify your style?
auction.properties|e.please_wait: The auction house is busy, please wait a moment and try again.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_amazing: Contains three amazing eye shapes for your style kit\: Clover, Skull, and Circuitry.
item.properties|m.weapon_tip_locked: Weapon Slot (Buy Weapon Slot Upgrade to Unlock)
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_4a: Hey, it looks like one of the sprites has taken a liking to you\! Well, let's not let that extra power go to waste, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. You use your new friend to help clear the rest of the area of hostiles.
mission.properties|r.cwt_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
item.properties|f.furni_rainbow: A magnificent arc of refracted light. What does it mean?
logon.properties|m.version_mismatch: Your client needs to be updated. Please quit and restart.
chat.properties|m.usage_trade: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message on the trade channel.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_a: I always carry a variety of gear... just in case.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: But what about you and the others?
item.properties|f.combuster: Combining the principles of the Skylark's engines with the technology powering the Blast Furnace produced this brutal blade, which can ignite even the most flame-retardant materials at a distance.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_4a: Before you go, here's a few materials to get you started.  Good luck.
item.properties|f.plasmatech_demo_suit: A demo suit commissioned by King Krogmo to celebrate the launch of Blast Network. It's the perfect attire for formal detonation, or for more casual explosions.
chat.properties|m.usage_broadcast: Usage\: /{0} message\nBroadcasts message to everyone online.
item.properties|f.thwack_hammer: A spirited spanner specially suited to scrapping mechanical enemies.
item.properties|f.vial_shock: A glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
item.properties|f.super_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with potent icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The drakon sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_gourmet: Contains various unique costumes and weapons used by battle chefs. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.spell_book: An old dictionary that seems to have quite a few spells within it.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: We almost didn't make it out alive. One moment everything was fine and the next thing we know gremlins are bursting out of the ground\!
item.properties|f.cold_snap: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of frost upon detonation.
item.properties|f.freezing_atomizer: A powerful alchemical bomb that produces a dense cloud of extremely frigid mist.
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak: A simple feathered cloak. Adorn yourself in down and get down for the new year.
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_suit: A suit snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells a bit sweaty.
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro_1a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
projectx.properties|m.suggestion_message: Please enter your comment or suggestion. If you need more space,\nfeel free to send an e-mail to suggestions@spiralknights.com.
projectx.properties|m.deposit_minerals: Gather minerals and deposit them in any gate in the Arcade.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies deception and debilitation. Its skills focus on subterfuge\: caustic quills fire poisonous quills that explode when followed with an attack, shadow cloak allows a knight to become invisible to monsters, and hexing haze allows the knight to inflict monsters with a timed damage blast. \n\nThe maskeraith is best suited for knights who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks.
guild.properties|m.remove_expansion: Removing this expansion will lower upkeep but will also remove any installed rooms in the expansion. Any furnishings in the expansion will be returned to the Guild Treasury.\nYou will lose the following rooms\: {0}
chat.properties|m.usage_level: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield) [level]\nSets the equipment to that level.
logon.properties|m.server_error: A server error caused authentication to fail.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_1a: Yes, I'd like to ask you a few things.
item.properties|f.spiral_scale_helm: A light mail helm that slightly shields oneself from piercing strikes.

mission.properties|b.a_call_to_arms: A frantic emergency comlink message broadcasts across all channels.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_2: Our advance has ground to a halt because of that artillery on the walls pinning us down.  Earlier, we staged a diversion to allow a small squad of knights to break through the front to silence that artillery...but they seem to have failed.  Now they're trapped in there, and we're stuck out here\! \n\nI need you to break through the front lines, get inside the artillery control center, and find a way to take out those cannons for good\!  Meanwhile, I'll get the troops reorganized so we can follow up your assault.  Good luck in there, soldier\!
projectx.properties|m.find_rhendon: Find and talk to Rhendon to gain access to missions.
item.properties|f.exp_west_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_3a: An intense sadness radiates from his fallen form.  His eyes fade and a darkness washes over him.  Arkus is lost.

item.properties|f.catalyzer: An advanced alchemical armament adapted from Gremlin mining and demolition devices. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
mission.properties|b.ending_in_fire: A strange energy anomaly has been been detected in the levels just above the Core.  Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2b: All traces of Compound 42 should be eliminated, along with the facility and any engineers not part of the inner fold. Remind the scorchers who find these orders uncomfortable that those who disobey shall soon hear my whisper in their ears. \n\nSeal the doors and burn everything to the ground.
mission.properties|o.toy_soldiers: Destroy the Mecha Knight factory's production center
item.properties|f.shadowtech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of concentrated shadow that split on impact.
conversation.properties|m.npc_onwatch_a: I can't talk right now. I'm on watch.
item.properties|f.static_clinger: A latent strand of energy that floats throughout the Clockworks, frequently catching on hair and clothing. It's too large to properly distill into Energy, but it's very useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.vial_poison: A glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: The sinister mask formerly worn by Vanaduke, Lord of the Firestorm Citadel. It's far too big for a knight to wear.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of dark matter.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_helm: A hardy helm crafted from overly oppressive ooze.

item.properties|l.needs_sprite: Requires completion of Rank 2-3 Mission, 'An Eternal Bond' to use this item.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: If only there were some way to open up those gates\!
mission.properties|b.silent_legion:
Guardian Knight Arkus was one of the finest warriors serving the Spiral Knights until some time shortly after the crash.  As one of the first to search for the Alpha Squad, Arkus's own squad perished in a grisly battle with a horde of dust zombies.  Since then, Arkus has blamed himself for their loss, saying that he betrayed his Guardian's Oath to protect his squad. 

Arkus now journeys into the Clockworks alone, never risking the loss of another squad and we believe, somehow trying to find the squad he once lost.  As these expeditions began to appear self-destructive, Spiral HQ issued him a direct order to cease. 

Arkus ignored these orders and has gone deep into the Clockworks and not returned.  Not wanting to lose the last member of his squad, Spiral HQ is asking you to pursue him to his last known whereabouts, some kind of mysterious statuary at depth 26.
item.properties|f.sun_shards: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in solar-charged Luminite. Whatever you do, don't look directly at it.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_5a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
item.properties|f.crest_of_ur: A crest from the lost Legion of Ur, an elite band of fiendish warriors said to have once conquered the Underworld. Whomever holds it can faintly hear the sound of drums and the clomping of hooves.
item.properties|f.silver_key: A special key that can open any lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_4: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing 5 Star gear and receive certification
mission.properties|b.darkest_depths: Having defeated the Roarmulus Twins and recovered the Alpha Squad recon module, it's time to check in with Intel Agent Kora to get a report on the analysis of the module and information about your new access to some of the deepest depths of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.token_winter: A tiny wishlist created by one of the children of Emberlight. It signifies that you fufilled their holiday wishes and saved Winterfest. Doesn't that just fill you with cheer?
mission.properties|o.new_threat: Confront a dangerous new threat to Haven
mission.properties|r.guardians_of_cradle: It would be my honor, Captain.
item.properties|f.skelly_shield: A bedeviled buckler best used for blocking bad energy.
item.properties|d.remove_accessory: WARNING\! Deleting an accessory from an item will destroy the accessory.
item.properties|f.volcanic_pepperbox: When encamped in dangerous territory, the Volcanic Pepperbox is perfect for roasting both marshmallows and enemies.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_3a: Yes, at this point you must begin forming an arsenal that protects you against special damage types. \n\nYour current missions will have you facing monsters with piercing damage attacks.  Thus, you must begin acquiring helmets, armor and shields that defend against piercing damage.
helptips.properties|m.atg_cblocks: Hit a CRYSTAL BLOCK to destroy other crystal blocks of the same color.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_773357: Defeat the Roarmulus Twins in the dangerous depths of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6b: I'd like to see the services. (Follow Tylen)
conversation.properties|r.rfc_court_6b: I don't see or hear any of those things.
sprites.properties|d.frenzied_firestorm: For every monster caught in the blaze, you and your party have a chance of receiving an attack power and speed bonus.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_5a: Once again, lots of empty transport crates. Trouble is brewing, {0}. You best go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
item.properties|f.furni_shelf_manor_book: An unassuming shelf filled unworldly tomes of unspeakable power.
item.properties|f.master_blast_bomb: An incredibly powerful explosive typically used in mining, now issued somewhat recklessly for use in combat.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_10a: Rulen was very... logical.  I think he was very aware of the odds we have of reaching the Core and then doing something with it in order to restore the Skylark.  I think Rulen knew exactly what kind of mission he was undertaking when they made their first descent into the darkness of the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_a: I just need to rest a bit before moving on.
item.properties|f.vial_stun_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!

mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.scalding_hot_cocoa: A singeing splash of sweet destruction awaits any foe that goes for this mug before it's had a chance to cool.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_4a: Vatel here will sell you a selection of recipes as well as personal color changers and other items.
item.properties|f.token_grim: A small wisp of the essential spirit of darkness and decay. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_1a: Hello there little one. You look as though you require knowledge of some kind.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_2a: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
item.properties|f.lockdown_striker_shiel: A speed-enhancing device used by Strikers, the hard-hitting shock troopers of the Spiral Order.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Well, I won't dishonor them by giving up now. We've come so far after all. 'Time to be a hero again\!' Right, {0}?
mission.properties|b.rise_or_fall: Infiltrating the Royal Jelly Palace and taking on the hordes of slimes that serve the great Royal Jelly is not going to be an easy task.  It is highly recommended you seek one of the 'Battle Arenas' within the Clockworks and determine if your equipment is up to the challenge of facing so many savage slimes. \n\nSpiral HQ has located one of these mysterious arenas that seems to be filled with all manner of gooey gladiators seeking a challenge.  Give them a good fight\!
mission.properties|m.pioneers_5a: Euclid wasn't your typical knight.  By the time most in his division were getting their Squire crest, he had already achieved Vanguard.  As a Squad Leader, he lead a series of successful assaults against the Morai during the liberation of Isora.  A brilliant tactician, he was known for getting the job done with half the knights of other squads.
chat.properties|m.usage_reboot: Usage\: /{0} minutes message\nSchedules a server reboot.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_2a: Strangers like Quillion here sell you weapons and armor.  Each one specializes in a particular kind of item, so talk to them and find out what they carry. They're not very chatty, but they always have a fresh stock of items every day\! \n\nJust be sure that you've reached the appropriate rank to equip an item\!
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_1a: Congratulations on becoming a Soldier, {0}\!  I hear you really gave that Snarbolax a clobbering, well done\! \n\nWe've had an opportunity to analyze Euclid's recon module you discovered in the Snarbolax's lair.  Based on the recording, it seems that Euclid suspected something our Geo Knights discovered sometime after the crash- that the levels within the Clockworks are comprised of terrain from multiple alien worlds\!

uplink.properties|m.tf2_end:
To Whom It May Concern\: 

I have confirmed your arrival at the Clockworks Terminal, and have obtained the relevant data regarding our competitor's catalog. Mann Co. appreciates your cooperation in this task. 

In return for your assistance, we have remitted to you one (1) Mann Co. Brand "Spiral Sallet" replica headwear. No refunds or exchanges will be offered for this reward, and Mann Co. is not liable for any injury sustained while attempting to use said reward. 

Regards, 

Mister Reddy 
Mann Co. 
"We sell products and get in fights." 

The information in this mail is confidential and is intended solely for the addressee. Access to this mail by anyone else is unauthorized. If you are not an intended recipient, you must not read, use, think about, eat or seduce the information contained in this mail. Failure to comply with this request will result in the recipient being mauled by bears to within the fullest extent of the law.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on direct assault\: firebolt creates an explosive projectile, flame barrier surrounds its knight with protective fireballs, and firestorm creates a massive wave of flames. \n\nThe drakon is best suited for fearless knights who prefer frontline, destructive combat.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_pu: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a purple glow with a gentle hiss.

item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_bl: A short torch filled with bizarre blue fire.
item.properties|f.maskeraith_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Maskeraith Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
mission.properties|b.prestigious_opportu: It seems you have been excelling in the eyes of Spiral HQ.  Contact Intel Agent Kora and learn how you can take on extra missions from Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_f: I keep a sword around for close encounters.

item.properties|f.wicked_idol: One of many statuettes carried by fiends as a means of gaining favor with their dark gods. The most valuable ones are 'MIBE' (mint in box of evil).
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_1a: Well thanks Hahn, it's almost as if-

support.properties|m.option_203_0:
You have to be 13 years or older to play this game. If someone admits in chat that they are under 13 then please click here to file the complaint against them.

Do NOT use this option if you simply believe the player to be underage, as there has to be proof in the last few minutes of chat. If there is no proof, then you should drop the complaint.

uplink.properties|m.wildwoods_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within this forest.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

This forest is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area.  Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible. 

Good luck\!
item.properties|f.groundbreaker_armor: A suit of armor worn by knights who were among the first to brave the depths of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_7: Once you're ready to transmute the item, click 'Transmute' and hold your breath\!
item.properties|f.blaze_pepper: A delectable spice prized by Clockwork denizens of all sorts. In powdered form, it has a terrible habit of clinging to absolutely everything.
item.properties|f.mug_misery: A cursed drinking utility that can only be used by a truly wicked soul. Those that possess it are said to bring grave misfortune to those around them.
item.properties|f.barrier_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The elemental resiliency of a tortodrone on the Long Migration should aid you on your own journies through harsh environments.
dungeon.properties|m.lobby_desc: A lobby before entering a gate where knights can strategize and gear up for the adventure to come.
item.properties|f.volcanic_demo_suit: Highly protective gear for the cutting-edge demolition man. The internal cooling system makes you feel a little like you've been cryogenically frozen.
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_wolf_ho: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. It is said that the polar twilight is a wonderous sight to behold.
conversation.properties|r.core_tech_3: I'll continue to explore the Clockworks and collect the minerals needed for your research.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
sprites.properties|d.violent_heart_attac: Targets destroyed while enchanted create an explosion.
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
item.properties|f.furni_crate_toughbox_w: It's filled with dangerous explosives and razor-sharp swords\! Keep out of reach of children.
