craft.properties|m.name: Name
item.properties|f.blitz_needle: For when suppression just isn't good enough, the Blitz Needle specializes in "oppressive fire".
item.properties|f.slime_lockbox: A slippery, slimy lockbox won at the Golden Slime Casino.  It contains one of many special items.  It can be opened with a Slime Key or a Silver Key.
item.properties|f.gh_env_rain_torrent: A environment with almost too much rain.
item.properties|f.storm_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to ride the lightning into battle.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_ora: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits an orange glow with a gentle hiss.
helptips.properties|m.bramble: Some areas are overgrown with bramble that will hurt you if you run through it\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_healpad: Stand on a HEART GENERATOR to restore your health\!
helptips.properties|m.tg3_end: Seems like you have a good grasp on the basics. I think you're ready to join the rest of the recruits in the Sparrow Gate. There you will learn how to work as a party. There's a lot of recruits out there depending on you now. Great job\!
item.properties|f.toy_soldier_crown: A gleaming crown worn by elite Toyland units and those who smell faintly of varnish.
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_1a: I have lingered in halls even after all these long centuries, denied my eternal rest by my cursed lord. I feel his spirit clinging onto this shattered realm even now. He refuses to leave and thus dooms us all.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_3b: Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.
helptips.properties|m.clockwork_tunnels: There are strange sounds and energies emanating from the Clockworks. Delve deep and unravel its mysteries but be careful not to get caught in the mechanisms.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_1: Welcome to the battle arena\! The only rule is that you must fight at least once to move on. Should you claim victory, it will be up to you to decide to fight for even more glory\!
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Hello {0}, it seems you had few problems with the oozing hordes and their like which can no doubt be chalked up to a good education on their behaviors prior to the mission.

item.properties|f.exp_west_5f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the western side of the Guild Hall.

item.properties|f.magister_robe: A ceremonial robe worn by learned masters of the arcane arts, who often leave their keys in one of the many inner pockets.

mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_9a: Why yes, given their outward appearance I think 'maskeraith' suits them nicely\!
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: We were in the middle of receiving a report from Lieutenant Vaelyn's team at the Core Terminal when our signal was disrupted. It took some time, but I've managed to pinpoint the source of the disruption. It's coming from that strange device you discovered near Vanaduke's throne room in Firestorm Citadel.  It seems like someone has activated it.
helptips.properties|m.loading6: If you become poisoned you will not be able to heal yourself. Avoid taking too much damage until it wears off.
helptips.properties|m.design:
Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to place.
Press DEFEND [[DEFEND]] to put away.
Press PREV_WEAPON [[PREV_WEAPON]] to rotate clockwise.
Press NEXT_WEAPON [[NEXT_WEAPON]] to rotate counter-clockwise.
item.properties|f.proto_sword: A small sword issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r6: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
item.properties|f.miracloth: A marvelous bolt of sublimely supple fabric.
item.properties|f.chroma_suit: A suit crafted from the hide of a chromalisk. Surprisingly, chromalisks seem to find the existence of these armors flattering.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of moonstone
item.properties|f.binding_essence: A strange, vile reagent thought to be harnessed by the Apocrea to build their structures. Once it gets on your skin it seems to never wash off. No, it must, you simply need to scrub harder. Harder, yes...
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_6: Many recipes require an equip-able, leveled item.  These are called 'special items' in a recipe and you are free to select the special item you wish, provided it's the correct item. \n\nThis is useful if the recipe calls for an item that you have two copies of, but one is superior.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_cb03dd: Earn clearance to explore Tier 3 of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_3: A ceremonial sword issued to Champions of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_end: Great job\! With another successful run through the Training Grounds you should be getting the hang of things by now. It won't be long before you are exploring the depths of the Clockworks on your own.
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_3a: It seems to lead to some kind of elevator, but with no power, the whole thing is just dead.
guild.properties|e.statue_deploy_limit: Sorry, only {0} knight statues may be placed in a hall at once. To add this statue, please remove another one.
item.properties|f.gold_wolf_hood: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Gold Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_gunn: Howdy {0}, the name's Daxen. I'm a knight who specializes in gunslinging.  The recipes I have for you produce weapons and gear that focus on ranged combat... you know, shootin' stuff. \n\nHandguns allow you to hit your enemies from a safe distance, but don't offer you many options once they close in on ya.  You've got to think and shoot fast to be a good gunslinger.  The gear I specialize in will make you a dead shot, not a dead knight.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  I hear you've recently arrived in Haven from across the great chasm.  While you were out there, did you encounter any of our battle sprites?
item.properties|f.fierce_flamberge: A scorching saber whose main thrust is to rotisserie your foes.
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: Here's a jelly gem for ya...
item.properties|f.primal_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it you can sense the natural energy within waiting to be unleashed.
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the amount of energy you want to buy, in multiples of 100.
pvp.properties|m.super_brawl-info: Super Brawl is a fantastic, free-for-all fight for up to eight knights\! You will be awarded points for defeating other contestants and lose points for being defeated. The contestant with the most points at the end of the five-minute round wins\!
item.properties|f.poison_barrier: Surrounds you with toxic orbs that can cripple hostiles
item.properties|f.mad_bomber_mask: A sturdy helmet designed to keep out explosions, radio waves and high-tech mind control devices. At least, that's what they *want* you to think it does.
helptips.properties|m.elevator: The elevator will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
item.properties|f.exp_center_2f: An expansion that adds a large central meeting room to the Guild Hall.
chat.properties|m.usage_haven: Go to your last Haven place.
item.properties|f.potocrowns: An unlucky thing for your foes to find, it explodes in a painful blow.
item.properties|f.frost_gun: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity, alchemical freezing agent.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_2a: Who doesn't right?  Let's head over to Punch and Vise's workshop.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4a: Your sprite will evolve as you level it up. At certain key levels your sprite will require an Evo Catalyst be fed to it in order to level up further. Once fed, your sprite will physically change its appearance\! \n\nIt will be interesting to see how these strange, new forms of battle sprites evolve in time.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_11: (He appears to be staring very intently at the corner.)
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3b: Each battle sprite will learn three skills that you can use in combat. Skills are learned automatically at certain levels as the sprite levels up. \n\nCombat skills become stronger with skill points.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.cosmic_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
mission.properties|b.vicious_viscous: Spiral HQ would like you to investigate levels of the Clockworks where the most powerful slime and beast monsters reside.  By exploring these levels and transferring your combat data back to Spiral HQ, all knights would ultimately benefit from your dangerous experience. \n\nIt is highly recommended that you equip yourself with piercing resistant gear with piercing and shadow damage weapons\!
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r9: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3c: Please take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
item.properties|f.bolted_blade: An upgraded Proto Sword reinforced with bronze bolts scavenged from the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.welcome_to_haven_b: Having survived the journey to Haven you must contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink and give her your report.  She has information as to what to do next.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_g: Have you seen a danger room yet? I hear they are really tough.
projectx.properties|i.cull_transients: Prevents display of some off-screen graphics effects\npossibly speeding up graphical performance, but may\ncause some effects not to appear.
item.properties|f.personal_height: Once used, this item will permanently change your Knight's height to the specified height.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_1a: What's this? Another poor soul ripe for harvest by the Apocrea?
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_2a: My knowledge is yours, little one.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
projectx.properties|e.no_lead_node: Service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
item.properties|f.shade_helm: A dark matter infused helm that allows its wearer to get the drop on foes by shooting straight from the shadows.
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_desc: A level where travelers can safely return to town, or journey further into the depths of the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.rescue_knight_: I've really been needing to stretch my legs.
conversation.properties|m.fc_greeter_2: May your end be mercifully swift.
chat.properties|m.unknown_flag: Unknown flag {0}. Use /help toggle to list flags.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_3: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 4 Star gear and receive certification
projectx.properties|m.reach_terminal_1: Delve into the Clockworks and find your way to the first Terminal.
chat.properties|m.usage_drain: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nDrains a player (yourself by default) of all mist energy.
dungeon.properties|m.moorcroft_desc: A mysterious old manor home to a number of restless spirits. Moorcroft Manor appears to act as a station stop for spirits in their travels, however none of them appear to actually be going anywhere in particular.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|m.use_harness: Use this item to add the {0} as an available harness for your battle sprites? \n\nOnce installed, all sprites capable of using this harness can select it via your sprite manager. This action cannot be undone.
logon.properties|m.temp_banned: This account has been temporarily suspended.
item.properties|f.shadow_steel: An extraordinary metal imbued with the creeping darkness of the Underworld.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_2: After the Skylark crashed, its primary tearium core exploded, destroying a portion of the ship and leaving it without a main power source. Since so far we haven't found several hundred tons of tearium just lying around, the bird has effectively lost its wings.\n\nWith the help of the Strangers, we were able to set up a small base of operations here in Haven. Once we got our systems online, we discovered that within the heart of this rock resonates a power signature of unprecedented magnitude.
item.properties|f.mighty_cobalt_armor: An advanced set of Spiral Knight armor skillfully crafted using the most recently deciphered Clockworks technology.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A squishy gem highly prized by slimes. This one was liberated from the Royal Jelly Palace and painstakingly preserved as a conversation piece.
mission.properties|o.choose_your_sprite: Talk to Morlin and choose a battle sprite as your companion
item.properties|f.valiant_visor: A lightweight visor for scouting and skirmishing, often highly accessorized.
mission.properties|b.mission_sprite_3: Rhendon is waiting for you in an abandoned gremlin chemical plant where reconnaissance has located a cache of missing battle sprites. Secure the sprites and clear the area of hostiles. You are authorized to utilize any sprites you secure in order to complete the mission.
mission.properties|r.heart_of_matter_2a: I've prepared for facing the Firestorm Citadel, you can count on me.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_1aa: More questions about battle sprites? How can I assist you?
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_heav: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
pvp.properties|m.refunded: You have been refunded your Coliseum entrance fee of {0} crowns.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 4 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r4: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_beast_: Maybe they want to play catch?
item.properties|f.alchemy_room: A utilitarian room equipped with two Alchemy Machines and a General Goods Merchant.
craft.properties|m.confirm_variants: This will replace all or some of the variants on your item. Are you sure?
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak_vol: A scorched feathered cloak. Set a fire under your feet and ensure punctuality as sure as the roosters crow.
mission.properties|o.spark_roar: Prove your valor against a legion of elite elemental monsters
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2b: What sort of challenges await me in the final gate?
item.properties|f.proto_bomb: A small bomb used by Spiral Knight recruits to learn the art of blowing things up.
guild.properties|log.mist_removed: Withdrew {0} mist energy from the energy well (new total\: {1}).
mission.properties|o.new_chapter: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last:
Yes, it is isn't it?  I should not have come here alone.  I should have stayed with my squad. 

(Edger looks off into the distance) 

I don't even remember how it happened.... maybe I never will.  But it didn't hurt.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_remin: Once you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. Once we are all reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.\n\nPlease hurry\!
mission.properties|b.shadow_knows: Biotech Hahn has suggested that given your recent promotion, you are ready to learn about the nefarious monsters within the Clockworks that inflict shadow damage. Contact him via comlink and see what he has to say.
social.properties|m.levels_completed: become the new Level Leader, having completed {0} levels in the past 7 days\!
item.properties|f.divine_mantle: A heavenly cloak thought to be once worn by celestial sages.
helptips.properties|m.loading17: Check out forums.spiralknights.com. Be a part of the conversation\!
conversation.properties|m.tortodrone_hav: Spiral HQ has us investigating reports that pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter are appearing all over the Clockworks. Kora believes the Fiends are up to something. There is evidence they played a hand in the disappearance of the tortodrones.
mission.properties|b.time_to_crafty: Bosco would like you to alchemize a Hot Edge and Frost Gun for him to inspect. If it's good, he'll inform Spiral HQ that you've grasped the vital art of alchemy and even add a couple powerful Unique Variants to your new weapons.  What a generous guy\!
item.properties|f.padded_hunting_cap: An upgraded helm for hunters that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
item.properties|f.prize_box_cavalry: Contains various unique accessories and items to celebrate the Year of the Horse\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires one Golden Slime Coin or crowns if none are available.
item.properties|f.electron_charge: A small electro-explosive charge with mysterious origins. It is capable of generating a crippling vortex of electricity.
chat.properties|m.usage_set-ident: Usage\: /{0}\nSet this knight as your identity for posting in the forums.
mission.properties|r.explosive_plot_3a: It's because the Strangers took us in that they're now targeted...
item.properties|f.spitfire: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity burst of flame.
item.properties|f.static_flash: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of electricity upon detonation.
uplink.properties|m.bid_outbid: Visit the Auction House for another chance at this item\!
sprites.properties|d.ray_of_light: Fires a concentrated beam of light that damages anything passing through it.
auction.properties|m.cancel_support:
Are you sure?


Use your GM powers to cancel this auction and refund everyone involved?
mission.properties|m.pioneers_11a: Right, down to business.  We've located an Alpha Squad recon module in an area of the Clockworks known as the 'Gloaming Wildwoods.'  However, this particular zone is home to a horrible creature known as 'the Snarbolax.' \n\nThe Snarbolax has made fast work of Squires like yourself, but I know you can handle it, {0}. But you're going to need to prepare.  I've issued you a series of missions that will allow you to assemble a loadout fit for taking on this terrible beast and reclaiming that recon module\!
item.properties|m.pvp_token_upgrade.1: Gives {0} extra Krogmo Coin in PvP.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_5a: We all sensed the moment you defeated Vanaduke. The entire citadel shook as he fell and for a moment we thought that this realm would be destroyed along with its ruler. You must be careful wandering these halls with the place coming apart like this\!
item.properties|f.spiral_flak_jacket: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_2a:
You're eager, that's good.  Your current mission is to reach the town of Haven where Spiral HQ has set up base.  Spend the time you need within the Rescue Camp to prepare yourself for your journey to come. 

Make use of any traveling merchants as well as the knowledge of other knights in the camp to learn how to survive in this new world.  I will contact you again once you reach Haven. 

Good luck to you.
item.properties|f.pollinator_plate: Styled after the unsung heroes of the hive. Fashionable, functional, and a little fuzzy.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 3 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_3: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 3 star item.
item.properties|f.winter_onesie: The perfect pajamas for passing out presents or patiently waiting for Impostoclaus' presence.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3a: Energy is a very special power that is constantly emanating from the core of this world. It is totally stable and will never be lost unless traded or spent. (You can see how much energy you have on the energy module in your arsenal.)
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_mail: Mythical armor crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
conversation.properties|m.core_resting_3: I hope those supplies come soon.
item.properties|f.polar_night_warden_hoo: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for hours of nighttime watch duty.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
chat.properties|m.usage_complain: Usage\: /{0} player name\nFile a complaint against the specified player.
item.properties|f.spoiled_treat: A terrible tummy ache awaits those who partake in the fetid fare of Winterfest past.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3a: Feeding your sprite materials is the fastest way to level it up. Talk to Biscotti here in the Lab for more information on sprite feeding.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_7: Now that you know about the Forge, would you like to give it a look?
item.properties|f.raiders_hammer: An ornate hammer infused with the power of a great storm, it's as cutting-edge as a blunt weapon can be.
conversation.properties|m.mission_lab_by: We formed a barricade around the Artifact but it was overrun. I'm sorry...
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Biotech Hahn for research.
helptips.properties|m.tut_chromalisks: Those chroma whelps up ahead can lash you with their tongues from afar. Avoid facing them when they get ready to strike.
conversation.properties|m.npc_survivorkn: They came from the darkness. There was no time to react.
projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in_notice:
By enabling this option, you will gain access to knight-created arenas.
You can browse, test, and play community-made content, as well as upload your own.

All arenas are subject to approval by coliseum crew before becoming part of the playable pool.
Please review the information and terms before continuing.
mission.properties|b.another_trace: The technicians in the Haven Laboratory report that their tracking system has finally been repaired and brought back online. Intel Agent Kora would like to bring you up to speed on the challenges ahead. Contact her via comlink for the details.
mission.properties|b.faith_armor:
An apprentice named Wilks who had just arrived from a Rescue Camp has found himself in what Spiral HQ calls a 'Trap Chamber.'  These levels of most likely gremlin design seem to be specifically built to trap and ultimately eliminate those attempting to explore the Clockworks. 

Wilks probably didn't know what he had got himself into until it was too late.  Now he's stuck somewhere in the chamber and needs your help. 

Some traps can be avoided and sometimes you may find that you just have to take the hit. In saving Wilks, you will no doubt learn the true value of strong armor.
craft.properties|e.wrong_item_group: Variant cannot be applied to this item type.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A scaled-down model of the Royal Jelly. He'd probably be flattered by it if he hadn't already been flattened.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5b: Get energy and do amazing things- got it\!
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.valkyrie_mail: A priceless set of armor whose name denizens of the Underworld dare not mention.
help.properties|m.support_4: To report a bug in the game, press F2. Keep in mind that bug reports are not answered, but they include non-personal debug information that helps track down the root of the problem. If you need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_3a: Exactly, and they're worse now.  And the same goes for the undead.  You'll find that howlitzers become particularly bothersome with their enhanced firing and homing capabilities. \n\nLastly, prepare for fiend and undead monsters to potentially deal pure shadow damage.  As always, choose the right gear for the job should you want to live long enough to hear from me again.
item.properties|f.angelic_cuirass: A beautifully ornate costume armor designed to evoke a heavenly connection.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_9a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
mission.properties|m.true_champion_3a: You can always count on me\! \n\nNow then, I'm sure you've got lots to do.  We're going crazy over here trying to make heads or tails over that recon module you discovered outside of the Core.  How the heck could the Alpha Squad have 'entered' the Core?
item.properties|f.prize_box_construct: Contains various unique Construct-themed costumes and items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: Eeeek\! No no no\! B-but it's not ready yet...\!  I guess I have no choice\! \n\nSparkcaster Deluxe....activate\!
item.properties|f.grim_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. Shadows seem to lengthen and cling to it whenever it is brought to bear.
mission.properties|o.prestigious_opportu: Contact Intel Agent Kora and receive Prestige Mission authorization
item.properties|f.bechamel_room: A trendy room where Bechamel can add or remove Accessories from your favorite equipment.
conversation.properties|m.mission_apocre: If you're going further, be on your guard. I smell a trap.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_5a: A recon squad has managed to track down where many of these battle sprites have landed.  Rhendon has been sent ahead to scout out three of these sites and will meet up with you in the Clockworks. \n\nYou must secure our battle sprites before they fall into enemy hands\!
uplink.properties|i.crystal: The amount of energy to attach.
item.properties|f.radiant_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within is wild and mysterious, shining brighter than any natural fire.
item.properties|f.casting_cone: A cap for comfortable casting. Conical, but no laughing matter.
item.properties|f.dusker_coat: A warm adventurer's coat that'll let you strike with the ferocity of an Alpha Dusker.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: Great, thanks for being a good ambassador\! \n\nI'll contact you again soon, good luck {0}\!
item.properties|f.cosmic_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
projectx.properties|m.enqueued: Please be patient; we are currently experiencing high server load.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_1a: Well met, {0}, Champion of the Spiral Knights.  Your service to our cause has been of the highest caliber.  Without you, reaching the Core would still be a dream.  Now, we have a chance of actually restoring the Skylark and returning home.
mission.properties|m.intro_rank: Rank Missions are the main campaign of Spiral Knights. Completing Rank Missions earns you rewards and allows you to achieve higher ranks as a Spiral Knight.
helptips.properties|m.alpha_recon: This recon module was left by a member of the Alpha Squad.  The recording it contains has been copied to your Arsenal.
projectx.properties|m.confirm_return: Are you sure you want to return to {0}?
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Victory is ours\!
item.properties|f.sinister_skelly_suit: A bony barrier that throbs with malevolence. Anyone skeptical of this suit's power deserves a good ribbing.
guildhelp.properties|l.storage_console: The Guild Storage can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
redeem.properties|e.max_attempts: You have tried too many invalid codes. Try again in a few minutes.
item.properties|f.tabard_rose: An aged, embroidered tabard that once belonged to a Knight of the Rose, a sacred order of brave and especially dashing heroes whose numerous adventures are the subject of many folk tales. The Knights of the Rose were said to be peerless fencers, believing that their blades were like the flowers of their name\: a delicate thing of beauty that hides a vicious sting.
item.properties|f.voltaic_radical_mask: A mask said to be replicated by a sentient mechaknight. The internal gyros and shock crest are sure to obscure your identity.
auction.properties|e.bid_insufficient: You must bid at least {0} crowns.
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_1: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  Made from fractured mask fragments, it only somewhat resembles the original.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Firepower will only get you so far, {0}.  Case in point, the gremlins are no doubt strong on their own, what with just sheer numbers and all, but these little, furry geniuses sought to also bolster their strength by creating an army of constructs.
mission.properties|o.chilled_to_bone: Investigate the shadowy remains of the Candlestick Keep
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Apologies for not appearing in person. I'm hidden away in a safe place. I knew I'd never make it there in time when I noticed your signal. Luckily I was able to pull some strings and find you an exit.
helptips.properties|m.recon: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to activate Recon Module.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Don't worry about Feron, he'll be healed up in no time.
item.properties|f.gigawatt_pulsar: A powerfully enhanced handgun that hits foes with the force of a lightning bolt. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
sprites.properties|d.crystal_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal elemental damage. \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Seraphynx
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3c: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_ebcd68: Defeat the Royal Jelly squatting in the Royal Jelly Palace.
mission.properties|r.reporting_duty_2a: If we could somehow harness that power...

uplink.properties|m.firestorm_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, at your current depth establishing communications is difficult- I hope you receive this message.  You currently stand in the Firestorm Citadel, some kind of ancient fortress that this planet apparently like to collect.  It is an incredibly hostile region of the Clockworks, you will not last long without the right gear and a talented squad. 

We have detected a faint signal that indicates some kind of artifact of the Alpha Squad's expedition is located within the throne room of this citadel.  We need you to recover this artifact- it could be a valuable clue for discovering their current whereabouts. 

I won't lie to you, no squad that has taken this mission has managed to return from the citadel.  As you have no doubt seen, the place burns with an unnatural fire and a legion of similarly unnatural horrors roam every hall.  Now may be a good time to turn back and craft some fire-resistant gear.  A trial by fire will only get you burned. 

Good luck\!

guildhelp.properties|m.emporium_info:
The Birdsong Emporium allows high-ranking guild members to purchase items for the guild using funds from the Guild Treasury. These items include various Guild Hall furniture items and upgrades. Purchased items go directly into the Guild Treasury, and thus cannot ever be removed from the guild.
 Furniture comes in a variety of types and sizes and is used to decorate your Guild Hall's rooms and halls to make them feel more like home. Some furniture even has special effects when activated\! Any furniture currently in your Guild Treasury can be placed into the Guild Hall using Design Mode.
 The Birdsong Emporium is also where you purchase Guild Upgrades that enhance your guild's capabilities, such as by increasing its maximum member count.
 As a Guild Hall's size increases by adding expansions, the selection of items available in the Birdsong Emporium's catalog also increases. Be sure to check back often to see what's available\!

mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft3:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, intel has located a black kat nest beyond an area with electrifying resistance. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!

mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc3: The renaming item will be consumed.
item.properties|f.blighted_bone: A peculiar patella that's seen better days, after having seen a few better knights.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_skbedrol: A soft sleeping bag perfect for whenever you're "roughing it". For a Spiral Knight stranded on Cradle, this is most of the time.
conversation.properties|m.mission_locked: We were securing the elevator when the door shut behind us.
guild.properties|m.motd_changed: {0} changed the message of the day\: {1}
item.properties|f.shroom_cap: It's no small truffle, you'll be cute as a button in this fungi looking cap.
item.properties|f.token_winter_wishlist: This Winterfest wishlist was lost long ago. It lists warm linens that protect from the snow. Randolph will reward those knights with a stack. So bring them to him and earn a present back.
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll help any way I can, Pembrooke.
chat.properties|m.usage_away: Usage\: /{0} message\nNotes that you have left the keyboard.
mission.properties|b.advanced_alchemy: Now that you have achieved the rank of Soldier, Bosco in the Haven Bazaar has some new information for you regarding advanced forms of alchemy.  Pay him a visit and learn about the hidden potential in some weapons and gear\!
item.properties|f.boosted_plate_helm: A Spiral Plate Helm with a supercharged internal power source. It's a little hard to see out of.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_6a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a CHARGE ATTACK, so make sure to evade monsters while charging\! \n\nFeel free to give it a try.  Just remember to equip it at that arsenal station up ahead.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I just put in another bulk order for office supplies. We keep running out.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires 50 Golden Slime Coins or equivalent crowns.
item.properties|f.celestial_shield: Cradle's equinox inspired the dual nature of this specialist shield, which protects against the dazzling light of day and the chill of night in equal measure.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: You... I... What was that? Did you say something?
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_w: Glorp\! Glorp\! Winterfest is saved and one thing is clear\: all hearts now sing with holiday cheer\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_vitapods: Pick up VITAPODS to temporarily increase your maximum health until you return to Haven.
item.properties|f.ash_tail_cap: A warm hat made from hide tanned with blaze pepper. It smells faintly of curry.
mission.properties|m.a_call_to_arms1: This is Vaelyn at the Core Terminal. Team wiped out. Darkness everywhere. Send help. It is opening.
helptips.properties|m.tut_weapons_short: Use [[NEXT_WEAPON]] to cycle your equipped weapon.
item.properties|f.prize_box_obsidian: Contains various unique and terrifying items found within the realm of the Apocrea. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_mail: This gelatinous gear combines the sturdiness of stone with the piercing protection of sticky goo. It's a wonder that you managed to beat up the jelly this is made out of.
craft.properties|m.transmute_accessories: {0} does not support certain accessories.  {1} will be destroyed if you transmute. Are you sure?
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
mission.properties|b.search_continues: Lieutenant Vaelyn would like to thank you for opening up a path to the Core and allowing her to set up an on-site research base.
monster.properties|m.fired_2: Your productivity is down .03% this week. You're fired.
item.properties|f.obsidian_obelisk: A jet-black stele of unnatural stone from the realm of the Apocrea. As you gaze upon it the stone seems to writhe and pulse with an eternal energy that is simultaneously alluring and sinister in a most grotesque manner.
item.properties|f.nightblade: A short slicer infused with the essence of the Underworld.
support.properties|m.option_1_0: 1. Remember you can click on players and choose "Ignore" to block any chat and mail from them. Click here to ignore {0} and skip the complaint.
sprites.properties|d.heavy_smoke: Increases the defensive power and duration of the flame barrier.
item.properties|f.the_bitter_end: A shield carried by all members of the Recon Rangers. Its name is a reminder to all Rangers as to precisely when they are permitted to drop it in battle.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_1a: Hello {0}, and congratulations in rising to the rank of Champion.  Allow me to say that in my experience working with you that you are truly deserving of such a title.  It is because of you that so many knights have returned to the surface safely and that we know so much more about the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: A miniature model of one of the Roarmulus Twins. It is mercifully inactive.
item.properties|f.bronze_bolt: A simple bronze bolt found everywhere throughout the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.cosmic_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
item.properties|f.confetti_bubbles: Use this item to blow a cloud of bubbles into the air. See how long they last before they pop\!
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_14: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_4a: Yes, I suppose we just might.  Safe travels then, {0}.
item.properties|f.prize_box_extraordinar: Contains various unique costumes and items sure to revitalize your vigor and bring the pep back into your stride\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.guild_members_250: Allows your guild to recruit up to 250 members\!
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_5a: That's right, you can acquire recipes and materials in order to alchemize weapons and gear at alchemy stations.  Come on, I'll show you one.
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_power: Usage\: /{0} skill power value\nUpdates a sprite skill's power value.
projectx.properties|e.not_enough_appetit: Not enough appetite to consume this item.
conversation.properties|m.casino_jelly_c: One day I'll win enough to build my own palace\! Glorp glorp\!
item.properties|f.stoic_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
chat.properties|m.smell_format_targeted: {0} gets a big whiff of {1}. Whew\!
item.properties|f.ticket_unbind_4: Use this ticket at the Unbinding Forge to unbind a 4 star item.
item.properties|f.piggy_banker: A small volatile bank that is sure to burn a hole in your enemies' pockets.
item.properties|f.exp_east_2f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_shield: Crafted from the most adamant of slimy specimens, it also functions as an emergency source of calories for stranded knights.
helptips.properties|m.atg_blocks: Hit a breakable block to destroy it\!
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_3a: Roger that Hahn, talk to you soon.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_armo: A hardened set of armor made to protect against even the most voracious monsters while exploring the unknown.
uplink.properties|m.newsletter_resub: If you had previously subscribed to the newsletter, just confirm your email address and resubscribe to claim your Proto Crest accessory\!
uplink.properties|m.mission_rewards: Attention {0}\!  Our data shows that a recent mission you successfully completed, {1}, did not issue rewards to you following the end of the mission.  These rewards are enclosed in this mail. \n\nPlease accept these rewards, gear up and continue your adventure\!
mission.properties|o.the_gauntlet: Battle your way to the Firestorm Citadel through a bulwark of monstrous might
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: B-beware...they...they are everywhere...in the shadows...\!
helptips.properties|m.event_module: Warning\! An unidentified place of interest lies beyond this gate. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!
auction.properties|e.no_preview: Sorry, this item cannot be previewed with your current equipment.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_f: They say you're going to travel down this elevator and into the chasm below. You're a heck of a lot braver than I am...
item.properties|f.shako: A ceremonial cap worn by knights during highly prestigious occasions.
item.properties|f.tempered_calibur: A Calibur reforged and tempered by the most advanced techniques available to weaponsmiths of the Spiral Order.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_4a: Hah\! You'll never reach me in my 'Room of Invincibility'\! You'll be trapped in that control room forever\! ...Erm, wait. I might have overlooked something...
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Hang in there\!
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
item.properties|f.dead_gold: A coin placed into the hands of the dead before burial, granting them fare for the long journey ahead.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Not all, but most of them are believed to have been directly manufactured from gremlin design, yes.  We think that most were originally engineered during the building of the Clockworks.  Some remain under gremlin control, others have gone rogue and the rest have become something else entirely.
helptips.properties|m.loading16: Using a shield can help you completely avoid damage, so make sure to use it\! Press "[[DEFEND]]" to defend. As the shield takes damage it will turn red and eventually break. The shield must regenerate before it can be used again.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Clawers, the fearsome frontline fighters of the Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.raging_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and razed the gates of a heavenly kingdom.
item.properties|f.gremlonium: A highly advanced compound created by gremlin engineers to power their most devious machines.  It constantly emits an unsettling hissing sound.
item.properties|f.vial_curse_ultra: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
item.properties|f.prismatic_frosted_helm: A delicious helm made of cake created during the Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration. It uses a strange prismatic frosting developed in Biscotti's test kitchen that prevents it from ever spoiling.  Please don't eat it.
item.properties|f.raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings.
guild.properties|log.expansion_added: Added the {0} expansion for {1} crowns, plus {2} crowns for pro-rated upkeep.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_1: Well met {0}, it has been some time since I first met you having just arrived from the Rescue Camp.  You've come along way since then, rising to the rank of Defender Elite no less. \n\nYou are a gifted soldier, {0}.  I have no doubt you will soon be a Champion amongst the Spiral Knights and instrumental in our solving the great mystery that is the Core, restoring the Skylark and returning home.  You have proven that you have what it takes to face the legions of dark forces that lurk below the surface.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
uplink.properties|m.items_expired: You have items that have expired. Items can be repurchased from the Supply Depot.
support.properties|m.option_1_1: 2. If {0} has been offensive or harassing and has not stopped when asked, click here to file a complaint.
item.properties|f.gran_faust: An upgraded Faust forged from pristine-quality shadow steel. Its charge attacks are powerful enough to curse its wielder, but that hasn't stopped Devilites from treasuring these rare blades even more highly than their meager vacation time.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_gamepad_1: Gamepad used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands and quickslots
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2b: As a sprite levels up, they will learn new combat skills as well as gain skill points.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.nightmare_mane: A coat of coarse fur taken from a Snarbolax.  Each fiber seems to curl and fray as if life is still flowing through it.
item.properties|f.shock_raider_helm: A simple helm, shielding the wearer from the elements and enemies alike.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_5: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.plague_needle: Knights are divided on whether this gun's bolts pierce and then poison, or poison and then pierce. To the unlucky target, this distinction is irrelevant.
item.properties|f.sacred_hazard_armor: A sturdy suit of armor for those who want to shoot some slimes.
helptips.properties|m.tut_bash: When your shield is full, press [[SHIELD_BASH]] to bash and stun monsters\!
sprites.properties|d.maskeraith: The maskeraith is a battle sprite that embodies the shadows. Its skills focus on subterfuge and deadly toxins.
item.properties|f.jalovec: A shivery sword for knights who think it'd be cool to inflict an avalanche of pain upon their foes.
chat.properties|m.usage_game: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to everyone in the game.
item.properties|f.perfect_snowball: An icy snowball of almost mythical perfection. Though it begs to be thrown squarely into the side of someone's head, it would be best to use in alchemy.
item.properties|f.spiral_hood: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_4a:
Re\: Re\: Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

I've contacted Internal Affairs regarding the recent theft of an everfrost pillar and the 'disappearance' of nearly 1,000 devilite data entry associates, as I believe it to be directly related to your recently denied resource allocation request. 

Disciplinary action will be required.  Additionally, please fill out the attached Personal Improvement Plan and return it as soon as possible.
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: Always good to see another Spiral Knight\!
conversation.properties|m.hav_snipes_1a: Please be careful not to step on any of the snipes, little one.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_3a:
Aye, as do we all. 

Now then, {0}, you need to prepare for what's to come.  Reaching the Core is only the beginning for us.  I suspect that Spiral HQ will be issuing you many more missions in the future that could only be taken on by someone of your ability. 

And finally, it is my pleasure to inform you that you will soon be awarded one of the greatest honors of the Spiral Knights, the rank of Vanguard.  I will see you in the Hall of Heroes.
item.properties|f.fur_coat: An extra-toasty coat made from the hide of a furry beast.
item.properties|f.magic_cloak: A wondrous robe worn by apprentices in the art of spells and sorcery.
conversation.properties|m.guard_laborato: I'm sorry, {0}, you are not authorized to enter the lab yet.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_housepla: A breezy blue plant inside a cheerful pot.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
conversation.properties|m.hav_mecha_1a: I got a great deal on this broken mecha knight. If I can just figure out how to get it working properly I'll have myself a personal bodyguard for my expeditions into the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.night_cap_pith: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer a restorative night of sleep.
item.properties|f.prize_box_slumber: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Slumber style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_3a: Amazing that after all this time we didn't know the truth. I mean, we've suspected for a while now that this planet was some kind of prison but who could have guessed that this 'Swarm' was just waiting for someone to stumble across the Core and free it?
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_2: This is a party pad. It's a big floor button that only activates when all members of the party are standing on it. They often open doors, but sometimes there is a little more to it than that...
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_3c: Most of them will attack you on sight, but there are some; outcasts from the colony, that have taken refuge in the towns below the surface. Theirs is a hard life, hated by their own kind and no longer in a world they call home.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2d: Actually, I have to run. Maybe some other time...
item.properties|f.gel_drop: A drop of goo collected from a jelly. It's still quivering.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_helm: A mythical helmet crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
item.properties|f.mod_calibrator: This complicated device was specially built to calibrate mods, and should not be confused with a Calibrator Mod, which modifies calibrators. It's a common mistake.
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_mail: Thick armor reinforced with more metal plates than a Clockworks vending machine. It's a little uncomfortable.
helptips.properties|m.controls: Press [[TOGGLE_HELP]] at any time to view the controls.
mission.properties|r.pioneers_7a: Tell me about Squad Recon Parma.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_4a: I won't let them take me so easily.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_card: Please check that card number is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
item.properties|f.raptor: An ancient pistol imbued with enchantments designed to smite the fiendish creatures of the Underworld. Like its namesake, its bullets fly fast and strike with deadly force.
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_helm: A helm snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. Sounds are a bit muffled from inside.
mission.properties|o.elemental_my_dear: Learn about monsters that inflict elemental damage
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_12: I admire your courage but if initial reports of this construct monster are accurate, you'll need some additional help. I'll prepare a selection of battle sprites to be ready for bonding to you, {0}. We'll talk again once I've made the proper preparations.
auction.properties|m.no_search: Your search did not match any auctions.
board.properties|m.auto_create_party: Sorry, we could not find you an available party. Do you want to start your own party?
help.properties|m.clockworks_1: The Clockworks is your gateway to the planet's Core\! It's filled with a huge variety of worlds and populated with monsters and treasure beyond your imagination. Beware, however\: the deeper you go below the surface, the tougher and smarter your opponents will become\!
helptips.properties|m.loading15: To add a friend to your friends list, simply click on that friend and choose "Add as Friend." To see the list of friends and what they are up to, click on the Social button.
item.properties|f.buccaneer_box: Contains one of various unique items and accessories for buccaneers. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.scale_mail: A shimmering set of serpentine scales woven into a suit of armor.
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Greetings {0}, and congratulations on becoming a Squire\!  Your performance has caught the attention of Spiral HQ and they have given you authorization to now take on Prestige Missions. \n\nPrestige Missions are select missions offered to you daily that offer prestige as rewards for completion.  Sometimes these missions require supplying Spiral HQ or other Knights with items and other times they will have you exploring the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_shield: An antique shield whose origins have been lost to the passing of time.
item.properties|f.spike_shower: A powerful device designed to shred opponents with a snarl.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_9a: Okay then, let's start from the top.
chat.properties|m.usage_cheer: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCheer for your fellow players\!
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_pur: A tall torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
conversation.properties|r.emberlight_vis: I have enough info, thanks. (End conversation)
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_wasd_move_: Mouse used for targeting, attacking and menu navigation
item.properties|f.guild_members_150: Allows your guild to recruit up to 150 members\!
mission.properties|r.heart_of_matter_1a: Hello, Lieutenant.  How can I help you?
item.properties|f.sacred_ghost_armor: A spectral suit of armor for those who are gunning for ghosts.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r7: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.shadow_key: A mysterious key that grants a party entrance to Shadow Lairs.  A Shadow Key is destroyed once used.
item.properties|f.spur: A mechanized sword with a built in motor that generates energy bursts when used.
item.properties|f.almire_rug: This rare rug was removed from the remains of a regal residence.
item.properties|f.prize_box_winterfest: Contains various unique Winterfest prizes. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of moonstone.
projectx.properties|m.antialiasing_note: This setting will take effect when the game is restarted.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: {0}, you've already done so much for all of us but I must now ask you to make one final sacrifice. We might never have a chance to return home to Isora, but right now Cradle needs us. I would like you to spearhead our Operations on Cradle.
item.properties|f.pathfinder_armor: A handy set of armor for blazing trails and protecting against the bites of hungry monsters in the wild.
mission.properties|r.pierce_of_cake_4b: I think I've got it thanks for-
mission.properties|o.p_r6_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
item.properties|f.volcanic_iron: An extraordinary metal imbued with the blazing energy of magma.
pvp.properties|m.start_soon: Your {0} game will be starting soon...
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_2a: Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage correct?
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_8: Yes indeed\!  That's because every time you transmute an item through alchemy, there is a chance you can get one of several Unique Variants that makes your item much more powerful\!
sprites.properties|d.enduring_night: Increases duration of the shadow cloak.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_nature_sprit: A spirit of Nature willing to wander rather than follow the guide of the Spirit Mother.
item.properties|f.proto_shield: A small shield issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.dusker_cap: A hide helm for knights that prefer to take their opponents on toe-to-toe.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
conversation.properties|r.rfc_court_2a: Speaking of 'below', how do I get there now?  This place is collapsing\!
mission.properties|b.securing_camp_b: Before you attempt to investigate the monster-infested depths below the Rescue Camp, Rhendon would like you to help him eliminate some of the monsters that attacked the Rescue Camp last night.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_2b: I don't understand, the distress signal came from here... but that can't be, right?
social.properties|m.join_friend_mission: Join your friend {0} at depth {1} on the Mission\: {2} ({3})
guild.properties|e.item_treasury_limit: Sorry, an item you're trying to add is already at the limit for how many can be placed in a guild hall.
lottery.properties|m.lottery_announcemen: In {0}, a Birdsong Trading Co. giveaway drawing will be held amongst all online players for a prize of {1}\!
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_2: Looks like you know how to handle yourself. That's good, because the final area is just ahead.
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_f: Our mission to save Winterfest ends in defeat\! The grinchlins have won, we must retreat\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
item.properties|f.torpor_tantrum: The ultimate sleep bomb. It's like a bedtime story, only more explodey.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_1a: "The Nine see all, hear all. Obey the Iron Law."
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_2a: Yes, I see that we're already back to-
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I promoted myself to Senior Manager of Ghastly Implements of Destruction.
helptips.properties|m.sprite_cooldown: After using any sprite skill, a cooldown is required on all skills before using them again.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_wasd_mo: Mouse used for targeting, attacking and menu navigation
sprites.properties|d.iron_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal normal damage. \nCan be used by\: All battle sprites
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_sight: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
item.properties|m.exp_upkeep: This expansion will increase your Guild Hall's upkeep by {0} crowns.
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_2a: What would you like to know?
conversation.properties|m.hunter_2a: Smashing\! Then perhaps you and your mates will be of service to this lodge. You see, the alchemy machine you see before you can craft magnificent monster trophies for your Guild Hall. \n\nThe alchemy machines uses materials and crowns from your Guild Treasury and deposits the results into the Guild Treasury as well.
item.properties|f.ocarina_slime: Call up a companion cube to complete your conquest.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard {0}. Kora said you had news of the Alpha Squad. Please, give us your report.
item.properties|f.boltbrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a powerful electrical discharge that is harmless to knights.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3c: Once you reach Haven I would advise you explore the town and familiarize yourself with all the sights and services the town has to offer. You will gain access to more powerful gear than we offer here as well and be surrounded with many more experienced knights. Be sure to ask them for assistance if you get lost.
item.properties|f.nitronome: An advanced explosive issued to only the most elite Spiral Knight grenadiers. It's made from a synthetic substance that ticks ominously even when unarmed.
prologue.properties|m.preface1: The Morai Wars have brought us to the brink of extinction.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_securi: Please check that the CVC or CVV security code is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
design.properties|i.place_room: Install a room at this location.
item.properties|f.argent_peacemaker: An ancient handgun forged from sun silver. Its bullets serve as ushers for those that refuse to leave this world.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_1a:
Listen up, Rangers\! Spiral HQ has received a very cryptic distress signal from some completely unknown facility deep within the Clockworks. 

The way I figure, we're about to dive head first into either a perilous rescue mission or a death trap. Either way, your means of resolving the situation resides in your arsenal right now. So get geared up, and get ready for combat. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!

uplink.properties|m.tf2_start:
G'Day, loyal customer\! 

You may have recently heard that I've become the fourth richest man in America, having surpassed the fifth richest man in wealth, and having killed the previously-fourth richest man in a harpoon duel. While this is, of course, entirely true (especially the part about the harpoon duel, which was long and bloody), it's not nearly enough. Fourth place might be fine for HIPPIES who wouldn't know victory if it wandered up and offered to braid their ponytails, but it's damn well not good enough for Saxton Hale\! 

Mister Reddy, my accountant, explained to me that the best way to light a fire under the backside of Mann Co.'s revenue would be to "open up new markets". I'd relate exactly how we plan on doing that to you, but as he was talking I immediately started doing military presses to keep from dying of boredom, and missed out on the intricate details. 

All you need to know, dear customer, is that I need a good man to find his way to a town called "Haven", bravely stride into one of the many gates there and then cut his way down to the first "Clockworks Terminal". Since we couldn't find a good man, you'll have to do it yourself. You'll be amply rewarded, of course\: there's NOTHING I wouldn't do for an employee who risked life and limb on a trivial task necessitated by my selfish whims. 

Don't bother directly contacting me once you're done, as I'll be too busy kickboxing giraffes to care. One of my other employees will handle things from there. Best of luck\: you'll need it\! 

Sincerely yours, 

SAXTON HALE 
Australian 
CEO, Mann Co.

mission.properties|b.built_to_destroy:
Once known to Spiral HQ as 'Project R,' the Roarmulus Twins have been identified as a gremlin-engineered weapon of tremendous power built with the sole purpose of destroying Haven.  Stored deep within the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory, this weapon is not only protected by hordes of shock-powered constructs and gremlins, but the factory is a highly dangerous, explosive hazard itself\! 

In addition to shutting down the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to recover the Alpha Squad recon module that is believed to be located somewhere within the factory. 

It is highly recommended that you form a full squad before deploying.
