mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t2: Help us test this new content.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_2_7a: Are you saying these sprites learned magic spells from an old book?
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_0_1a: Well met, {0}. This is the Hall of Heroes, where veteran knights come to offer their services to members of our order who have attained the rank of Soldier or higher. \n\nBy undertaking more missions, I am confident that you will one day stand among us.
help.properties|m.controls_options: You can change your current control scheme from the Options menu.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_2: A ceremonial sword issued to seasoned Spiral Knights. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
item.properties|f.flare_popper: While never intended to be used in a party, Recon Rangers like to shoot signal flares into the air to celebrate missions where everyone comes back alive. Sadly, any Ranger will tell you that far too few of them are ever sent burning into the sky.
mission.properties|r.rc_buddyknight_2a: Thanks Rhendon, this will come in handy\!
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_4a: Piercing damage is produced by slime and beast family monsters. Additionally, slime monsters tend to be weak to shadow damage and beasts themselves to piercing damage. Keep this in mind. \n\nNow then, is there anything else you require?
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_helm: A substantial helmet designed to take all kinds of abuse from conventional weaponry. The inside smells a little like sweat.
uplink.properties|e.already_received: That knight cannot receive another gift of this type.
help.properties|m.tier_2_monster: Monsters split their damage between NORMAL and one other special damage type (PIERCING, ELEMENTAL or SHADOW).\nMonsters utilize STATUS EFFECTS more often. Equip armor with FIRE, FREEZE, SHOCK or POISON resistance\!
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder_spark:
The Iron Law is Broken\! 
The Crimson Order is False\! 
The Nine are blind, they cannot see the Truth that lies below. 
The Nine are deaf, they cannot hear the Resonance that beats within this world. 

Herex no longer serves as one of the Nine. 
Only Herex sees and hears the Truth. Only Herex will prevail. 
Follow Herex and you will be spared.
uplink.properties|m.login_event: Hail, {0}\! Thanks for playing Spiral Knights\! As part of a special event, please accept the attached rewards to aid you in your adventures\! \n\nAnd don't forget to check out the Supply Depot for more rare items and special offers\!
sprites.properties|d.drakon: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on raw, offensive power.
item.properties|f.storm_chaser: A rare elemental found hovering in storm clouds. Their electric hum creates an almost melodic choir that can be faintly heard between thunderclaps.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r4: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_3: Now that you have a grasp of using pickups, let's apply what you've learned in a combat environment.
support.properties|m.subheader_step205: You should not be sending a complaint against someone just because they sent a complaint against you.\n\nGame Masters will read through all complaints, and if you didn't break any rules in the complaint that was filed against you, then you don't need to worry.
mission.properties|r.securing_camp_b_1a: I'll head over to the Arsenal Station and equip my Proto Bomb\!
helptips.properties|m.unlock_grim_gate: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Fiendish ID Card \n\nWARNING\: If this Grim Gate is unlocked the party will become locked and stay locked for the duration of the mission. Choose your party members wisely\!
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_5: You have proven that you are combat ready and I have faith that you will serve the Spiral Order courageously. The gates into the Clockworks are just up ahead. \n\nGood luck to you\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_shield: Press and hold [[DEFEND]] to block attacks.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Preowa, whose artillery silenced the Grey Feather Tower Sages.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_slime_: I have a delicious fruity center\!
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones clad in gold armor are invincible.
item.properties|f.snarble_barb: A bestial blade that can shoot slithy spines at those who would oppose its wielder.
item.properties|f.furni_wardrobe_sklocke: A locked cabinet containing currently unequipped clothing and armor.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_6a: Good luck to you. Travel swiftly and avoid their grasp.
uplink.properties|d.battle_pack: A Battle Pack is the ultimate resource for facing the challenges of King Krogmo's Coliseum.  Gift it to a friend who is brave enough to enter the arena with you\!
item.properties|f.furni_drawer_spiral: A small set of drawers filled with a variety of important items.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
exchange.properties|m.opening_billing: Opening Energy Depot web site in your browser...
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_6a:
Wow, this thing is a massive tower of everfrost.  I've only ever seen little handfuls of the stuff, nothing close to what we're seeing here. 

The intel we've collected so far suggests that fiends utilize large deposits of the stuff to trap the souls of the lost within it, like some kind of icy prison. 

It would seem that Maulos, that horrible arch-fiend you just took down, had a different use in mind and was actually destroying this everfrost to unleash swarms of angry, frozen souls into the Clockworks.  Had he finished the job, well, I don't even want to think about how many sweaters we would all be needing right now...
mission.properties|o.rise_or_fall: Test your might with a slimy showdown in the Battle Arena
mission.properties|b.spark_roar:
An exceptionally high concentration of constructs has been found guarding an area of the Clockworks that Spiral HQ suspects could be a Crimson Order hideout. Unlike other monsters, constructs don't seem capable of reproducing on their own, meaning that any time one is deconstructed, it's a permanent dent in their numbers. It will be a worthwhile task regardless of Crimson Order influence or not. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter these levels, investigate the possible hideout, and eliminate the construct threat. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with elemental resistant gear with elemental and shadow damage weapons\!
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_2_2: Those heavy cogs are in our way, and from intel reports, the only way to open them up is from inside two adjacent gatehouses.  I will not waste needless lives battering at the gatehouse from the front.  I'll need you to find a way around.  Flank the defenses, get inside the gatehouse, and open up the gates\!
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm_b: Cross the chasm with Rhendon and reach Haven
guild.properties|log.door_placed: Placed a {0} for {1} crowns, replacing a {2}.
item.properties|f.artillery_beacon: A portable beacon that when deployed, summons a barrage of powerful rockets
item.properties|f.onesie: One size fits all. Machine washable, heavy duty cycle. Air dry only.
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_2a: Yes, Project R appears to be in fact two massive weapons known as the 'Roarmulus Twins.'  Designed by one of the Crimson Order itself, the Roarmulus Twins are some kind of construct cannon that the gremlins intend on moving up the Clockworks into the Haven Arcade\! \n\nBased on what the schematics suggest, their power far exceeds standard gremlin weaponry and could be truly devastating to Haven, Spiral HQ and the Strangers should it reach the Arcade.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_9a: If so, we must prevent further damage.  Now please, there are yet more sprites to be rescued.  And who knows what we'll discover when we get there\!
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2a: Battle sprites level up by acquiring heat, just like your weapons and gear. They can acquire heat in two ways\: absorbing it as you battle in the Clockworks and by consuming materials and synthesizing them into heat.
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts: Break these blocks to receive hearts. Hearts restore your health. You cannot pick them up unless you need them.
chat.properties|m.user_disconnected: That user has been disconnected for {0}.
chat.properties|m.usage_who: Usage\: /{0} player name\nRetrieves information about a knight.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
mission.properties|b.p_boost_test_t1: Start the mission and help us test.
item.properties|f.green_shard: A shard of Valestone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: Ugh, I can barely see... did Spiral HQ send you to rescue us?
conversation.properties|r.ritual_2b: I've got a really bad feeling about this, but ok...
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
item.properties|f.firetail_mask: A simmering simian mask made to celebrate the new year. The searing silhouette will display your dominant demeanor.
monster.properties|m.promotion_2: We could use a guy like you in management.
item.properties|f.wild_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.hatchet: A heavy blade used to chop vines and foliage in the wilderness surrounding the Rescue Camp.
item.properties|m.open_box_prompt: Prize Boxes contain random prizes inside.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_skescape: A piece of Spiral technology used to escape disabled starships. They're very cramped inside.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_dev: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
item.properties|f.gh_env_snowing: A beautiful environment that fills your Guild Hall with perfect snow\: the kind that gently falls from the sky and never collects on the ground, melting into gray muck.
dungeon.properties|m.jigsaw_valley_desc: Appearing to be sky islands ripped apart and put back together again as if it were a puzzle this world can sometimes be confusing to navigate. Unfortunately it seems to also be home to a host of mindless slimes and constructs who do not seem to mind its erratic layout.
item.properties|f.arctic_rogue_mail: A plated mail said to be crafted by an arctic rogue. It comes augmented with ice plating to conceal your location during arctic expeditions.
conversation.properties|m.core_tech_2: That's easy, keep gathering minerals within the Clockworks and powering those gates within the arcade.  We need to analyze how mineral power affects the Core.  The problem is that very little power reaches down to these depths.  We can only gather so much data from each gate as it launches.
item.properties|f.fused_demo_suit: An upgraded Demo Suit fused dangerously with the unstable core from a powerful Blast Cube. Even still, you should feel a lot safer wearing this.
social.properties|m.booted: {0} has been banned from the party.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_4: I mean that the Core isn't a big battery that runs this world, but rather it and the whole of this world is a massive prison designed to keep something from ever leaving. \n\nThink about our geo-scans of Cradle just before the crash- they show it as being composed of hundreds of massive slabs of other worlds, almost like plates of armor.  Then you have the Clockworks, the most unnatural thing I've ever seen.  An entire world whose sole purpose seems to be stopping anyone from ever reaching its Core.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Careful, those Gremlins have lined the place with barbed wire.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Whatever that was, we're here now. Wherever here is. It looks like our only option is to see where this leads.
global.properties|e.must_complete_tutori: You must complete The Crash Site before joining friends.
helptips.properties|m.tut_miniboss: You've almost made it to the Rescue Camp, run through the force barrier ahead\!
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: Gremlins\!? Am I reading this data right? An ambush\!? How were they able to trick our sensors?
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: No problem, from the top then...
sprites.properties|d.plentiful_pain: Increases the bonus duration of hexing haze as additional targets are acquired.
guild.properties|m.invite_name: Enter the name of the knight you wish to invite\:
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: Enter the amount of energy you want to sell, in multiples of 100
guildhelp.properties|l.treasury_console: The Guild Treasury can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|f.prize_box_guildhall: Contains random furnishings.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_slime: Contains various unique costumes and items that augment the Jelly series of gear. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.heavy_splinter_bomb: A solid chunk of synthetic mineral with an explosive surprise inside. Wolvers hate surprises.
auction.properties|m.cancel_confirm: You will get your item back but will not be refunded your listing fee.
item.properties|f.raiders_sword: A runed sword that will reduce your foe to cold cuts.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_9a: Rulen was recruited as the technical genius that Captain Ozlo believed would be required for navigating the vast, mechanized world of the Clockworks.  His primary responsibilities included everything from disabling locks to repairing armor to wrecking sentient constructs.  He was additionally the lead on analyzing the Core once the squad reached it.
item.properties|f.gremlin_helm: A special helmet handcrafted by gremlin smiths to shield from the harshest of environs. This one has been modified to fit a knight.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
item.properties|f.plated_shade_helm: A helm of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_5a: Hey, {0}\! I see you've acquired a Proto Bomb\! They're very useful for when you need to deal with groups of enemies.
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_description: Leave your party and venture out on your own.
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: You should get inside the town walls.  It's not safe out here.
item.properties|f.nightshade: A hazardous herb that's bad for most beasts, but tasty to a teeming variety of toxic creatures.
item.properties|f.crimsonite: A fabled mineral of a fiery, red color said to contain the passion, anger and strength of the life surrounding it.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r4: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_4a: Take it easy {0}, not all gremlins are cut from the same cloth.  Some disagree with the ways of King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order.  In fact, somewhere down in the Clockworks I'm told there's an entire town full of gremlins who left the Great Colony.
conversation.properties|m.npc_survivorkn: They... They got everyone except me. I just hid in the corner.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_3_3: Roger that, Lieutenant.  I'll make the Warmaster pay.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|f.punch_n_vise_room: A busy room where Punch and Vise can be called upon to unbind and rework your equipment.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Then scour the Clockworks for those wretched kats and destroy them\! Even if they ate the books you will be able to recover the Ancient Pages. These pages can be given to Montague in exchange for rewards. Help us and we'll help you\! \n\nBlack kats can be found randomly when encountering spookats in Tier 2 and Tier 3 (Arcade Gates and Missions). There is also a daily Prestige Mission that likely leads to a black kat nest.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_4a: As a Defender, you can now undertake missions in Tier 3 of the Clockworks.  These are the deepest and most dangerous depths of the Clockworks, delve any further and you will reach the Core itself. \n\nPerhaps if you make it that far, you can locate the Alpha Squad, I just don't know.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_3: In any case it would seem that this new 'recipe' caused the cakes to turn into horrible monsters that have overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks.  I'd like to have my kitchen back, so could you please assist me in destroying these horrible Creep Cakes?
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_4_acc: Free 6 Lost Sprites? I can do that\!
item.properties|f.beast_basher: A powerful pick modified to add an extra helping of hurt to beast family monsters.
item.properties|f.obsidian_carbine: A deadly gun made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. With every shot fired, a faint whisper is heard, believed to be the true name of its target.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_3b: Thank you for your help. When I am ready, I will enter the final gate.
help.properties|m.energy_depot: You can buy or sell Energy at the Energy Depot.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_2a: You stand within the Hall of Heroes, where the best of the Spiral Knights offer what they can to aspiring knights.  Knights like you yourself once were when you first emerged from your drop pod and found your way to Haven. \n\nAnd after so many successful missions, daring rescues and exemplary performance in battle, you now stand fit to join these heroes.
mission.properties|o.shadow_beast: Defeat the Snarbolax in the Gloaming Wildwoods and recover the recon module
mission.properties|b.blades_fallen:
Not every knight who enters the Clockworks returns to feel the sun on their face once more.  Within the perilous depths of the Clockworks, those that brave its dangers always face the reality that every expedition may be their last.  Sometimes their bodies can be recovered and other times all that is left is remnants of their gear. 

Just outside of Haven, Spiral HQ has built a soldier's graveyard where fallen knights can lay to rest.  As a Spiral Knight, you must face the reality of death in order to understand its gravity. 

Deliver the remains of an unknown knight, a sword, to a memorial within the graveyard.  But stay alert- dark energies resonate from the graveyard, attracted to the countless souls it houses.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_b_: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
global.properties|m.idled_out: You have been disconnected due to idleness.
helptips.properties|m.atg_crowns: CROWNS are used to buy items and pay for other services.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro2_1a: ...come in, {0}, are you there?  This is Recon Knight Rhendon\!
item.properties|f.pig_armor: Hog all the attention in this leather suit. Its durable protection may just save your bacon one day.
mission.properties|m.cryptic_coder_crims:
Infiltrate the Complex. 
Take all schematics. 
The Nine are quiet but we will silence them. 
The Knights pursue but we will halt them. 

Only Herex comprehends the Truth. Only Herex will descend. 
There can be no other.
item.properties|f.luminite_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
helptips.properties|m.loading8: If you become frozen you will not be able to move or turn, but you can still attack. If adventuring with others, ask them to chip away at the ice with their best attacks.
item.properties|f.plate_helm: A heavy duty helm suited for heavy combat.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_companion_cu: A sociable slime with uncontainable curiosity. (Limit 1 per hall).
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_luggage: Some stylish suitcases suitable for stowing everything you'll need for the last trip you'll ever take.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_3a: Punch and Vise are gremlin smiths that can change the properties of your weapons and gear.
item.properties|f.empty_room: An empty Guild Hall room with standard flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
item.properties|f.plasma_capacitor: The addition of an advanced Spiral power source gives this bomb a shockingly large blast radius.
social.properties|m.befriend_message_nam: Enter an optional message to {0} with your friend request\:
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_9: That covers the basics for alchemy.  I can go over it all once more if you like, or mark you as having cleared this mission and send you on your way.
item.properties|f.swordstone: A fine chunk of natural rock perfect for honing the edge of a deadly blade.
guild.properties|m.formation:
You may form a new guild for {0} crowns and {1} energy. The crowns will be seeded into the guild's treasury. By creating a guild you will become the Guild Master and will have the ability to invite new members into your guild. Guild features include\:
Personal Guild Hall for Guild Members only
Guild Member chat channel
Guild Officer chat channel
Guild Member rankings
Guild Member status updates
item.properties|f.icebreaker_armor: Upgraded Frostbreaker Armor further hacked to resist freeze.
item.properties|f.flawed_snowball: A hard-packed snowball that is unfortunately too flawed for use in alchemy. It would be best to simply throw it away... at someone's head.
mission.properties|o.go_shopping_b: Help out a knight in trouble
item.properties|f.sorcerer_robe: A fine robe known to be worn by powerful sorcerers, and this one guy Bob.
item.properties|f.chess_room: An empty room with an 8x8 chess board in the corner and a row for spectators.
mission.properties|b.delved_too_deep: The truth has been revealed. It's time to update Intel Agent Kora and Spiral HQ about what you and Lieutenant Vaelyn have learned.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: {0}, this is almost certainly a trap and I can't ask you to come with me, but I'm going in there. If there's even a chance that Rulen and the other Alpha Squad members are alive I need to try and find them.
item.properties|f.polar_day_wolf_hood: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending day patrols.
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r6: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
item.properties|f.chaos_cowl: A hood of dubious origin that shrouds its wearer in both mystery and elemental protection.
item.properties|f.fireworks: During times of celebration, the Spiral Order devotes some of its munitions experts to create spectacular fireworks.
item.properties|f.blue_shard: A shard of Moonstone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
dungeon.properties|m.battle_arena_desc: Said to be watched by countless drifting souls for entertainment, Battle Arenas offer escalating challenges for the brave warriors who wish to claim the treasure of the Arena King.
item.properties|f.shadow_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_16: Wonderful\!  I'm glad I could help you get your bearings. Good luck to you, {0}\!
mission.properties|r.the_flickering_flam: That gremlin Herex must be involved.
item.properties|f.savage_tortofist: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it you can feel the primal energy of a rampaging wolver pack within waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.faust: A powerful, cursed sword forged in the Underworld. Its powerful charge attacks can sometimes curse the one that wields it.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_medium: Advanced difficulty features an increased challenge for players who have a thorough grasp of combat. Monsters can deal and receive more damage and traps are more dangerous. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are increased.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_2_2: The gates are as good as opened, Lieutenant\!
projectx.properties|m.mission_imf: Recover the recon module in the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
mission.properties|o.king_of_ashes: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the Firestorm Citadel and reach the Core
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_10: Your sarcasm has been noted. \n\nNow then, about those empty sprite transport crates; we have confirmed foul play.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_warden_: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of scanning the horizon during polar twilight.
mission.properties|o.crossing_chasm: Cross the perilous chasm and connect with Spiral HQ in Haven
item.properties|f.stagger_storm: Though it was originally developed by the Spiral Order to harmlessly subdue dangerous species, how you deal with foes unfortunate enough to be caught in the storm is entirely up to you.
conversation.properties|m.rescue_knight_: Whew\! It was cramped in there.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_steam_cont: Menu key toggles between mouse mode
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of luminite.
item.properties|f.helm_back: An accessory that can be attached to the back of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
chat.properties|m.usage_pbroadcast: Usage\: /{0} message\nBroadcasts message to everyone on the current peer.
conversation.properties|m.lab_harness_1a: I'm Riley, Morlin's assistant.  I'm in the process of inventing a way to enhance our battle sprites even further.  Check back later once you've acquired a permanently-bonded sprite.
conversation.properties|r.hunter_2a: Ah, so it's a team effort?
helptips.properties|m.loading9: If you become stunned you will move and attack slower than usual. This can leave you as a prime target for larger monsters that you can normally outrun, so watch out\!
mission.properties|o.p_r4_weap_1: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
conversation.properties|r.sl_guard_2: Got it.  What else do I need?
item.properties|m.expire_days.n: This item expires {0} days after it is equipped.\n
item.properties|f.slime_trinket: A curious circle coated with calcified slime.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_13: Here we have Bechamel the Accessorizor, who can add accessories to your gear so long as you have a ticket.  With accessories, you can make your gear really stand out in a crowd, I highly suggest giving it a try.  You'll soon become the apple of every one's eye\!
item.properties|f.savage_tortoise: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. Even a rampaging wolver pack would have a hard time puncturing its reinforced plates.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
helptips.properties|m.tg_pots: Some objects can be picked up and used or even thrown across the room. Try throwing a pot at that switch.
mission.properties|b.from_below: A squad of Desna's Recon Rangers is trapped somewhere in the depths of the Clockworks by a mysterious force. Judging from the severity of the reports and panicked communications from the squad, Spiral HQ believes that only someone with your experience is capable of handling whatever deadly force has trapped them.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_spooky: A dark and foreboding theme perfect for a Guild Hall whose members are among the recently departed.

item.properties|f.wild_hunting_blade: A legendary cutter feared by even the mightiest of Wolvers and Chromalisks.
helptips.properties|m.devilish_drudgery: The office minions of the Underworld are a disgruntled lot, attacking any unauthorized personnel on sight.  While not terrible threats on their own, they can become far worse if one of their Pit Bosses gets a hold of them.  Watch out\!

mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_2a: I'm just another soul hiding from the gaze of the Apocrea. But I refuse to give up. Until they find me I will do anything I can to save another soul from my fate.
item.properties|f.ice_queen_mail: A regal suit of armor resembling the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_3a: They seem friendly. In fact they seem to behave just like the battle sprites I know. Only difference is they, uh, well, look like dragons.
mission.properties|o.weight_of_darkness: Prove your valor against a legion of supreme shadow monsters

item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_2: A flawed fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.

mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the evil master of munitions within the gremlin's all-powerful Crimson Order  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.
item.properties|f.emberbreak_shield: A Proto Shield modified to provide some protection against fire.
pvp.properties|m.love_delete_confirm: Are you sure? The level will be deleted.
item.properties|f.black_kat_raiment: A reclaimed raiment that is brimming with dark energy. It is said to resemble the great Kat Tribe hero, Margrel, the one who opened The Book of Grey Feathers and brought about the Kataclysm. It brings great misfortune to anyone who dares to wear it.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I am ready to choose my battle sprite.
item.properties|f.shadow_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful shadow bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.antigua: A mysterious relic from a forgotten time. It uses explosive powder to fire its rounds.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_1_2: I won't let you down, Lieutenant.
item.properties|f.paper_mask: A simple paper {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's not well made and eventually falls apart.
mission.properties|b.minerals_rock: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is responsible for researching the strange minerals that Knights have begun mining from within the Clockworks.  He believes that they may hold the answer to gaining entry into the Core and retrieving the energy needed to restore the Skylark. \n\nMeet with him in the Haven Arcade and gain an understanding of how you can help his research as well as harness the true power of the Haven Arcade\!
mission.properties|r.delved_too_deep_2a: (Tell Kora about The Swarm, The Sleeper, and the Alpha Squad)
uplink.properties|m.bid_complete: Thank you for using the Haven Auction House, your shinies are always appreciated.
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: Don't know how long before our forcefield gives out...
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_2b: No thanks, I'll wander around on my own.
item.properties|f.dread_captain_cutlass: A custom curving cutter kept keen on careless castaways.
auction.properties|m.no_mybids: You have not bid on any recent auctions.
item.properties|f.feral_kat_hood: A primitive looking hood made to resemble a wild beast.
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_helm: A demo helm made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
item.properties|f.sunset_stetson: A sturdy hat for gunslingers that shouldn't cost you much more than a fistful of crowns.
dungeon.properties|m.emberlight_desc: A village of outcasts, Emberlight serves as a refuge for gremlins who were banished from the Great Colony. Now they live humble lives, selling wares and repairs to passing travelers, always fearful that one day the gremlin king Tinkinzar would see fit to wipe them out entirely.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_5a: That's right, you can acquire recipes and materials in order to alchemize weapons and gear at alchemy stations.  Come on, I'll show you one.
support.properties|m.option_206_0: If there is no doubt this was personal information then please click here to file the complaint.
item.properties|f.punkin_sprout: A small sprig capable of growing into a grand gourd.
item.properties|f.ticktocktop: Enough complications to make your head spin.
item.properties|f.budding_helm: This cracked biotech helm is home to a harmless decorative plant.
item.properties|f.super_dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb stuffed with even more Dark Matter. How much Dark Matter is too much? This much.
item.properties|f.prize_box_blazing: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Blazing style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.grey_feather_mantle: A cloak for renowned Owlite scholars, this feathery frock is filled with the wisdom of the ages... and is super soft\!

mission.properties|b.best_of_beast: After a recent promotion, Biotech Hahn has earned the title of 'Chief Biotech.' He was informed of your recent accomplishments and would like to give you a quick briefing on what you can expect from the beast and slime family of monsters as you approach the Core.

item.properties|f.volt_breaker_helm: A Circuit Breaker Helm modified to provide further protection against shock.

projectx.properties|m.downloading: Please wait while we install the rest of the game.

item.properties|f.celestial_nav_helm: A special helm built to commemorate Isoran spacefarers of old.  With this equipped, you can see a clear path across the night sky to countless worlds beyond.
item.properties|f.sacred_sentinel_armor: A raidiant defending doubleweave for insulating against erratic elements.

item.properties|f.nodeslime_shield: This weathered wobbling wall can withstand a walloping when wielded by unwaveringly willed warriors.

mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having faced the jaws of the most ferocious wolvers, avoided the spikes of fully evolved jelly cubes and even the vile regurgitations of virulisks, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.

mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...This world has seen few greater tragedies than the fall of the great Kingdom of Almire.  Once a vibrant, beautiful realm of lush forests and sweeping plains... 

...neighboring kingdoms declared war... 

...seeking the power needed to turn the tide, Lord Vanaduke of Almire fled into the mountains...
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.

but may affect framerate with less

Hello there lad\!  
Taking on ol' Seerus aye?  Careful now, he's not right in the head. Proper imbalanced that one.

item.properties|f.furni_chair_manor: An exquisite chair, cunningly crafted for cozy comfort.
chat.properties|m.jk_notfound: {0} does not exist on your friend or guild lists.
item.properties|f.owlite_mask: A mask of an owlite scholar. The Kats of Moorcroft have assured us with confidence that this reconstruction matches their "grotesque and feathered visage".
item.properties|f.vial_freeze: A glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
item.properties|f.gremlin_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gremlin.  It's so convincing, you just might receive an invitation to the Colony\!

Once purchased, a harness is automatically added to your harness list in the battle sprite interface. \n\nAdditionally, any time you purchase a direct upgrade to a harness you own, it will be replaced by the superior harness.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r6: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
exchange.properties|m.other_tooltip: Opens the online Energy Depot in your browser where you can use a variety of payment methods to get more Energy.
item.properties|f.toy_soldier_coat: Tailored for duty in the battle for Toyland but also perfect for posing in parades.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_7a: I'll take the artifact to the Lab.  When you're ready you should head into Haven and meet up with the rest of the crew.  I have a feeling we might be stuck on this planet for quite some time, so we might as well see what we can do to help.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s:
We got enough that Anomalie let me mess around with a few. 

See, I had this handgun chassis from an old import.  Cool little launcher, but impossible to get parts for, especially the ammo. 

Well, with a little wrenching and a little creative misapplication of thermodynamics, I converted it into a pretty peppy little Spike Slicer\!
chat.properties|m.usage_invite: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nInvites a player into your current party.
item.properties|f.robo_wrecker: A wrench-like tool thought to be of gremlin design.  Though its origin is mysterious, its abilty to destroy constructs is well-documented.
item.properties|f.snarbostuffing: A dense, fluffy stuffing made from a special polymer that doesn't break down when exposed to the cursed fur of the Snarbolax. It's perfect for creating trophies or adorable, cursed, stuffed toys.

item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_1: A fractured fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.

uplink.properties|m.generic_change: Something changed and we had to change things. Please accept this attachment as a replacement. Sorry for the inconvenience.

item.properties|f.rock_salt: A small amount of Clockworks mineral that's been infused with absolutely nothing. It hungrily draws at nearby essences and flavors, making it a staple in cooking, and the bane of jellies everywhere.

conversation.properties|m.fc_court_compl: Our focus with the Spirit Mother is strong now thanks to you\! Use the water that flows from the spirit wells to extinguish the shadow fire. dungeon.properties|m.vip_tos:
This C.U.B.E. Club Membership Agreement constitutes a binding legal document between the undersigned (the "knight"), Golden Casino Holdings LLC (the "Casino"), and the entire slime community ("slimes").

 I. General Terms and Conditions
  1. Membership in the C.U.B.E. Club is for personal use only and can not be transferred to other knights, Devilites, or other Clockwork creatures.
  2. Selling access to your ability to spin is prohibited.
  3. Keep your arms and legs inside the Casino at all times.
  4. Please do not drop items into the core.
 II. Description of Benefits
  1. Benefits are varied and may be changed at any time.
  2. Lounge access is not guaranteed and limited by availability.
  3. Buffalo Wings are not included.
  4. All disputes will be arbitrated by the Casino floor manager and all decisions are final.
 III. Winnings, Payments, and Fees
  1. Winnings may be paid in Golden Slime Coins at the discretion of the Casino floor manager.
  2. No additional fees are collected at this time.
 IV. Promotional Awards
  1. Sale promotions\: Reduced prices for members, if any, will be displayed plainly in the shop interface.
  2. The Gift Shop reserves the right to modify, alter, discontinue or terminate these promotions at any time for any reason whatsoever without notice to the end users. No whiners.
 V. Restrictions and Conditions of Use
  1. As a condition of your use of the club services, you agree not to use club facilities or interfaces for any purpose that is unlawful or prohibited by the terms, conditions, and notices included in this Membership Agreement or any relevant Licence Agreement, or anything generally regarded as uncouth by the slimes.
  2. The Spiral Knights Terms of Service supersedes these terms where applicable.
  3. The knight agrees to all terms and conditions enumerated here, and those not enumerated here. The slimes may add new conditions at any time that require complete retroactive compliance.
 VI. Termination of Account
  1. The Casino has the right to terminate your membership for violating any terms or conditions, precise or vague, enumerated herein or generated at the time of infraction. You've been warned.
 VII. Disclaimer of Warranty; Limitation of Liability
  1. Your use of the Casino is at your sole risk. You click it, you bought it.
  2. The Casino nor the general slime community shall not be liable in contract, tort, negligence or otherwise for any loss or damage whatsoever arising from or in any way connected with your use of the Casino.
 VIII. General
  1. This Membership Agreement is governed by the laws of Haven and the laws of Cradle. You hereby irrevocably consent to submit to the jurisdictions of the Courts of Cradle and Haven.
  2. This agreement was written by a few slimes with little grasp of legal language beyond what they saw when watching A Few Good Men. Thus, any parts that don't make sense are usually blamed on the other guy. Any good parts left over are still good. They don't go bad just because we screwed up on the other badder parts. There's a word for that concept and the fact that we don't know it is one of the bad parts.

item.properties|f.rugged_robo_wrecker: An upgraded robo wrecker that has assisted a great many constructs in becoming smoldering, scrap metal heaps.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the shadowy maskeraith, battle sprite of those who wish to lurk in the shadows and strike the enemy with sneak attacks? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: I don't know about that... I'm fine here amongst all these ancient tomes.  I've got plenty to read, more than I ever could in a lifetime.  But I suppose that won't be a problem. \n\nPlease, just head on back to Haven.  Let my squad know that I'm ok and that I'm safe.
item.properties|f.deadly_virulisk_mask: A Virulisk Mask upgraded with an advanced toxin filter. It always smells like artificial pine needles on the inside.

helptips.properties|m.scenario_compound_: The others must never know.  Silence them. -H
mission.properties|b.shocking_sentient_s:
Recon Knights have uncovered a secret weapons facility that according to the intel we have available, could belong to a high ranking gremlin of The Crimson Order.  It is heavily fortified by a small army of electrified constructs who have no doubt been programmed to defend the facility at all costs. 

While it is unclear if this weapons stash actually belongs to a gremlin of The Crimson Order, it is no less worth infiltrating and neutralizing the weapons stash. 

It is advised that you prepare yourself with elemental damage and shock resistant gear before deploying.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!

conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_2: Thank you for defeating the Snarbolax. Too many of our squires met an early end because of that beast. I can rest easier knowing that threat is now behind us. \n\nI look forward to hearing about your future exploits, Soldier\!
conversation.properties|r.impostoclaus_1: Not on my watch. I will save Winterfest\! How can I help?
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2c: All battle sprites wear a mechanical harness that aligns their skills to a damage type. Not all sprites can wear all harnesses though. For example, a drakon cannot output piercing damage. \n\nBy default, you have an iron harness that any sprite can equip. If you want to branch out as you likely do with your weapons and gear, you need to purchase new harnesses.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_2a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more. \n\nNow then {0}, for your 3 Star Certification you must be currently equipped with a 3 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_sig: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
guild.properties|i.guild_shop: Purchase guild furnishings and upgrades using funds from the Guild Treasury.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_2a: Very well {0}, let's get right to it.  It seems the closer monsters get to the Core, the more their unique properties begin to surface.  In most cases this takes the form of their being able to inflict special damage types that require special defenses in order to withstand properly. \n\nIn Tier 2, a monster inflicting a special damage type will always produce a split normal/special damage output.  Thus, normal defense is still a somewhat valid defense choice.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_7b: (Your words do not seem to faze the fallen knight, whose mind seems to be lost somewhere in the glories of his past life.)
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet3_1a: You've restored the power and saved us all, {0}\!  I can't thank you enough, all these recruits owe you their lives. \n\nYou should now try to contact Spiral HQ via your comlink.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.

conversation.properties|m.mon_pocket_1:
Greetings\! I'm Nonna with the Emberlight Adoption Agency\! 

We at the Emberlight Adoption Agency collect baby monsters that have managed to become lost in the darkest depths of the Clockworks.  No longer having a home or any means of caring for themselves, we try to find these needy monsters a good home\! 

By purchasing one of these adorable 'monster pockets' you can carry around a baby monster of your very own\! 

The Emberlight Adoption Agency will visit Haven from time to time, and you never know what we will have to offer\!

mission.properties|b.rotting_metropolis: It would seem as though those slime generators have been around much longer than we thought, seeping their vile toxins into any levels that should be near them. \n\nA modern city, much like those that the devilites inhabit seems to be overrun with these toxins, and was probably left behind by both the devilites and gremlins as a result.  Now a legion of slime and undead creatures haunt the place, festering in the poisons that linger in the air.  A squad that was attempting to pass through the city has gone missing.  Given that the very air is toxic, it is urgent that an experienced team enter this city and rescue the squad.  There is little hope left for them otherwise.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: We've had a few cases where knights have met non-hostile constructs that they swear behaved like true sentient creatures.  But that is very difficult to believe. Gremlins are brilliant, but brilliant at the kind of direct engineering that simply gets the job done and little else.  Brute force. \n\nArtificial life?  Well, that's something else entirely.

mission.properties|b.alone_in_dark: The spookats of Moorcroft Manor have another valuable piece of intel for us that is worth investigating.  They say that a lost soul of the former Kingdom of Almire resides in a soldier's graveyard near the Firestorm Citadel.  This soul is willing to provide us with the information on the nature of the citadel as well as how we can get through it and reach the Core. \n\nReaching him will not be easy given his location.  Graveyards are terrible places, especially at this depth.  It is highly advisable that you move through the graveyard as quickly as possible in your search for this lost soul.

mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.

item.properties|f.twicer_slicer: Slicer prototype Mk II.  They say a little bit of knowledge is a dangerous thing, so that's exactly how much knowledge we have about the mysterious spikes we're slicing up and launching out here.

mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: I will provide you with a summary of each battle sprite. In recognition of your valor in rescuing these sprites, Spiral HQ has authorized you to bond with one. This bond will last forever and is a significant responsibility. \n\nPlease think carefully before making your decision; there is no going back once you decide.
mission.properties|b.the_gauntlet: One final battle stands in your way before reaching the Firestorm Citadel. Thought to be devised by Lord Vanaduke himself, this unrelenting gauntlet is teeming with all manners of dark creatures and culminates in a nightmarish battle arena that must be conquered in order to gain access to the gates of the Firestorm Citadel. \n\nThis mission will take everything you've got and requires a full arsenal of powerful weapons and gear.  If Lord Vanaduke is testing you, give him the fight that he's asking for and show him what a true Champion can do\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: This thing is useless without power.  How are we supposed to defend ourselves from those monsters?\!
item.properties|f.padded_demo_suit: An upgraded suit for bombers that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_6: That jelly palace...what an odd place. Also, I wonder what that strange device you found inside the palace was? It didn't appear to be made by the likes of jellies.
item.properties|f.super_shock_barrier: Surrounds you with potent orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_3a: The Clockworks are the massive complex of gears and machinery that lies just below the surface of this whole world. It's truly an incredible sight. It is a strange and dangerous world in which we have found ourselves. Tread carefully.
mission.properties|b.honor_duty: Lieutenant Feron would like a brief word with you regarding your achievement in breaking through the Firestorm Citadel.
mission.properties|o.delved_too_deep: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.power_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.

Tinkinzar is said to be a great ruler and mechanical genius, responsible for the vision of the whole of the Clockworks. It is our understanding however that the king is never seen by common gremlins, but instead his orders are delivered and carried out by his Crimson Order, a fearful and zealous band of gremlins who alone share audience with the great king.

item.properties|f.firetail_mail: A scorching simian mail typically worn by commanders in combat. It will ward off many wounds made to the wearer.
projectx.properties|e.name_too_long: Sorry, the name is too long.

mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm: In order to reach Spiral HQ's base of operations in Haven you will need to descend into the Clockworks and cross a massive chasm. item.properties|f.guild_bond: Deposit in your guild's treasury to redeem the crowns.

conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_1a: Hail, knight. You must be {0}, Rhendon radioed us and said you were on your way. Come with us, the Rescue Camp is just ahead.

shop.properties|m.cart_vitapod_adjusted: You may only equip one best vitapod\: cart adjusted.

helptips.properties|m.tg1_welcome: Welcome to the Training Grounds, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_helm: A superior plate helmet forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It'll restrict your peripheral vision a bit, but it's virtually impregnable.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_2a: Missions range from dangerous combat engagements to talking to certain people, such as myself.  By completing missions, you'll earn progress towards new ranks, which will in turn give you access to increasingly powerful gear.  Greta informed me that you'll be tackling our power supply problem in the Ancient Generator?
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_1a: I understand that Spiral HQ has uncovered the nature of Project R.

item.properties|f.ionized_salt_bomb: A solid chunk of rock salt with an explosive surprise inside. Jellies hate surprises.

mission.properties|r.arc_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
item.properties|f.sun_silver: An extraordinary metal imbued with the radiant light of the sky.

projectx.properties|m.mission_gw: Recover the recon module in the Gloaming Wildwoods.

mission.properties|b.p_testmission_1: Start the mission and refer to the testing notes for the depth of each floor.
item.properties|f.jack_froster: Usher in a winter wonderland with this nose-nipping, nasty surprise that is perfect for giving your foes a bad case of frostbite.

item.properties|f.glacius: Mixing some advanced theories on cryogenics with the technology powering the Cooling Chamber produced this advanced armament, which is capable of flash-freezing the most formidable of foes.
item.properties|f.boosted_plate_mail: A suit of Spiral Plate Mail with a supercharged internal power source. The upgrade didn't make the armor any lighter.
item.properties|f.confetti: Use this item to throw it into the air and celebrate good times. Come on\!
item.properties|f.sunset_duster: A sturdy set of leather clothing made for a pilgrim with true grit.
item.properties|f.beast_scale: A relatively intact scale recovered from a Clockworks creature.
item.properties|f.jelly_animal: A magnificent animalistic mask exemplifying ectoplasmic expropriation.
trade.properties|e.cart_removed.1: NOTE\: a {1} was removed from the cart.

item.properties|f.fur_cap: A toasty fur cap forming the visage of a wild beast.
item.properties|f.shogun_helmet: A grand helmet worn by warriors who long ago united a land under the banner of the rising sun.
item.properties|f.illuminating_ward: A personal candle for warding off the darkness, and that which lurks within it.
item.properties|f.bio_coat: A biotech's air-tight clean suit designed for handling hostile or unknown flora.

item.properties|f.cloak: An extraordinary cloak favored by the students of the arcane.

dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_hard: Elite difficulty features an exceptional challenge for fearless players who have mastered combat. Monsters and traps are very deadly. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are greatly increased.
item.properties|f.galactic_guardian_helm: A commemorative helm that pays tribute to the countless brave Isoran guardians that have protected spacefaring crews in their adventures across the stars.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Clawers, the fearsome frontline fighters of the Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.voltech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of electricity at an increased rate.
item.properties|f.spark_plug: A small, mechanical component that really gets a construct's motor running.
conversation.properties|r.almire_histori: What have you learned about Almire?
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_2: The room ahead will give you a chance to try out using vials. Simply press the number key (1 through 5) to the corresponding pickup in your belt at the top of the screen. Doing so will load a vial. Press attack to throw it.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.

mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_4a: Yes, I feel the same way.  We owe it to them to put an end to this gremlin threat as quickly as possible. \n\nI've lined up several missions for you that will take you to locations where gremlins seem to be gathering resources for Project R.  Your briefing should explain everything.
helptips.properties|t.loading12: Press F2 to send a bug report
logon.properties|m.converted_to_steam: This account has been converted to Steam.  Select Use Steam Account to log on.
item.properties|f.dangerous_oni_helm: A helm worn by members of the Recon Rangers. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a fiend who lives in the mountains of a distant land. Said to guard the gate to heaven itself, it only allows those who are worthy to pass.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: I just heard an explosion in the back of the lab\! \n\nWe'll handle these monsters, {0}.  You go and make sure the Artifact is secure\!  Hurry\!

chat.properties|m.player_between_scenes: That player is moving between scenes.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_1a:
{0}, still holding it together I see and earning the rank of Defender Elite no less.  Bravo. 

I've had a chance to analyze your combat data from your last mission and it's proving quite interesting.  The mecha knights in particular appear to actually be reacting to your attacks as if improvising.  But I can't say just yet. 

In any case, that's not relevant to today's data that I'm presenting.

mission.properties|o.p_r3_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Moorcroft Manor.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_8a: Well, that's the end of the tour, {0}. Would you like me to go over that again or are you ready to try everything out for yourself?

mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r3: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'

conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_2: Recon Knights who have ventured within these strange, new worlds claim to feel a dreadful darkness enveloping them at every turn.  There's something else happening here and we need our most elite knights to investigate.

shop.properties|m.unbindeDepotAd: Out of energy? Get more in the supply depot\!

conversation.properties|m.casino_klepto_: I won't steal anything... I promise\!

item.properties|f.grate_plate: A protective plate with peephole perforations permitting ventilation of exhalations.
